{{

        materialized='materialized_view',
        auto_refresh=true

}}

SELECT
    c.request_id::VARCHAR(36)                AS request_id,

    c.customer_id::VARCHAR(255)              AS customer_code,
    c.claim_id::VARCHAR(36)                  AS claim_number,
    c.requested_at::TIMESTAMP                AS requested_at,
    c.responded_at::TIMESTAMP                AS responded_at,
    c.payer_id::VARCHAR(255)                 AS payer_id,
    c.billing_npi::VARCHAR(10)               AS billing_npi,
    c.billing_ein::VARCHAR(10)               AS billing_ein,
    c.billing_name::VARCHAR(255)             AS billing_name,
    c.rendering_npi::VARCHAR(10)             AS rendering_npi,
    c.rendering_ein::VARCHAR(10)             AS rendering_ein,
    c.rendering_name::VARCHAR(255)           AS rendering_name,
    c.line_of_business::VARCHAR(255)         AS lob,
    c.standard_line_of_business::VARCHAR(255) AS standard_line_of_business,
    c.network_status::CHAR(1)                AS network_status,
    c.place_of_service::VARCHAR(255)         AS place_of_service,
    nullif(
        case when is_valid_json_array(c.standard_place_of_service)
            then json_extract_array_element_text(c.standard_place_of_service, 1)
            else c.standard_place_of_service
        end,
        ''
    )::VARCHAR(255)                          AS standard_place_of_service,
    c.patient_gender::CHAR(1)                AS gender,
    c.patient_state::CHAR(2)                 AS member_state_code,
    c.patient_age_band::INTEGER              AS member_age_band,
    c.icd_version::INTEGER                   AS icd_version,
    c.type_of_bill::VARCHAR(255)             AS type_of_bill,
    c.admission_type::VARCHAR(255)           AS admission_type,
    coalesce(c.lab_code::VARCHAR(20), 'OtherProvider') AS service_provider_lab_code,

    segment.segment_hash::VARCHAR(32)        AS segment_hash,
    segment.segment_name::VARCHAR(255)       AS segment_name,
    segment.segment_class::VARCHAR(255)      AS segment_class,
    segment.category_id::VARCHAR(255)        AS category_id,
    segment.category_confidence::DECIMAL(3, 2) AS category_confidence,
    segment.model_id::VARCHAR(36)            AS model_id,

    line.line_number::VARCHAR(255)           AS claim_line_number,
    line.date_of_service::TIMESTAMP          AS date_of_service,
    line.billed::DECIMAL(18, 2)              AS billed,
    line.cpt_code::VARCHAR(255)              AS procedure_code,
    line.cpt_modifier_1::VARCHAR(11)         AS procedure_modifier,
    line.cpt_modifier_2::VARCHAR(11)         AS procedure_modifier_2,
    line.cpt_modifier_3::VARCHAR(11)         AS procedure_modifier_3,
    line.cpt_modifier_4::VARCHAR(11)         AS procedure_modifier_4,
    line.service_units::INTEGER              AS service_units,
    line.target_count::INTEGER               AS target_count,
    line.has_auth_number::BOOLEAN            AS has_auth_number,
    line.status::VARCHAR(255)                AS claim_line_status,
    line.allowed::DECIMAL(18, 2)             AS allowed,
    line.revenue_code::VARCHAR(255)          AS revenue_code,

    line.icd_code_1::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_1,
    line.icd_code_2::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_2,
    line.icd_code_3::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_3,
    line.icd_code_4::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_4,
    line.icd_code_5::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_5,
    line.icd_code_6::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_6,
    line.icd_code_7::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_7,
    line.icd_code_8::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_8,
    line.icd_code_9::VARCHAR(255)            AS icd_9,
    line.icd_code_10::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_10,

    edit.edit_id::VARCHAR(36)                AS edit_id,
    edit.edit_short_code::VARCHAR(10)        AS edit_short_code,
    edit.edit_version::INTEGER               AS edit_version,
    edit.edit_disposition::VARCHAR(255)      AS disposition,
    edit.edit_msg::VARCHAR(1000)             AS rationale,
    edit.reason_code::VARCHAR(255)           AS remark_code,
    edit.reason_desc::VARCHAR(1000)          AS remark_desc,
    edit.edit_rank::INTEGER                  AS edit_rank,
    
    {{
        dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
            'segment.segment_name',
            'segment.segment_class'
        ])
    }} AS segment_id,
    {{
        dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
            'c.claim_id',
            'segment.segment_name',
            'segment.segment_class'
        ])
    }} AS segment_key

FROM {{ source('zetl_orders_db', 'deid_claim_grain_logs')}} c
LEFT JOIN c.segment_grain AS segment ON true
LEFT JOIN segment.lines AS line ON true
LEFT JOIN line.edits AS edit ON true

model.concert.stg_orders_db__results.name: stg_orders_db__results
model.concert.stg_orders_db__results.raw_code:
WITH 
  results AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('orders_db', 'orders_db__results') }}
  ),
  orders AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('orders_db', 'orders_db__orders') }}
  ),
  activitylog AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {{ source('orders_db', 'orders_db__activity_logs') }}
  )
  SELECT
      r.id
    , r.dateprocessed                   AS date_processed
    , r.dateuploaded                    AS date_uploaded
    , r.indicator
    , r.orderproduct_id                 AS order_product_id
    , r.order_id
    , r.patient_id
    , r.processedby_id                  AS processed_by_id
    , r.type
    , r.oruexportdate                   AS oru_export_date
    , r.oruexportdocumentsent           AS oru_export_document_sent
    , r.fuzzymatchproduct               AS fuzzy_match_product
    , TO_CHAR((
        SELECT MIN(a.datecreated)
        FROM activitylog a
        WHERE
          a.result_id=r.id
          AND a.user_id=o.user_id
          AND a.type='ResultViewed')
        ,'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM')     AS date_viewed_by_ordering_user
  FROM results r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id

WITH

claim_edit_api_line as (

),

api_lines as (
  select
    id,
    customer_id as customer_code,
    claim_id as claim_number,
    request_id,
    requested_at,
    responded_at,
    payer_id,
    billing_npi,
    billing_ein,
    billing_name,
    rendering_npi,
    rendering_ein,
    rendering_name,
    line_of_business as lob,
    standard_line_of_business,
    network_status,
    place_of_service,
    -- For a period of time, the audit API was appending certain enrichments as arrays. This flattens the place of service into varchars
    nullif(
      case when is_valid_json_array(standard_place_of_service)
        then json_extract_array_element_text(standard_place_of_service, 1)
        else standard_place_of_service
      end,
      ''
    ) as standard_place_of_service,
    patient_gender as gender,
    patient_state as member_state_code,
    patient_age_band as member_age_band,
    icd_version,
    type_of_bill,
    admission_type,
    coalesce(lab_code, 'OtherProvider') as service_provider_lab_code,
    category_id, -- NOTE( 2025-06-23 ): This is the pre-punt category_id
    category_confidence, -- NOTE( 2025-06-23 ): This is the pre-punt category_confidence
    segment_name,
    segment_class,
    segment_hash, -- TODO( 2024-04-11 ): Propogate this column downstream
    target_count, -- TODO( 2024-04-11 ): Propogate this column downstream
    model_id,
    line_number as claim_line_number,
    date_of_service,
    status      as claim_line_status,
    billed,
    allowed,
    revenue_code,
    cpt_code as procedure_code,
    cpt_modifier_1 as procedure_modifier,
    cpt_modifier_2 as procedure_modifier_2,
    cpt_modifier_3 as procedure_modifier_3,
    cpt_modifier_4 as procedure_modifier_4,
    service_units,
    has_auth_number,
    icd_code_1 as icd_1,
    icd_code_2 as icd_2,
    icd_code_3 as icd_3,
    icd_code_4 as icd_4,
    icd_code_5 as icd_5,
    icd_code_6 as icd_6,
    icd_code_7 as icd_7,
    icd_code_8 as icd_8,
    icd_code_9 as icd_9,
    icd_code_10 as icd_10,
    edit_id,
    edit_short_code,
    edit_version,
    edit_disposition as disposition,
    edit_msg as rationale,
    reason_code as remark_code,
    reason_desc as remark_desc,
    edit_rank
  from claim_edit_api_line
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        {{
            dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
                'segment_name',
                'segment_class'
            ])
        }} AS segment_id,
        {{
            dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
                'claim_number',
                'segment_name',
                'segment_class'
            ])
        }} AS segment_key
    FROM api_lines
)

select * from final

{#
  Notes to the Data Engineer:
    
    This data should be incorportated into the dimensional/mart
    structure as the need arises particularly regarding the usage
    of medicare LCD policies and their associated claim edits.

    The following is a template of the column definitions
    and tests that should be considered when modeling this data

    - name: ...
      description: >
        Distinct set of Medicare localities that are linked to
        Medicare Jurisdictions (Health Plan)
      columns:
        - name: key
          description: >
            Surrogate key representing the combination of the carrier_num and
            locality_num delimited by a hyphen (ex. 12345-00)
          tests:
            - unique
            - not_null
        - name: carrier_num
          description: The carrier (MAC) number used to identify the medicare administrative contractor
          tests:
            - not_null
        - name: locality_num
          description: The locality number for a carrier (MAC). Locality numbers can be reused by different carriers (not unique)
          tests:
            - not_null
        - name: state_codes
          description: The JSON string array of state codes that apply to this locality
          tests:
            - not_null
        - name: fee_schedule_area
          description: A description of the fee schedule area covered by the locality
          tests:
            - not_null
        - name: counties
          description: A description of the list of counties covered (or not covered) by the locality
          tests:
            - not_null
        - name: ab_jurisdiction_code
          description: The A/B MAC jurisdiction health plan code
          tests:
            - relationships:
                to: ref('dim_health_plan')
                field: health_plan_code
#}

WITH

localities AS (
  SELECT * FROM {{ source('concert_db', 'concert_db__medicare_localities') }}
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    datecreated             AS date_created,
    datemodified            AS date_modified,
    key,
    carriernum              AS carrier_num,
    localitynum             AS locality_num,
    statecodes              AS state_codes,
    feeschedulearea         AS fee_schedule_area,
    counties,
    abjurisdictioncode      AS ab_jurisdiction_code
  FROM localities
)

model.concert.stg_concert_db__zip_codes.raw_code:
{#
  Notes to the Data Engineer:
    
    This data should be incorportated into the dimensional/mart
    structure as the need arises particularly regarding the usage
    of medicare LCD policies and their associated claim edits.

    This could also potentially be rolled up into a more general purpose
    zip code dimension if it makes sense

    The following is a template of the column definitions
    and tests that should be considered when modeling this data

    - name: ...
      description: >
        Exhaustive list of all U.S. zip codes with a key to link them
        to their appropriate medicare localities
      tests:
        - unique_combination_of_columns:
            combination_of_columns:
              - zip_code
              - zip4_code
            config:
              where: "zip4_code != 'Not Applicable'"

      columns:
        - name: zip_code
          description: The 5-digit zip code
          tests:
            - unique
                config:
                  where: "zip4_code = 'Not Applicable'"
            - not_null
        - name: zip4_code
          description: >
            The plus 4 code to make up a complete 9-digit zip code.
            This is only used for zip codes that encompass more
            than one locality (ex. A zip code that crosses state boundaries).
          tests:
            - not_null
        - name: state_code
          description: The state code associated with this zip code
          tests:
            - not_null
            - relationships:
                to: ref('dim_state')
                field: state_code
        - name: medicare_locality_key
          description: The carrier number and locality number combined
          tests:
            - relationships:
                to: ref('stg_concert_db__medicare_localities')
                field: key
#}

  SELECT * FROM {{ source('concert_db', 'concert_db__zip_codes') }}

  SELECT
    datecreated             AS date_created,
    datemodified            AS date_modified,
    id,
    zipcode                 AS zip_code,
    zip4code                AS zip4_code,
    statecode               AS state_code,
    medicarelocalitykey     AS medicare_locality_key

)

model.concert.stg_claim_edit_api__transa.description:
Handles unnesting all of the nested object columns of a single audit record into a model
where each row represents the lowest possible grain of a claim audit record. Each row
is unique based on the transaction id, line number, and edit. The same claim can be submitted
by multiple transactions over time, so it's important to note that this is a TRANSACTION grain
table.
model.concert.stg_claim_edit_api__transa.compiled_code:
WITH

-- Grab all audit records excluding errors
claim_record AS (
	SELECT * FROM "dw"."dw_sources"."claim_audit_deid_prod"
	WHERE transaction."isError"::BOOLEAN = FALSE
),

-- Bulk majority of the claim record fields unnested to the transaction line grain
unnested_record__transaction_line AS (
	SELECT
		-- Server Data
		  record.server."workspace"::VARCHAR AS workspace,
		
		  record.server."context"::VARCHAR AS context,
		
		  record.server."editApiVersion"::VARCHAR AS edit_api_version,
		
		  record.server."auditApiVersion"::VARCHAR AS audit_api_version,
		
		  record.server."matchingModelId"::VARCHAR AS matching_model_id,
		
		  record.server."matchingModelVersion"::VARCHAR AS matching_model_version,
		
		  record.server."segmentVersion"::VARCHAR AS segment_version,
		-- Transaction Data
		  record.transaction."id"::VARCHAR AS id,
		
		  record.transaction."requestId"::VARCHAR AS request_id,
		
		  record.transaction."traceId"::VARCHAR AS trace_id,
		
		  record.transaction."customerId"::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
		
		  record.transaction."configId"::VARCHAR AS config_id,
		
		  record.transaction."configVersion"::VARCHAR AS config_version,
		
		  
    TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + record.transaction."editRequestTimestamp"::FLOAT / 1000 * INTERVAL '1 second'
 AS edit_request_timestamp,
		
		  
    TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + record.transaction."editResponseTimestamp"::FLOAT / 1000 * INTERVAL '1 second'
 AS edit_response_timestamp,
		
		  
    TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + record.transaction."auditReceivedTimestamp"::FLOAT / 1000 * INTERVAL '1 second'
 AS audit_received_timestamp,
		
		  
    TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + record.transaction."auditSentTimestamp"::FLOAT / 1000 * INTERVAL '1 second'
 AS audit_sent_timestamp,
		
		  record.transaction."url"::VARCHAR AS url,
		-- Claim Grain Data
		  record.claim."claimId"::VARCHAR AS claim_id,
		
		  record.claim."payerId"::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
		
		  record.claim."billingNPI"::VARCHAR AS billing_npi,
		
		  record.claim."billingEIN"::VARCHAR AS billing_ein,
		
		  record.claim."billingName"::VARCHAR AS billing_name,
		
		  record.claim."renderingNPI"::VARCHAR AS rendering_npi,
		
		  record.claim."renderingEIN"::VARCHAR AS rendering_ein,
		
		  record.claim."renderingName"::VARCHAR AS rendering_name,
		
		  record.claim."lineOfBusiness"::VARCHAR AS line_of_business,
		
		  record.claim."networkStatus"::VARCHAR AS network_status,
		
		  record.claim."placeOfService"::VARCHAR AS place_of_service,
		
		  record.claim."typeOfBill"::VARCHAR AS type_of_bill,
		
		  record.claim."admissionType"::VARCHAR AS admission_type,
		
		  record.claim."patientGender"::VARCHAR AS patient_gender,
		
		  record.claim."patientState"::VARCHAR AS patient_state,
		
		  record.claim."patientAgeBand"::INT AS patient_age_band,
		
		  record.claim."icdVersion"::INT AS icd_version,
		-- Line Grain Data
		  line."lineNumber"::VARCHAR AS line_number,
		
		  
    TO_TIMESTAMP(line."dateOfService"::VARCHAR, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
 AS date_of_service,
		
		  line."billed"::REAL AS billed,
		
		  line."allowed"::REAL AS allowed,
		
		  line."revenueCode"::VARCHAR AS revenue_code,
		
		  line."status"::VARCHAR AS status,
		
		  line."cptCode"::VARCHAR AS cpt_code,
		
		  line."cptModifier1"::VARCHAR AS cpt_modifier_1,
		
		  line."cptModifier2"::VARCHAR AS cpt_modifier_2,
		
		  line."cptModifier3"::VARCHAR AS cpt_modifier_3,
		
		  line."cptModifier4"::VARCHAR AS cpt_modifier_4,
		
		  line."serviceUnits"::INT AS service_units,
		
		  line."hasAuthNumber"::BOOLEAN AS has_auth_number,
		
		  line."icdCode1"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_1,
		
		  line."icdCode2"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_2,
		
		  line."icdCode3"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_3,
		
		  line."icdCode4"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_4,
		
		  line."icdCode5"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_5,
		
		  line."icdCode6"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_6,
		
		  line."icdCode7"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_7,
		
		  line."icdCode8"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_8,
		
		  line."icdCode9"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_9,
		
		  line."icdCode10"::VARCHAR AS icd_code_10,
		-- Claim Grain Enrichments
		  record.enrichments."lab"::VARCHAR AS lab_code
		,
		  record.enrichments."lob"::VARCHAR AS standard_line_of_business
		,
		  record.enrichments."pos"::VARCHAR AS standard_place_of_service
		,
		  record.enrichments."its"::VARCHAR AS standard_its_type
		FROM
		claim_record        record,
		record.claim.lines  line
),

-- Enrichments section of the audit record unnested to the transaction edit grain
unnested_record__transaction_edit AS (
	SELECT
		-- Keys used for joining
		record.transaction.id::VARCHAR  AS id,
		line."num"::VARCHAR             AS line_number,
		-- Segment Grain Enrichments
		  segment."name"::VARCHAR AS segment_name,
		
		  segment."class"::VARCHAR AS segment_class,
		
		  segment."cat"::VARCHAR AS category_id,
		
		  segment."prob"::REAL AS category_probability,
		-- Line Grain Enrichments
		  line."targ"::INT AS line_target_count,
		-- Edit Grain Enrichments
		  edit."id"::VARCHAR AS edit_id
		,
		  edit."ver"::INT AS edit_version
		,
		  edit."rank"::INT AS edit_rank
		FROM
		claim_record             record,
		record.enrichments.segs  segment,
		segment.lines            line,
		line.edits               edit
),

final AS (
	SELECT
		-- All columns from the unnested transaction line grain
		  record.workspace,
		
		  record.context,
		
		  record.edit_api_version,
		
		  record.audit_api_version,
		
		  record.matching_model_id,
		
		  record.matching_model_version,
		
		  record.segment_version,
		
		  record.id,
		
		  record.request_id,
		
		  record.trace_id,
		
		  record.customer_id,
		
		  record.config_id,
		
		  record.config_version,
		
		  record.edit_request_timestamp,
		
		  record.edit_response_timestamp,
		
		  record.audit_received_timestamp,
		
		  record.audit_sent_timestamp,
		
		  record.url,
		
		  record.claim_id,
		
		  record.payer_id,
		
		  record.billing_npi,
		
		  record.billing_ein,
		
		  record.billing_name,
		
		  record.rendering_npi,
		
		  record.rendering_ein,
		
		  record.rendering_name,
		
		  record.line_of_business,
		
		  record.network_status,
		
		  record.place_of_service,
		
		  record.type_of_bill,
		
		  record.admission_type,
		
		  record.patient_gender,
		
		  record.patient_state,
		
		  record.patient_age_band,
		
		  record.icd_version,
		
		  record.line_number,
		
		  record.date_of_service,
		
		  record.billed,
		
		  record.allowed,
		
		  record.revenue_code,
		
		  record.status,
		
		  record.cpt_code,
		
		  record.cpt_modifier_1,
		
		  record.cpt_modifier_2,
		
		  record.cpt_modifier_3,
		
		  record.cpt_modifier_4,
		
		  record.service_units,
		
		  record.has_auth_number,
		
		  record.icd_code_1,
		
		  record.icd_code_2,
		
		  record.icd_code_3,
		
		  record.icd_code_4,
		
		  record.icd_code_5,
		
		  record.icd_code_6,
		
		  record.icd_code_7,
		
		  record.icd_code_8,
		
		  record.icd_code_9,
		
		  record.icd_code_10,
		
		  record.lab_code,
		
		  record.standard_line_of_business,
		
		  record.standard_place_of_service,
		
		  record.standard_its_type,
		-- All columns joined from the transaction edit grain enrichments
		  enrich.segment_name
		,
		  enrich.segment_class
		,
		  enrich.category_id
		,
		  enrich.category_probability
		,
		  enrich.line_target_count
		,
		  enrich.edit_id
		,
		  enrich.edit_version
		,
		  enrich.edit_rank
		FROM unnested_record__transaction_line record
	LEFT JOIN unnested_record__transaction_edit enrich ON
		record.id = enrich.id AND
		record.line_number = enrich.line_number
)

model.concert.stg_spectrum__claim_audit_.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='incremental',
        unique_key='id',
        incremental_strategy='append'
    )
}}

WITH

claim_lines AS (
    SELECT
        c."transaction".requestId::VARCHAR(36)      AS request_id,
        c."transaction".id::VARCHAR(36)             AS id,
        c."transaction".customerId::VARCHAR(255)    AS customer_code,
        c."transaction".claimId::VARCHAR(36)        AS claim_number,

        TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (c."transaction".editRequestTimestamp::BIGINT / 1000) * INTERVAL '1 second'
                                                    AS requested_at,
        TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (c."transaction".editResponseTimestamp::BIGINT / 1000) * INTERVAL '1 second'
                                                    AS responded_at,

        c.claim.payerId::VARCHAR(255)               AS payer_id,
        c.claim.billingNPI::VARCHAR(10)             AS billing_npi,
        c.claim.billingEIN::VARCHAR(10)             AS billing_ein,
        c.claim.billingName::VARCHAR(255)           AS billing_name,
        c.claim.renderingNPI::VARCHAR(10)           AS rendering_npi,
        c.claim.renderingEIN::VARCHAR(10)           AS rendering_ein,
        c.claim.renderingName::VARCHAR(255)         AS rendering_name,
        c.claim.lineOfBusiness::VARCHAR(255)        AS lob,
        c.enrichments.lob::VARCHAR(255)             AS standard_line_of_business,
        c.claim.networkStatus::CHAR(1)              AS network_status,
        c.claim.placeOfService::VARCHAR(255)        AS place_of_service,
        c.enrichments.pos::VARCHAR(255)             AS standard_place_of_service,
        c.claim.patientGender::CHAR(1)              AS gender,
        c.claim.patientState::CHAR(2)               AS member_state_code,
        c.claim.patientAgeBand::INTEGER             AS member_age_band,
        c.claim.icdVersion::INTEGER                 AS icd_version,
        c.claim.typeOfBill::VARCHAR(255)            AS type_of_bill,
        c.claim.admissionType::VARCHAR(255)         AS admission_type,
        COALESCE(c.enrichments.lab::VARCHAR(20), 'OtherProvider') AS service_provider_lab_code,

        c.server.matchingModelId::VARCHAR(36)       AS model_id,

        claim_line.lineNumber::VARCHAR(255)         AS claim_line_number,
        (claim_line.dateOfService::VARCHAR)::DATE::TIMESTAMP AS date_of_service,
        claim_line.billed::DECIMAL(18, 2)           AS billed,
        claim_line.cptCode::VARCHAR(255)            AS procedure_code,
        claim_line.cptModifier1::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier,
        claim_line.cptModifier2::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier_2,
        claim_line.cptModifier3::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier_3,
        claim_line.cptModifier4::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier_4,
        claim_line.serviceUnits::INTEGER            AS service_units,
        claim_line.hasAuthNumber::BOOLEAN           AS has_auth_number,
        claim_line.status::VARCHAR(255)             AS claim_line_status,
        claim_line.allowed::DECIMAL(18, 2)          AS allowed,
        claim_line.revenueCode::VARCHAR(255)        AS revenue_code,

        claim_line.icdCode1::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_1,
        claim_line.icdCode2::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_2,
        claim_line.icdCode3::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_3,
        claim_line.icdCode4::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_4,
        claim_line.icdCode5::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_5,
        claim_line.icdCode6::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_6,
        claim_line.icdCode7::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_7,
        claim_line.icdCode8::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_8,
        claim_line.icdCode9::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_9,
        claim_line.icdCode10::VARCHAR(255)          AS icd_10,

        c."transaction".editRequestTimestamp        AS _edit_request_ts

    FROM {{ source('redshift_spectrum', 'claim_audit_records') }} c
    LEFT JOIN c.claim.lines AS claim_line ON true
    WHERE c."transaction".isError = false

    {% if is_incremental() %}
        AND c."transaction".editRequestTimestamp > (
            SELECT MAX(_edit_request_ts) FROM {{ this }}
        )
    {% endif %}
),

enrichment_edits AS (
    SELECT
        c."transaction".id::VARCHAR(36)             AS id,
        c."transaction".claimId::VARCHAR(36)        AS claim_number,
        enr_line.num::VARCHAR(255)                  AS line_number,

        MD5(
            (c."transaction".claimId::VARCHAR || '|') ||
            (seg."class"::VARCHAR || '|') ||
            COALESCE(seg."name"::VARCHAR, 'NULL')
        )::VARCHAR(32)                              AS segment_hash,
        seg."name"::VARCHAR(255)                    AS segment_name,
        seg."class"::VARCHAR(255)                   AS segment_class,
        seg.cat::VARCHAR(255)                       AS category_id,
        seg.prob::DECIMAL(3, 2)                     AS category_confidence,

        enr_line.targ::INTEGER                      AS target_count,

        edit.id::VARCHAR(36)                        AS edit_id,
        NULL::VARCHAR(10)                           AS edit_short_code,
        edit.ver::INTEGER                           AS edit_version,
        NULL::VARCHAR(255)                          AS disposition,
        NULL::VARCHAR(1000)                         AS rationale,
        NULL::VARCHAR(255)                          AS remark_code,
        NULL::VARCHAR(1000)                         AS remark_desc,
        edit."rank"::INTEGER                        AS edit_rank,

        {{
            dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
                'seg."name"',
                'seg."class"'
            ])
        }} AS segment_id,
        {{
            dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
                'c."transaction".claimId',
                'seg."name"',
                'seg."class"'
            ])
        }} AS segment_key

    FROM {{ source('redshift_spectrum', 'claim_audit_records') }} c
    LEFT JOIN c.enrichments.segs AS seg ON true
    LEFT JOIN seg.lines AS enr_line ON true
    LEFT JOIN enr_line.edits AS edit ON true
    WHERE c."transaction".isError = false

    {% if is_incremental() %}
        AND c."transaction".editRequestTimestamp > (
            SELECT MAX(_edit_request_ts) FROM {{ this }}
        )
    {% endif %}
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        cl.request_id,
        cl.id,
        cl.customer_code,
        cl.claim_number,
        cl.requested_at,
        cl.responded_at,
        cl.payer_id,
        cl.billing_npi,
        cl.billing_ein,
        cl.billing_name,
        cl.rendering_npi,
        cl.rendering_ein,
        cl.rendering_name,
        cl.lob,
        cl.standard_line_of_business,
        cl.network_status,
        cl.place_of_service,
        cl.standard_place_of_service,
        cl.gender,
        cl.member_state_code,
        cl.member_age_band,
        cl.icd_version,
        cl.type_of_bill,
        cl.admission_type,
        cl.service_provider_lab_code,
        ee.segment_hash,
        ee.segment_name,
        ee.segment_class,
        ee.category_id,
        ee.category_confidence,
        cl.model_id,
        cl.claim_line_number,
        cl.date_of_service,
        cl.billed,
        cl.procedure_code,
        cl.procedure_modifier,
        cl.procedure_modifier_2,
        cl.procedure_modifier_3,
        cl.procedure_modifier_4,
        cl.service_units,
        ee.target_count,
        cl.has_auth_number,
        cl.claim_line_status,
        cl.allowed,
        cl.revenue_code,
        cl.icd_1,
        cl.icd_2,
        cl.icd_3,
        cl.icd_4,
        cl.icd_5,
        cl.icd_6,
        cl.icd_7,
        cl.icd_8,
        cl.icd_9,
        cl.icd_10,
        ee.edit_id,
        ee.edit_short_code,
        ee.edit_version,
        ee.disposition,
        ee.rationale,
        ee.remark_code,
        ee.remark_desc,
        ee.edit_rank,
        cl._edit_request_ts,
        ee.segment_id,
        ee.segment_key
    FROM claim_lines cl
    LEFT JOIN enrichment_edits ee ON
        cl.id = ee.id AND
        cl.claim_line_number = ee.line_number
)

        c.claim.billingName::VARCHAR(255)           AS billing_name,
        c.claim.renderingNPI::VARCHAR(10)           AS rendering_npi,
        c.claim.renderingEIN::VARCHAR(10)           AS rendering_ein,
        c.claim.renderingName::VARCHAR(255)         AS rendering_name,
        c.claim.lineOfBusiness::VARCHAR(255)        AS lob,
        c.enrichments.lob::VARCHAR(255)             AS standard_line_of_business,
        c.claim.networkStatus::CHAR(1)              AS network_status,
        c.claim.placeOfService::VARCHAR(255)        AS place_of_service,
        c.enrichments.pos::VARCHAR(255)             AS standard_place_of_service,
        c.claim.patientGender::CHAR(1)              AS gender,
        c.claim.patientState::CHAR(2)               AS member_state_code,
        c.claim.patientAgeBand::INTEGER             AS member_age_band,
        c.claim.icdVersion::INTEGER                 AS icd_version,
        c.claim.typeOfBill::VARCHAR(255)            AS type_of_bill,
        c.claim.admissionType::VARCHAR(255)         AS admission_type,
        COALESCE(c.enrichments.lab::VARCHAR(20), 'OtherProvider') AS service_provider_lab_code,

        c.server.matchingModelId::VARCHAR(36)       AS model_id,

        claim_line.lineNumber::VARCHAR(255)         AS claim_line_number,
        (claim_line.dateOfService::VARCHAR)::DATE::TIMESTAMP AS date_of_service,
        claim_line.billed::DECIMAL(18, 2)           AS billed,
        claim_line.cptCode::VARCHAR(255)            AS procedure_code,
        claim_line.cptModifier1::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier,
        claim_line.cptModifier2::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier_2,
        claim_line.cptModifier3::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier_3,
        claim_line.cptModifier4::VARCHAR(11)        AS procedure_modifier_4,
        claim_line.serviceUnits::INTEGER            AS service_units,
        claim_line.hasAuthNumber::BOOLEAN           AS has_auth_number,
        claim_line.status::VARCHAR(255)             AS claim_line_status,
        claim_line.allowed::DECIMAL(18, 2)          AS allowed,
        claim_line.revenueCode::VARCHAR(255)        AS revenue_code,

        claim_line.icdCode1::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_1,
        claim_line.icdCode2::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_2,
        claim_line.icdCode3::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_3,
        claim_line.icdCode4::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_4,
        claim_line.icdCode5::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_5,
        claim_line.icdCode6::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_6,
        claim_line.icdCode7::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_7,
        claim_line.icdCode8::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_8,
        claim_line.icdCode9::VARCHAR(255)           AS icd_9,
        claim_line.icdCode10::VARCHAR(255)          AS icd_10,

        c."transaction".editRequestTimestamp        AS _edit_request_ts

    FROM "dw"."spectrum_schema"."claim_audit_records" c
    LEFT JOIN c.claim.lines AS claim_line ON true
    WHERE c."transaction".isError = false

    
        AND c."transaction".editRequestTimestamp > (
            SELECT MAX(_edit_request_ts) FROM "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines"
        )
    
),

enrichment_edits AS (
    SELECT
        c."transaction".id::VARCHAR(36)             AS id,
        c."transaction".claimId::VARCHAR(36)        AS claim_number,
        enr_line.num::VARCHAR(255)                  AS line_number,

        MD5(
            (c."transaction".claimId::VARCHAR || '|') ||
            (seg."class"::VARCHAR || '|') ||
            COALESCE(seg."name"::VARCHAR, 'NULL')
        )::VARCHAR(32)                              AS segment_hash,
        seg."name"::VARCHAR(255)                    AS segment_name,
        seg."class"::VARCHAR(255)                   AS segment_class,
        seg.cat::VARCHAR(255)                       AS category_id,
        seg.prob::DECIMAL(3, 2)                     AS category_confidence,

        enr_line.targ::INTEGER                      AS target_count,

        edit.id::VARCHAR(36)                        AS edit_id,
        NULL::VARCHAR(10)                           AS edit_short_code,
        edit.ver::INTEGER                           AS edit_version,
        NULL::VARCHAR(255)                          AS disposition,
        NULL::VARCHAR(1000)                         AS rationale,
        NULL::VARCHAR(255)                          AS remark_code,
        NULL::VARCHAR(1000)                         AS remark_desc,
        edit."rank"::INTEGER                        AS edit_rank,

        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(seg."name" as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(seg."class" as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) AS segment_id,
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(c."transaction".claimId as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(seg."name" as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(seg."class" as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) AS segment_key

    FROM "dw"."spectrum_schema"."claim_audit_records" c
    LEFT JOIN c.enrichments.segs AS seg ON true
    LEFT JOIN seg.lines AS enr_line ON true
    LEFT JOIN enr_line.edits AS edit ON true
    WHERE c."transaction".isError = false

    
        AND c."transaction".editRequestTimestamp > (
            SELECT MAX(_edit_request_ts) FROM "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines"
        )
    
),

final AS (
    SELECT
        cl.request_id,
        cl.id,
        cl.customer_code,
        cl.claim_number,
        cl.requested_at,
        cl.responded_at,
        cl.payer_id,
        cl.billing_npi,
        cl.billing_ein,
        cl.billing_name,
        cl.rendering_npi,
        cl.rendering_ein,
        cl.rendering_name,
        cl.lob,
        cl.standard_line_of_business,
        cl.network_status,
        cl.place_of_service,
        cl.standard_place_of_service,
        cl.gender,
        cl.member_state_code,
        cl.member_age_band,
        cl.icd_version,
        cl.type_of_bill,
        cl.admission_type,
        cl.service_provider_lab_code,
        ee.segment_hash,
        ee.segment_name,
        ee.segment_class,
        ee.category_id,
        ee.category_confidence,
        cl.model_id,
        cl.claim_line_number,
        cl.date_of_service,
        cl.billed,
        cl.procedure_code,
        cl.procedure_modifier,
        cl.procedure_modifier_2,
        cl.procedure_modifier_3,
        cl.procedure_modifier_4,
        cl.service_units,
        ee.target_count,
        cl.has_auth_number,
        cl.claim_line_status,
        cl.allowed,
        cl.revenue_code,
        cl.icd_1,
        cl.icd_2,
        cl.icd_3,
        cl.icd_4,
        cl.icd_5,
        cl.icd_6,
        cl.icd_7,
        cl.icd_8,
        cl.icd_9,
        cl.icd_10,
        ee.edit_id,
        ee.edit_short_code,
        ee.edit_version,
        ee.disposition,
        ee.rationale,
        ee.remark_code,
        ee.remark_desc,
        ee.edit_rank,
        cl._edit_request_ts,
        ee.segment_id,
        ee.segment_key
    FROM claim_lines cl
    LEFT JOIN enrichment_edits ee ON
        cl.id = ee.id AND
        cl.claim_line_number = ee.line_number
)

SELECT * FROM final

model.concert.mart_claim_edit_api_future.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='claim_number',
    sort=['claim_number'],
  )
}}

with

line as (
  select * from {{ ref('fct_claim_edit_api_line') }}
),

claim as (
  select * from {{ ref('fct_claim_edit_api_claim') }}
),

line_edit as (
  select * from {{ ref('bdg_claim_edit_api_line_edit') }}
),

subscription as (
  select * from {{ ref('bdg_claim_edit_subscription') }}
),

claim_edit as (
  select * from {{ ref('dim_claim_edit') }}
),

category as (
  select * from {{ ref('dim_category') }}
),

future_subscription_date as (
  select
    claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    payer_id AS payer_id,
    effective_start_date AS effective_date,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        claim_edit_subscriber_code,
        payer_id,
        effective_start_date
    ) as row_num
  from subscription
  where effective_start_date is not null
    and effective_start_date > current_date
),

unique_future_subscription_date as (
  select
    claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    effective_date,
    payer_id
  from future_subscription_date
  where row_num = 1
),

{% for source in ['audit', 'udf_concert'] %}
  {{ source }}_edit as (
    select
      line_edit.claim_number as claim_number,
      line_edit.segment_key AS segment_key,
      line_edit.claim_edit_api_line_key as claim_edit_api_line_key,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_key as edit_key,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_type as edit_type,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_short_code as edit_short_code,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_version as edit_version,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_short_disposition as edit_disposition,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_rationale as edit_rationale,
      line_edit.edit_rank
    from line_edit
    inner join claim_edit
      on line_edit.claim_edit_key = claim_edit.claim_edit_key
    where line_edit.edit_source = '{{ source|upper }}'
    -- Only limit audit source edits to the top ranked (etl will be filtered by subscription)
    {% if source == 'AUDIT' %}
      and line_edit.edit_rank = 1
    {% endif %}
  ),
{% endfor %}

-- All line edits per distinct future subscription for each applicable subscriber
line_edit_subscription as (
  select
    line.claim_edit_api_line_key,
    unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date,
    unique_future_subscription_date.payer_id,
    line.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    line.service_provider_lab_code,
    line.claim_number,
    line.segment_key,
    line.claim_line_number,
    line.category_id,
    etl_edit.edit_key,
    etl_edit.edit_short_code,
    etl_edit.edit_version,
    etl_edit.edit_disposition,
    etl_edit.edit_rationale,
    subscription.participation,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        unique_future_subscription_date.payer_id,
        unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date,
        line.claim_number,
        line.claim_line_number
      order by
        etl_edit.edit_rank
    ) as edit_rank
  from line
  inner join unique_future_subscription_date
    on line.claim_edit_subscriber_code
      = unique_future_subscription_date.claim_edit_subscriber_code
  -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
  left join udf_concert_edit etl_edit on
    line.claim_number = etl_edit.claim_number and
    line.claim_edit_api_line_key = etl_edit.claim_edit_api_line_key
  left join subscription
    on line.claim_edit_subscriber_code = subscription.claim_edit_subscriber_code
      and etl_edit.edit_key = subscription.claim_edit_key
  where etl_edit.edit_type = 'Static'
    or (
      subscription.claim_edit_subscriber_code is not null
      and (
        subscription.effective_start_date is null
        or subscription.effective_start_date
          <= unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date
      )
      and (
        subscription.effective_end_date is null
        or subscription.effective_end_date
          > unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date
      )
    )
),

top_line as (
  select *
  from line_edit_subscription
  where edit_rank = 1
),

edit_disposition as (
  select
    top_line.claim_edit_api_line_key,
    top_line.participation,
    case
        when
            (
                (top_line.participation IN ('All', 'Unknown') OR claim.network_status = 'X') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'In-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'I') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'Out-of-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'O')
            ) then top_line.edit_disposition
        else 'NoEdit'
    end as realized_new_edit_disposition,
    case
        when
            (
                (top_line.participation IN ('All', 'Unknown') OR claim.network_status = 'X') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'In-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'I') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'Out-of-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'O')
            ) then top_line.edit_rationale
        else 'Particpation status = ' || top_line.participation || ' and Network Status = ' || claim.network_status
    end as realized_new_edit_rationale
  from top_line
  inner join claim
    on top_line.claim_number = claim.claim_number
    AND top_line.payer_id = claim.payer_id
),

final as (
  select
    top_line.effective_date,
    top_line.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    claim.payer_id,
    top_line.service_provider_lab_code,
    top_line.claim_number,
    top_line.segment_key,
    top_line.claim_line_number,
    category.category_name,
    category.domain_name,
    coalesce(api_edit.edit_short_code, 'Unspecified')          AS current_edit_short_code,
    coalesce(api_edit.edit_version, 0)                         AS current_edit_version,
    coalesce(api_edit.edit_disposition, 'Unspecified')         AS current_edit_disposition,
    coalesce(api_edit.edit_rationale, 'Unspecified')           AS current_edit_rationale,
    top_line.edit_short_code                                   AS new_edit_short_code,
    top_line.edit_version                                      AS new_edit_version,

with

line as (

future_subscription_date as (

    row_number() over (
      partition by
        claim_edit_subscriber_code,
        payer_id,

    ) as row_num
  from subscription
  where effective_start_date is not null
    and effective_start_date > current_date
),

unique_future_subscription_date as (
  select
    claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    effective_date,
    payer_id
  from future_subscription_date
  where row_num = 1
),


  audit_edit as (
    select
      line_edit.claim_number as claim_number,
      line_edit.segment_key AS segment_key,
      line_edit.claim_edit_api_line_key as claim_edit_api_line_key,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_key as edit_key,

      claim_edit.claim_edit_short_code as edit_short_code,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_version as edit_version,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_short_disposition as edit_disposition,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_rationale as edit_rationale,
      line_edit.edit_rank
    from line_edit
    inner join claim_edit
      on line_edit.claim_edit_key = claim_edit.claim_edit_key
    where line_edit.edit_source = 'AUDIT'
    -- Only limit audit source edits to the top ranked (etl will be filtered by subscription)
    
  ),

  udf_concert_edit as (
    select
      line_edit.claim_number as claim_number,
      line_edit.segment_key AS segment_key,
      line_edit.claim_edit_api_line_key as claim_edit_api_line_key,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_key as edit_key,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_type as edit_type,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_short_code as edit_short_code,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_version as edit_version,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_short_disposition as edit_disposition,
      claim_edit.claim_edit_rationale as edit_rationale,
      line_edit.edit_rank
    from line_edit
    inner join claim_edit
      on line_edit.claim_edit_key = claim_edit.claim_edit_key
    where line_edit.edit_source = 'UDF_CONCERT'
    -- Only limit audit source edits to the top ranked (etl will be filtered by subscription)
    
  ),


-- All line edits per distinct future subscription for each applicable subscriber
line_edit_subscription as (
  select
    line.claim_edit_api_line_key,
    unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date,
    unique_future_subscription_date.payer_id,
    line.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    line.service_provider_lab_code,
    line.claim_number,
    line.segment_key,
    line.claim_line_number,
    line.category_id,
    etl_edit.edit_key,
    etl_edit.edit_short_code,
    etl_edit.edit_version,
    etl_edit.edit_disposition,
    etl_edit.edit_rationale,
    subscription.participation,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        unique_future_subscription_date.payer_id,
        unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date,
        line.claim_number,
        line.claim_line_number
      order by
        etl_edit.edit_rank
    ) as edit_rank
  from line
  inner join unique_future_subscription_date
    on line.claim_edit_subscriber_code
      = unique_future_subscription_date.claim_edit_subscriber_code
  -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
  left join udf_concert_edit etl_edit on
    line.claim_number = etl_edit.claim_number and
    line.claim_edit_api_line_key = etl_edit.claim_edit_api_line_key
  left join subscription
    on line.claim_edit_subscriber_code = subscription.claim_edit_subscriber_code
      and etl_edit.edit_key = subscription.claim_edit_key
  where etl_edit.edit_type = 'Static'
    or (
      subscription.claim_edit_subscriber_code is not null
      and (
        subscription.effective_start_date is null
        or subscription.effective_start_date
          <= unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date
      )
      and (
        subscription.effective_end_date is null
        or subscription.effective_end_date
          > unique_future_subscription_date.effective_date
      )
    )
),

top_line as (
  select *
  from line_edit_subscription
  where edit_rank = 1
),

edit_disposition as (
  select
    top_line.claim_edit_api_line_key,
    top_line.participation,
    case
        when
            (
                (top_line.participation IN ('All', 'Unknown') OR claim.network_status = 'X') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'In-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'I') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'Out-of-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'O')

        else 'NoEdit'
    end as realized_new_edit_disposition,
    case
        when
            (
                (top_line.participation IN ('All', 'Unknown') OR claim.network_status = 'X') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'In-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'I') OR
                (top_line.participation = 'Out-of-Network' AND claim.network_status = 'O')
            ) then top_line.edit_rationale
        else 'Particpation status = ' || top_line.participation || ' and Network Status = ' || claim.network_status
    end as realized_new_edit_rationale
  from top_line
  inner join claim
    on top_line.claim_number = claim.claim_number
    AND top_line.payer_id = claim.payer_id
),

final as (
  select
    top_line.effective_date,
    top_line.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    claim.payer_id,
    top_line.service_provider_lab_code,
    top_line.claim_number,
    top_line.segment_key,
    top_line.claim_line_number,
    category.category_name,
    category.domain_name,

    coalesce(api_edit.edit_version, 0)                         AS current_edit_version,
    coalesce(api_edit.edit_disposition, 'Unspecified')         AS current_edit_disposition,
    coalesce(api_edit.edit_rationale, 'Unspecified')           AS current_edit_rationale,
    top_line.edit_short_code                                   AS new_edit_short_code,
    top_line.edit_version                                      AS new_edit_version,
    edit_disposition.realized_new_edit_disposition             AS new_edit_disposition,
    edit_disposition.realized_new_edit_rationale               AS new_edit_rationale,
    claim.network_status                                       AS network_status,
    coalesce(edit_disposition.participation, 'Not Applicable') AS participation,
    case
      when api_edit.edit_key != top_line.edit_key
        then 'Is Different'
      else 'Not Different'
    end as is_different_edit,
    case
      when api_edit.edit_disposition != edit_disposition.realized_new_edit_disposition
        then 'Is Different'

model.concert.mart_claim_edit_api_line.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='claim_number',
    sort=['claim_number', 'claim_line_number', 'request_id'],
    tags=['claim_edit_api_reporting'],
  )
}}

{% set FCT_LINE = ref('fct_claim_edit_api_line') %}
{% set FCT_CLAIM = ref('fct_claim_edit_api_claim') %}
{% set DIM_SUBSCRIBER = ref('dim_claim_edit_subscriber') %}
{% set DIM_POS = ref('dim_place_of_service') %}
{% set DIM_CATEGORY = ref('dim_category') %}
{% set DIM_PROVIDER = ref('dim_provider') %}
{% set CLAIM_ICD = ref('claim_edit_api_icd__claim__grouped') %}
{% set CLAIM_CPT = ref('claim_edit_api_cpt__claim__grouped') %}
{% set SEGMENT_CPT = ref('claim_edit_api_cpt__segment__grouped') %}
{% set DIM_DIAGNOSIS = ref('dim_diagnosis') %}
{% set DIM_PROCEDURE = ref('dim_procedure') %}

{% set EDIT_SOURCES = var('ceapi_edit_sources') %}

select
  line.claim_edit_api_line_key,
  line.concert_id,
  line.claim_number,
  line.segment_key,
  line.claim_line_number,
  line.request_id,
  subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
  subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_name,
  claim.payer_id,
  line.date_of_transaction_request,
  line.date_of_transaction_response,
  line.requested_at_et,
  line.responded_at_et,
  line.error,
  line.status_code,
  line.claim_line_status,
  line.transaction_processing_time_in_ms,
  line.date_of_service,
  billing_provider.provider_npi                                     as billing_provider_npi,
  billing_provider.provider_ein                                     as billing_provider_ein,
  billing_provider.provider_name                                    as billing_provider_name,
  line.billing_provider_key,
  billing_provider.lab_code                                         as billing_provider_lab_code,
  billing_provider.lab_name                                         as billing_provider_lab_name,
  rendering_provider.provider_npi                                   as service_provider_npi,
  rendering_provider.provider_ein                                   as service_provider_ein,
  rendering_provider.provider_name                                  as service_provider_name,
  line.service_provider_key,
  rendering_provider.lab_code                                       as service_provider_lab_code,
  line.service_provider_lab_name                                    as service_provider_lab_name,
  claim.line_of_business,
  line.standard_line_of_business,
  claim.network_status,
  pos.place_of_service_code                                         as cms_place_of_service_code,
  pos.place_of_service_name                                         as cms_place_of_service_description,
  category.category_name,
  category.domain_name,
  category.area_name,
  claim.member_sex,
  line.member_state_code,
  line.member_age_band,
  claim.icd_version,
  line.procedure_code,
  {% for i in range(1, 5) %}
    line.procedure_modifier_{{ i }},
  {% endfor %}
  claim.procedure_signature                                         as claim_procedure_signature,
  {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
    line.diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
    coalesce(diagnosis_{{ i }}.diagnosis_description, 'Unknown')    as diagnosis_description_{{ i }},
  {% endfor %}
  claim.diagnosis_signature                                         as diagnosis_signature,
  
  -- Legacy edit column names (for backwards compatibility with existing reports)
  line.audit_edit_short_code                                        as top_edit_code,
  line.audit_edit_disposition                                       as top_edit_disposition,
  line.audit_edit_rationale                                         as top_edit_rationale,
  line.audit_edit_remark_code                                       as top_edit_remark_code,
  line.audit_edit_remark_description                                as top_edit_remark_description,
  line.audit_edit_criteria_code                                     as top_edit_parent_criteria_code,

  -- Top edits from each edit source (preferred naming convention)
  {% for edit_source in EDIT_SOURCES %}
    {% set prefix = edit_source.name ~ '_edit' %}
    line.{{ prefix }}_key                                           as {{ prefix }}_key,
    line.{{ prefix }}_id                                            as {{ prefix }}_id,
    line.{{ prefix }}_short_code                                    as {{ prefix }}_code,
    line.{{ prefix }}_version                                       as {{ prefix }}_version,
    line.{{ prefix }}_disposition                                   as {{ prefix }}_disposition,
    line.{{ prefix }}_rationale                                     as {{ prefix }}_rationale,
    line.{{ prefix }}_remark_code                                   as {{ prefix }}_remark_code,
    line.{{ prefix }}_remark_description                            as {{ prefix }}_remark_description,
    line.{{ prefix }}_criteria_code                                 as {{ prefix }}_criteria_code,
    line.{{ prefix }}_edited_billed_amount                          as {{ prefix }}_edited_billed_amount,
    line.{{ prefix }}_policy_code                                   as {{ prefix }}_policy_code,
    line.{{ prefix }}_policy_version                                as {{ prefix }}_policy_version,
    line.{{ prefix }}_policy_name                                   as {{ prefix }}_policy_name,
    line.{{ prefix }}_policy_id                                     as {{ prefix }}_policy_id,
    line.{{ prefix }}_policy_type                                   as {{ prefix }}_policy_type,
    line.{{ prefix }}_criteria_version                              as {{ prefix }}_criteria_version,
    line.{{ prefix }}_criteria_name                                 as {{ prefix }}_criteria_name,
    line.{{ prefix }}_criteria_id                                   as {{ prefix }}_criteria_id,
    CASE
      WHEN line.{{ prefix }}_disposition = 'deny' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END as {{ prefix }}_claim_edit_indicator,
  {% endfor %}
  line.is_concert_edit_different,
  line.is_customer_edit_different,
  line.concert_edit_change,
  line.customer_edit_change,
  line.is_concert_disposition_different,
  line.is_customer_disposition_different,
  line.concert_disposition_change,
  line.customer_disposition_change,
  line.billed_amount_per_service_unit,
  line.service_units,
  line.billed_amount,
  line.allowed_amount,
  line.volume,
  line.admission_type,
  line.category_id,
  line.customer_code,
  line.has_prior_authorization,
  line.pre_punt_category_id,
  line.revenue_code,
  line.segment_class,
  line.segment_id,
  line.segment_name,
  line.standard_place_of_service,
  line.type_of_bill,
  line.target_count,
  line.pre_punt_prediction_probability,
  line.is_punted,
  line.latest_claim_indicator,
  line.claim_revenue_code_signature,
  line.claim_matching_model_id,
  claim_icd.diagnosis_descriptions                                 as diagnosis_descriptions,
  claim_cpt.cpt_descriptions                                       as claim_procedure_descriptions,
  procedure.clean_procedure_description                            as procedure_description,
  segment_cpt.cpt_signature                                        as segment_procedure_signature,
  segment_cpt.procedure_descriptions                               as segment_procedure_descriptions,
  GETDATE()                                                        as record_last_updated_UTC
from {{ FCT_LINE }} line
inner join {{ FCT_CLAIM }} claim
  on line.claim_number = claim.claim_number
inner join {{ DIM_SUBSCRIBER }} subscriber
  on line.claim_edit_subscriber_code = subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code
inner join {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} billing_provider
  on line.billing_provider_key = billing_provider.provider_key
inner join {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} rendering_provider
  on line.service_provider_key = rendering_provider.provider_key
inner join {{ DIM_POS }} pos
  on line.cms_place_of_service_code = pos.place_of_service_code
inner join {{ DIM_CATEGORY }} category
  on line.category_id = category.category_id
inner join {{ CLAIM_ICD }} claim_icd on
  line.claim_number = claim_icd.claim_number
{% for i in range(1, 11) %}
  left join {{ DIM_DIAGNOSIS }} diagnosis_{{ i }}
    on line.diagnosis_code_{{ i }} = diagnosis_{{ i }}.diagnosis_code 
{% endfor %}
left join {{ CLAIM_CPT }} claim_cpt
  on line.claim_number = claim_cpt.claim_number
left join {{ DIM_PROCEDURE }} procedure
  on line.procedure_code = procedure.procedure_code
left join {{ SEGMENT_CPT }} segment_cpt
  on line.claim_number = segment_cpt.claim_number
  and line.segment_key = segment_cpt.segment_key

model.concert.mart_claim_matching_model_.description:
This table is in a "transition" state.

As we move from editing at the claim level to editing at the segment level, the utility of this table is in question. Will this become a "mart_segment_matching_model_comparison_mart"? Will "mart_segment_matching_model_comparison_mart" sit alongside this mart?

I'm not sure yet. However, as we transition from claims to segments, I would rather break a few reports than have incorrect insights be taken from data whose integrity I can't currently vouch for.
model.concert.mart_claim_matching_model_.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='claim_number',
    sort=['claim_number'],
    materialized='incremental',
  )
}}

-- Model Dependencies
{% set DIM_CATEGORY = ref('dim_category') %}

-- Variables
{% set CATEGORY_MIN_CONFIDENCE = var('category_min_confidence') %}

-- Query Helpers
{% set CURR_CAT_ID = "NVL(c.category_id, 'N/A')" %}
{% set NEW_CAT_ID = "NVL(n.category_id, 'N/A')" %}
{% set CURR_CAT_NAME = "NVL(c.category_name, 'N/A')" %}
{% set NEW_CAT_NAME = "NVL(n.category_name, 'N/A')" %}
{% set CAT_NOT_EQ = CURR_CAT_ID ~ ' != ' ~ NEW_CAT_ID %}
{% set CAT_EQ = CURR_CAT_ID ~ ' = ' ~ NEW_CAT_ID %}


WITH

current_line_match AS (
  SELECT * FROM {{ source('post_pay_staging', 'latest_post_pay__line__match') }}
),

current_line_match_w_taxonomy AS (
  SELECT 
    current_line_match.*,
    {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.category_name              AS category_name,
    {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.domain_name                AS domain_name,
    {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.area_name                  AS area_name
  FROM current_line_match
  INNER JOIN {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}
    ON current_line_match.category_id = {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.category_id
),

new_line_match AS (
  SELECT * FROM {{ source('post_pay_staging', 'next_post_pay__line__match') }}
),

new_line_match_w_taxonomy AS (
  SELECT 
    new_line_match.*,
    {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.category_name              AS category_name,
    {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.domain_name                AS domain_name,
    {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.area_name                  AS area_name
  FROM new_line_match
  INNER JOIN {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}
    ON new_line_match.category_id = {{ DIM_CATEGORY }}.category_id
)

SELECT
  -- Coalesce common/missing values between full join tables
  NVL(c.payer_code, n.payer_code)                                AS payer_code,
  NVL(c.claim_number, n.claim_number)                            AS claim_number,
  NVL(c.claim_line_number, n.claim_line_number)                  AS claim_line_number,
  NVL(c.procedure_code, n.procedure_code)                        AS procedure_code,
  NVL(c.service_units, n.service_units)                          AS service_units,
  {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
    NVL(c.diagnosis_code_{{ i }}, n.diagnosis_code_{{ i }})      AS diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
  {% endfor %}
  NVL(c.patient_gender, n.patient_gender)                        AS patient_gender,
  NVL(c.patient_age_band, n.patient_age_band)                    AS patient_age_band,
  NVL(c.service_provider_lab_code, n.service_provider_lab_code)  AS service_provider_lab_code,

  -- Procedure Signature
  c.procedure_signature                                            AS current_procedure_signature,
  n.procedure_signature                                             AS new_procedure_signature,
  
  -- Diagnosis Signature
  c.diagnosis_signature                                            AS current_diagnosis_signature,
  n.diagnosis_signature                                             AS new_diagnosis_signature,
  
  -- Segment Version
  c.segment_version                                                AS current_segment_version,
  n.segment_version                                                 AS new_segment_version,

  -- Segment Class
  c.segment_class                                                  AS current_segment_class,
  n.segment_class                                                   AS new_segment_class,
  
  -- Segment Name
  c.segment_name                                                   AS current_segment_name,
  n.segment_name                                                    AS new_segment_name,

  -- Segment Target Count
  c.target_count                                                   AS current_target_count,
  n.target_count                                                    AS new_target_count,

  -- Matching Model Id
  c.claim_matching_model_id                                        AS current_claim_matching_model_id,
  n.claim_matching_model_id                                         AS new_claim_matching_model_id,

  -- Category (Predicted Label) Id
  c.category_id                                                    AS current_category_id,
  n.category_id                                                     AS new_category_id,

  -- Category Probability
  c.category_probability                                           AS current_category_probability,
  n.category_probability                                            AS new_category_probability,

  -- Taxonomy
  c.category_name                                                  AS current_category_name,
  n.category_name                                                   AS new_category_name,

  c.domain_name                                                    AS current_domain_name,
  n.domain_name                                                     AS new_domain_name,

  c.area_name                                                      AS current_area_name,
  n.area_name                                                       AS new_area_name,

  -- Punted Indicators
  CASE
    WHEN c.category_probability < {{ CATEGORY_MIN_CONFIDENCE }}
      THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END                                                                 AS is_current_category_punted,
  CASE
    WHEN n.category_probability < {{ CATEGORY_MIN_CONFIDENCE }}
      THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END                                                                 AS is_new_category_punted,
  
  -- Category Difference Indicator
  CASE
    WHEN {{ CAT_NOT_EQ }}
      THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END                                                                 AS is_different_category,

  -- Category Transition
  CASE
    WHEN {{ CAT_NOT_EQ }}
      THEN {{ CURR_CAT_NAME }} || ' --> ' || {{ NEW_CAT_NAME }}
    ELSE 'No Change'
  END                                                                 AS category_transition,

  -- Probability Difference
  CASE
    WHEN {{ CAT_EQ }}
      THEN n.category_probability - c.category_probability
    ELSE null
  END                                                                 AS category_probability_difference
FROM current_line_match_w_taxonomy c
FULL JOIN new_line_match_w_taxonomy n ON
  c.claim_number = n.claim_number AND
  c.claim_line_number = n.claim_line_number
{# ignore on incremental runs #}
{% if is_incremental() %}
  WHERE TRUE IS FALSE
{% endif %}

claim_number.name: claim_number
claim_number.description: Claim number to uniquely identify the claim

date_of_transaction.description: Date that the transaction was originally sent to the API

requested_at_et.description: The exact date and time that the request was received by the API, converted to Eastern Time

responded_at_et.name: responded_at_et
responded_at_et.description: The exact date and time that the response was sent by the API, converted to Eastern Time

status_code.name: status_code
status_code.description: The status code returned by the API in response to the request

date_of_service.name: date_of_service
date_of_service.description: Minimum date of service across all lines on the claim

request_id.name: request_id

     + 
    
    p1.generated_number * power(2, 1)
     + 
    
    p2.generated_number * power(2, 2)
     + 
    
    p3.generated_number * power(2, 3)
     + 
    
    p4.generated_number * power(2, 4)
    
    
    + 1
    as generated_number

    from

    
    p as p0
     cross join 
    
    p as p1
     cross join

    p as p4

    order by generated_number


),

model.concert.dim_procedure.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='all',
    sort=['procedure_code'],
    tags=['ppp_dependency']
  )
}}

{% set default_row_keys = var('default_row_keys') %}
{% set benchmark_percentiles = var('benchmark_percentiles') %}

{% set is_genetic_procedure %}
  distinct_code_scope.genetic_scope = 'genetic'
{% endset %}

{% set is_infectious_disease_procedure %}
  distinct_code_scope.infectious_disease_scope = 'infectious_disease'
{% endset %}

{% set description_logic_medium %}
    coalesce(active_code_info.description_medium, concert_cpt_code_references.description_medium, 'Unknown')
{% endset %}

{% set description_logic_long %}
    coalesce(active_code_info.description_long, concert_cpt_code_references.description_long, 'Unknown')
{% endset %}

with

procedure_code_scope_dim as ( 
  select * from {{ ref('dim_procedure_code_scopes') }}
),

seed_code_crosswalk as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_code_crosswalk') }}
),

seed_ceapi_procedure_code as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_ceapi_procedure_codes') }}
),

concert_cpt_code_references as(
  select * from{{ref('stg_concert_db__cpt_code_references')}}
),

concert_cpt_code as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__cpt_codes') }}
),

benchmarked_procedure as (
  select * from {{ ref('procedure__benchmarked') }}
),

category as (
  select * from {{ ref('dim_category') }}
),

post_pay_line_code as (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT procedure_code
    FROM {{ source('post_pay_sources', 'post_pay_payers_claims_lines') }}
    WHERE procedure_code IS NOT NULL
),

claim_edit_api_line_code as (
  select
    distinct procedure_code
  from {{ ref('stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines') }}
  where nullif(procedure_code, '') is not null
),

all_procedure_codes as (
  select distinct code as procedure_code from seed_code_crosswalk
  union
  select distinct procedure_code from seed_ceapi_procedure_code
  union
  select distinct code as procedure_code from concert_cpt_code
  union
  select distinct code as procedure_code from concert_cpt_code_references
  union
  select distinct procedure_code from benchmarked_procedure
  union
  select procedure_code from post_pay_line_code
  union
  select procedure_code from claim_edit_api_line_code
  union
  select code as procedure_code from procedure_code_scope_dim
),

distinct_procedure_code AS (
    SELECT
        procedure_code
    FROM all_procedure_codes
    WHERE
    {% call(key) for_delimited(default_row_keys, 'and') %}
      procedure_code != '{{ key }}'
    {% endcall %}
),

all_code_info AS (
    select
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            partition by code
            order by effective_end_date desc nulls first
        ) as row_num
    FROM procedure_code_scope_dim
),

active_code_info as (
  SELECT *
  FROM all_code_info
  WHERE row_num = 1
),

distinct_code_scope as (
  SELECT
    code as procedure_code,
    ANY_VALUE(is_genetic) as genetic_scope, 
    ANY_VALUE(is_infectious_disease) as infectious_disease_scope, 
    ANY_VALUE(is_general_lab) as general_lab_scope,
    ANY_VALUE(is_imaging) as imaging_scope,
    ANY_VALUE(is_out_of_scope) as out_of_scope_scope
  FROM procedure_code_scope_dim
  GROUP BY procedure_code
),

distinct_ceapi_code as (
  SELECT
    procedure_code,
    
    BOOL_OR(for_whitelisting) as for_api_whitelisting,
    BOOL_OR(for_segmentation) as for_api_segmentation
  FROM seed_ceapi_procedure_code
  GROUP BY 1
),

crosswalked_procedure_category as (
  select
    seed_code_crosswalk.code as procedure_code,
    category.*
  from seed_code_crosswalk
  inner join category
    on seed_code_crosswalk.cat_id = category.category_id
),

final_procedure as (
  select
    -- Procedure code
    distinct_procedure_code.procedure_code as procedure_code,
    -- Description
    {{ description_logic_long }} as procedure_description_ama_long,
    -- NOTE: this was added in order to ensure the `procedure_descriptions` columns in `post_pay_procedure__[segment | claim]__grouped` tables work
    -- (we were running into a LISTAGG errors due to the size of some of the procedure code descriptions)
    CASE 
        WHEN active_code_info.mol_path_tier_2_code IS TRUE AND STRPOS(active_code_info.description_long, ')') > 0 THEN LEFT(active_code_info.description_long, STRPOS(active_code_info.description_long, ')'))
        WHEN len({{ description_logic_long }}) <= 250 THEN {{ description_logic_long}}
        WHEN len({{ description_logic_medium }}) <= 250 THEN {{ description_logic_medium}}
        ELSE 'Description too long; Truncated for safety'
    END AS clean_procedure_description,
    -- Type
    active_code_info.mol_path_code as mol_path, 
    active_code_info.mol_path_tier_1_code as mol_path_tier_1, 
    active_code_info.mol_path_tier_2_code as mol_path_tier_2, 
    active_code_info.gsp_code as gsp, 
    active_code_info.cat_1_maaa_code as cat_1_maaa, 
    active_code_info.admin_maaa_code as admin_maaa, 
    active_code_info.ihc_code as ihc, 
    active_code_info.pla_code as pla, 
    active_code_info.allergy_code as allergy,
    -- TODO( 2024-10-04 ): remove this string version (and all references to this) in all tables (possible excluding the MARTs)
    -- API Whitelisting
    coalesce(
      distinct_ceapi_code.for_api_whitelisting,
      false
    ) as for_api_whitelisting,
    -- API Segmentation
    coalesce(
      distinct_ceapi_code.for_api_segmentation,
      false
    ) as for_api_segmentation,
    -- Genetic procedure indicator (DEPRECATED string version)
    case when {{ is_genetic_procedure }}
      then 'Is Genetic Procedure'
      else 'Not Genetic Procedure'
    end as is_genetic_procedure,
    -- Genetic procedure indicator
    {{ is_genetic_procedure }} as is_genetic,
    -- Infectious disease procedure indicator (DEPRECATED string version)
    case when {{ is_infectious_disease_procedure }}
      then 'Is Infectious Disease Procedure'
      else 'Not Infectious Disease Procedure'
    end as is_infectious_disease_procedure,
    -- Infectious disease procedure indicator
    {{ is_infectious_disease_procedure }} as is_infectious_disease,
    -- CMS fee schedule rate (0 values resolved to null by the benchmarked procedure)
    benchmarked_procedure.cms_fee_schedule_rate as procedure_cms_fee_schedule_rate,
    -- Percentile benchmarks
    {% for percentile in benchmark_percentiles %}
      -- Reusable crosswalk category conditions
      {% set use_category_condition %}
        (active_code_info.pla_code = true or active_code_info.cat_1_maaa_code = true or active_code_info.admin_maaa_code = true)
        and crosswalked_procedure_category.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate is not null
        and (
          benchmarked_procedure.cms_fee_schedule_rate is null
          or crosswalked_procedure_category.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate
            < benchmarked_procedure.cms_fee_schedule_rate
        )
      {% endset %}
      -- Reusable category justification
      {% set category_justification = "'Benchmark from category: ' || crosswalked_procedure_category.category_name" %}
      -- Concert fee schedule rate
      case
        when not {{ is_genetic_procedure }}
          then null
        when {{ use_category_condition }}
          then crosswalked_procedure_category.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate
        else coalesce(
          benchmarked_procedure.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
          crosswalked_procedure_category.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate
        )
      end as procedure_{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
      -- Actual claims data percentile amounts and percent difference for reference
      benchmarked_procedure.{{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount as procedure_{{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount,
      benchmarked_procedure.{{ percentile.alias }}_percent_difference as procedure_{{ percentile.alias }}_percent_difference,
      -- Concert fee schedule justification
      case
        when not {{ is_genetic_procedure }}
          then 'Not a genetic procedure'
        when {{ use_category_condition }}
          then {{ category_justification }}
        when benchmarked_procedure.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate is not null
          then benchmarked_procedure.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_justification
        when crosswalked_procedure_category.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate is not null
          then {{ category_justification }}
        else 'Insufficient claims data'
      end as procedure_{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_justification,
    {% endfor %}
    benchmarked_procedure.claim_volume                                        AS  procedure_claim_volume,
    active_code_info.test_name                                                   AS  test_name,
    active_code_info.lab_name                                                    AS  pla_lab,
    active_code_info.effective_start_date                                    AS  effective_start_dt,
    active_code_info.effective_end_date                                      AS  effective_end_dt
  from distinct_procedure_code
  left join active_code_info
    on distinct_procedure_code.procedure_code = active_code_info.code
  left join benchmarked_procedure
    on distinct_procedure_code.procedure_code = benchmarked_procedure.procedure_code
  left join crosswalked_procedure_category
    on distinct_procedure_code.procedure_code = crosswalked_procedure_category.procedure_code
  left join concert_cpt_code_references
    on distinct_procedure_code.procedure_code = concert_cpt_code_references.code
  left join distinct_code_scope
    on distinct_procedure_code.procedure_code = distinct_code_scope.procedure_code
  left join distinct_ceapi_code
    on distinct_procedure_code.procedure_code = distinct_ceapi_code.procedure_code
),

default_procedure as (
  {% call(key) for_delimited(default_row_keys, 'union all') %}
    select {{ default_procedure_columns(key) }}
  {% endcall %}
),

unioned as (
  select * from final_procedure
  union all
  select * from default_procedure
),

casted_types AS (
    SELECT
        procedure_code
        ,procedure_description_ama_long
        ,clean_procedure_description
        ,mol_path
        ,mol_path_tier_1
        ,mol_path_tier_2
        ,gsp
        ,cat_1_maaa
        ,admin_maaa
        ,ihc
        ,pla
        ,allergy
        ,for_api_whitelisting
        ,for_api_segmentation
        ,is_genetic_procedure
        ,is_genetic
        ,is_infectious_disease_procedure
        ,is_infectious_disease
        ,procedure_cms_fee_schedule_rate
        ,procedure_lower_quartile_allowed_amount
        ,procedure_lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_justification
        ,procedure_lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate
        ,procedure_lower_quartile_percent_difference
        ,procedure_median_allowed_amount
        ,procedure_median_concert_fee_schedule_justification
        ,procedure_median_concert_fee_schedule_rate
        ,procedure_median_percent_difference
        ,effective_end_dt
        ,effective_start_dt
        ,pla_lab
        ,procedure_claim_volume
        ,test_name
        -- TODO( 2023-09-13 ): there are now 4 lines (these 2, and their
        -- complements above) of unnecessary code that are an artifact of
        -- unioning with the default_row_keys (text types). Figure out a way to avoid this
    FROM unioned
)

SELECT * FROM casted_types
