model.concert.dim_claim_edit_api_segment.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='claim_number',
    sort=['claim_number'],
  )
}}

with

segment_edit_api_line as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines') }}
),

segment_edit_api_icd as (
  select * from {{ ref('claim_edit_api_icd__segment__grouped') }}
),

segment_edit_api_cpt as (
  select * from {{ ref('claim_edit_api_cpt__segment__grouped') }}
),

patient_age_band_group AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('dim_age_band') }}
),

place_of_service as (
  select * from {{ ref('dim_place_of_service') }}
),

segment as (
  select
    segment_key,
    
    ANY_VALUE(claim_number)                                 AS claim_number,
    ANY_VALUE(coalesce(request_id, 'Unknown'))              AS request_id,
    ANY_VALUE(payer_id)                                     AS payer_id,
    {% for provider in ['billing', 'rendering'] %}
      {% for type in ['ein', 'npi', 'name'] %}
        ANY_VALUE({{ provider }}_{{ type }})                AS {{ provider }}_provider_{{ type }},
      {% endfor %}
    {% endfor %}
    ANY_VALUE(lob)                                          AS line_of_business,
    ANY_VALUE(standard_line_of_business)                    AS standard_line_of_business,
    ANY_VALUE(network_status)                               AS network_status,
    ANY_VALUE(place_of_service)                             AS place_of_service,
    ANY_VALUE(standard_place_of_service)                    AS standard_place_of_service,
    ANY_VALUE({{ standardize_patient_gender( 'gender' ) }}) AS patient_gender,
    ANY_VALUE(icd_version)                                  AS icd_version,
    ANY_VALUE(member_age_band)                              AS patient_age_band,
    ANY_VALUE(service_provider_lab_code)                    AS service_provider_lab_code
  from segment_edit_api_line
  group by 1
),

final as (
  select
    -- Primary Key
    segment.segment_key,
    -- Degenerate Dimensions
    segment.claim_number,

    request_id,
    patient_age_band,
    service_provider_lab_code,
    coalesce(segment.payer_id, 'Unspecified') as payer_id,
    {% for provider in ['billing', 'rendering'] %}
      {% for type in ['ein', 'npi', 'name'] %}
        coalesce(
          segment.{{ provider }}_provider_{{ type }},
          'Unspecified'
        ) as {{ provider }}_provider_{{ type }},
      {% endfor %}
    {% endfor %}
    coalesce(segment.line_of_business, 'Unspecified') as line_of_business,
    coalesce(segment.standard_line_of_business, 'unknown') as standard_line_of_business,
    replace(coalesce(segment.network_status, 'X'), 'U', 'X') as network_status,
    place_of_service.place_of_service_code as place_of_service,
    -- Prefer standard value from API if available
    coalesce(
      segment.standard_place_of_service,
      'unknown'
    ) as standard_place_of_service,
    segment.patient_gender,
    coalesce(segment.icd_version, 10) AS icd_version,
    coalesce(segment_edit_api_icd.icd_signature, 'Unspecified') as icd_signature,
    coalesce(segment_edit_api_cpt.cpt_signature, 'Unspecified') as cpt_signature
  from segment
  -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
  left join segment_edit_api_icd on
    segment.claim_number = segment_edit_api_icd.claim_number and
    segment.segment_key = segment_edit_api_icd.segment_key
  -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
  left join segment_edit_api_cpt on
    segment.claim_number = segment_edit_api_cpt.claim_number and
    segment.segment_key = segment_edit_api_cpt.segment_key
  left join patient_age_band_group
    on segment.patient_age_band = patient_age_band_group.age_band
  left join place_of_service
    on coalesce(segment.place_of_service, 'Unspecifed') = place_of_service.place_of_service_code
)

select * from final

{{

-- Variables
{% set EDIT_SOURCES = var('ceapi_edit_sources') %}

-- Model Dependencies
{% set BASE_LINE = ref('base_claim_edit_api_line') %}
{% set TOP_RANKED_EDIT = ref('claim_edit_api__line__top_ranked_edit') %}

with

final as (
  select
    line.*,

    edit.audit_edit_short_code                          as top_edit_code,
    edit.audit_edit_disposition                         as top_edit_disposition,
    edit.audit_edit_rationale                           as top_edit_rationale,

    edit.audit_edit_remark_description                  as top_edit_remark_description,
    edit.audit_edit_criteria_code                       as top_edit_parent_criteria_code,

    -- Top edits from each edit source (preferred naming convention)
    {% for edit_source in EDIT_SOURCES %}
      {% set prefix = edit_source.name ~ '_edit' %}
      edit.{{ prefix }}_key                             as {{ prefix }}_key,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_id                              as {{ prefix }}_id,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_short_code                      as {{ prefix }}_short_code,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_version                         as {{ prefix }}_version,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_disposition                     as {{ prefix }}_disposition,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_rationale                       as {{ prefix }}_rationale,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_remark_code                     as {{ prefix }}_remark_code,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_remark_description              as {{ prefix }}_remark_description,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_criteria_code                   as {{ prefix }}_criteria_code,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_edited_billed_amount            as {{ prefix }}_edited_billed_amount,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_policy_code                     as {{ prefix }}_policy_code,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_policy_version                  as {{ prefix }}_policy_version,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_policy_name                     as {{ prefix }}_policy_name,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_policy_id                       as {{ prefix }}_policy_id,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_policy_type                     as {{ prefix }}_policy_type,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_criteria_version                as {{ prefix }}_criteria_version,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_criteria_name                   as {{ prefix }}_criteria_name,
      edit.{{ prefix }}_criteria_id                     as {{ prefix }}_criteria_id,
    {% endfor %}
    edit.is_concert_edit_different,
    edit.is_customer_edit_different,
    edit.concert_edit_change,
    edit.customer_edit_change,
    edit.is_concert_disposition_different,
    edit.is_customer_disposition_different,

  from {{ BASE_LINE }} line
  left join {{ TOP_RANKED_EDIT }} edit on
    line.claim_number = edit.claim_number and
    line.claim_line_number = edit.claim_line_number and 
    line.request_id = edit.request_id
)

model.concert.bdg_claim_edit_criteria.name: bdg_claim_edit_criteria
model.concert.bdg_claim_edit_criteria.description: Bridge table that computes the relationship between a claim edit and its parent criteria version(s).
model.concert.bdg_claim_edit_criteria.compiled_code:
with 

parent AS (
  SELECT * FROM "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__parent_criteria"
),

criteria as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__policy_criteria"
),

claim_edit as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__claim_edits"
),

final as (
  select
    claim_edit.claim_edit_key AS claim_edit_key,
    claim_edit.id             AS claim_edit_id,
    claim_edit.version        AS claim_edit_version,
    criteria.id               AS criteria_id,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        claim_edit.claim_edit_key,
        criteria.code
      order by
        
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 desc,
        
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 desc
    ) as criteria_rank
  from parent
  inner join criteria
    on parent.code = criteria.code
  inner join claim_edit
  on (
    
    case 
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_start, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then  1
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_start, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then -1
      else
        case
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_start, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then  1
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_start, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then -1
          else 0
        end
    end
 in (1, 0) 
    and (
      claim_edit.criteria_version_end is null
        or 
    case 
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_end, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then  1
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_end, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then -1
      else
        case
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_end, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then  1
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(claim_edit.criteria_version_end, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then -1
          else 0
        end
    end
 in (-1, 0) 
    )
    and parent.code = claim_edit.parent_criteria_code
    and criteria.code = claim_edit.parent_criteria_code
  )
)

      'Unspecified'
    )                             AS claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    {{
      dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
        "coalesce(subscription.claim_edit_id, 'Unspecified')",
        "coalesce(subscription.claim_edit_version, 1)"
      ])
    }}                            AS claim_edit_key,
    subscription.effective_start  AS effective_start_date,
    subscription.effective_end    AS effective_end_date,
    CASE
      WHEN
          subscriber.default_config_id != 'Unspecified' AND
          subscription.config_id = subscriber.default_config_id
        THEN 'Unknown'
      ELSE COALESCE(subscription.config_id, 'Unknown')
    END                           AS payer_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN subscription.participation = 'All' THEN 'All' 
      WHEN subscription.participation = 'Par' THEN 'In-Network'
      WHEN subscription.participation = 'NonPar' THEN 'Out-of-Network'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END                           AS participation
  from subscription
  inner join subscriber
    on subscription.claim_edit_customer_code = subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code
),

final as (
  select
    claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    claim_edit_key,
    payer_id,
    
    MAX(effective_start_date)     AS effective_start_date,
    any_value(effective_end_date) AS effective_end_date,
    any_value(participation)      AS participation
  from multiples
  group by 1, 2, 3
)

model.concert.dim_diagnosis.name: dim_diagnosis
model.concert.dim_diagnosis.description: Dimensional table for diagnosis codes. The `diagnosis_code` column represents every ICD-9 and ICD-10 that appear in our genepayer claims, claim edit API claims, and internal reference sources. Every record has an `icd10_code` column that can be used to map ICD-9 codes to their respective ICD-10 code.

diagnosis_description.name: diagnosis_description
diagnosis_description.description: Human readable description of the diagnosis code

icd10_code.name: icd10_code
icd10_code.description: The ICD-10 code associated with the diagnosis code (used for mapping purposes)

model.concert.dim_diagnosis.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='all',
    sort=['diagnosis_code'],
    tags=['ppp_dependency']
  )
}}

{% set default_row_keys = var('default_row_keys') %}

with

icd10_code as (
  select 
    REPLACE(code, '.', '') AS code,
    description
  from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__icd10_codes') }}
),

icd_translation as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_common__icd_translation') }}
),

post_pay_code AS (
    {% call(i) for_delimited(range(1, 11), 'union all') %}
        SELECT
            DISTINCT diagnosis_code_{{ i }} AS diagnosis_code
        FROM {{ source('post_pay_sources', 'post_pay_payers_claims_lines') }}
        WHERE diagnosis_code_{{ i }} IS NOT NULL
    {% endcall %}
),

claim_edit_api_code as (
  {% call(i) for_delimited(range(1, 11), 'union all') %}
    select
      distinct replace(icd_{{ i }}, '.', '') as diagnosis_code
    from {{ ref('stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines') }}
    where nullif(icd_{{ i }}, '') is not null
  {% endcall %}
),

distinct_diagnosis_code as (
  select
    distinct code as diagnosis_code
  from icd10_code
  where nullif(code, '') is not null
  
  union
  
  select
    distinct icd9 as diagnosis_code
  from icd_translation
  where nullif(icd9, '') is not null
  
  union
  
  select
    diagnosis_code
  from post_pay_code
  
  union
  
  select
    diagnosis_code
  from claim_edit_api_code
  WHERE
      diagnosis_code NOT IN (
    {% call(key) for_delimited(default_row_keys, ',') %}
        '{{ key }}'
    {% endcall %}
    )
),

icd9_code as (
  select
    icd_translation.icd9,
    icd_translation.icd10,
    icd10_code.description
  from icd_translation
  left join icd10_code
    on icd_translation.icd10 = icd10_code.code
),

final_diagnosis as (
  select
    distinct_diagnosis_code.diagnosis_code,
    case
      when icd10_code.code is not null
        then 'ICD-10'
      when icd9_code.icd9 is not null
        then 'ICD-9'
      else 'Unknown'
    end as diagnosis_version,
    case
      when icd10_code.code is not null
        then coalesce(icd10_code.description, 'Unspecified')
      when icd9_code.icd9 is not null
        then coalesce(icd9_code.description, 'Unspecified')
      else 'Unknown'
    end as diagnosis_description,
    case
      when icd10_code.code is not null
        then icd10_code.code
      when icd9_code.icd9 is not null
        then coalesce(icd9_code.icd10, 'Unspecified')
      else 'Unknown'
    end as icd10_code
  from distinct_diagnosis_code
  left join icd10_code
    on distinct_diagnosis_code.diagnosis_code = icd10_code.code
  left join icd9_code
    on icd10_code.code is null and
      distinct_diagnosis_code.diagnosis_code = icd9_code.icd9
),

default_diagnosis as (
  {% call(key) for_delimited(default_row_keys, 'union all') %}
    select {{ default_diagnosis_columns(key) }}
  {% endcall %}
),

final as (
  select * from final_diagnosis
  union
  select * from default_diagnosis
)

select * from final

model.concert.bdg_policy_policy_criteria.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='all',
    sort=['criteria_id'],
  )
}}

with

criteria as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__policy_criteria') }}
),

),

policy_criteria as (
  select
    policy.id           AS policy_id,
    policy.content_type AS content_type,
    policy.code         AS policy_code,
    policy.version      AS policy_version,
    criteria.id         AS criteria_id,
    criteria.code       AS criteria_code,
    criteria.version    AS criteria_version,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        policy.code,        
        policy.version,
        criteria.code
      order by
        policy.code desc,
        {{ semver_at_idx('policy.version', 1) }} desc,
        {{ semver_at_idx('policy.version', 2) }} desc,
        criteria.code desc,
        {{ semver_at_idx('criteria.version', 1) }} desc,
        {{ semver_at_idx('criteria.version', 2) }} desc
    ) as row_num 
  from criteria
  inner join policy
  on 
    {{ compare_semver('policy.version', 'criteria.policy_version_start') }} in (1, 0)
    and (
      criteria.policy_version_end is null 
        or {{ compare_semver('policy.version', 'criteria.policy_version_end') }} in (-1, 0)
    )
    and policy.code = criteria.parent_policy_code

model.concert.bdg_policy_policy_criteria.compiled_code:
with

criteria as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__policy_criteria"
),

policy as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__policies"
),

policy_criteria as (
  select
    policy.id           AS policy_id,
    policy.content_type AS content_type,
    policy.code         AS policy_code,
    policy.version      AS policy_version,
    criteria.id         AS criteria_id,
    criteria.code       AS criteria_code,
    criteria.version    AS criteria_version,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        policy.code,        
        policy.version,
        criteria.code
      order by
        policy.code desc,
        
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 desc,
        
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 desc,
        criteria.code desc,
        
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 desc,
        
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 desc
    ) as row_num 
  from criteria
  inner join policy
  on 
    
    case 
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_start, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then  1
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_start, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then -1
      else
        case
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_start, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then  1
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_start, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then -1
          else 0
        end
    end
 in (1, 0)
    and (
      criteria.policy_version_end is null 
        or 
    case 
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_end, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then  1
      when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 1), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_end, '.', 1), '0')::int
 then -1
      else
        case
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 > 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_end, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then  1
          when 
  coalesce(split_part(policy.version, '.', 2), '0')::int
 < 
  coalesce(split_part(criteria.policy_version_end, '.', 2), '0')::int
 then -1
          else 0
        end
    end
 in (-1, 0)
    )
    and policy.code = criteria.parent_policy_code
),

final as (
  select * from policy_criteria
)

select * from final

model.concert.dim_claim_edit.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='all',
    sort=['claim_edit_key'],
    tags=['ppp_dependency']
  )
}}

{% set default_row_keys = var('default_row_keys') %}
{% set static_claim_edits = var('static_claim_edits') %}
{% set edit_scopes = var('edit_scopes') %}
{% set parsed_values = [
  { 'key': 'cptCodes', 'label': 'cpt_codes' },
  { 'key': 'andCptCodes', 'label': 'and_cpt_codes' },
  { 'key': 'icdCodes', 'label': 'icd_codes' },
  { 'key': 'andIcdCodes', 'label': 'and_icd_codes' },
  { 'key': 'orIcdCodes', 'label': 'or_icd_codes' },
  { 'key': 'categories', 'label': 'categories' },
  { 'key': 'labCodes', 'label': 'lab_codes' },
  { 'key': 'gender', 'label': 'gender' },
  { 'key': 'minAge', 'label': 'min_age' },
  { 'key': 'genderMinAge', 'label': 'gender_min_age' },
  { 'key': 'maxAge', 'label': 'max_age' },
  { 'key': 'genderMaxAge', 'label': 'gender_max_age' },
  { 'key': 'placesOfService', 'label': 'place_of_service' },
] %}
{% set claim_edit_key = dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
  'claim_edit.id',
  'claim_edit.version',
]) %}

with

claim_edit as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__claim_edits') }}
),

claim_edit_remark as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__claim_edit_remarks') }}
),

claim_edit_strategy as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__claim_edit_strategies') }}
),

claim_edit_subscription as (
  select * from {{ ref('bdg_claim_edit_subscription') }}
),

claim_edit_policy_criteria as (
  select * from {{ ref('bdg_claim_edit_criteria') }}
),

health_plan_policy_subscription as (
  select * from {{ ref('bdg_health_plan_policy_subscription') }}
),

policy_policy_criteria as (
  select * from {{ ref('bdg_policy_policy_criteria') }}
),

{% for edit_scope in (edit_scopes | reject('eq', 'medicare')) %}
  {{ edit_scope }}_claim_edit as (
    select
      distinct claim_edit_policy_criteria.claim_edit_key
    from claim_edit_policy_criteria
    inner join policy_policy_criteria
      on claim_edit_policy_criteria.criteria_id = policy_policy_criteria.criteria_id
    inner join health_plan_policy_subscription
      on policy_policy_criteria.policy_id
        = health_plan_policy_subscription.policy_id
    where 
      health_plan_policy_subscription.content_type = '{{ edit_scope }}'
  ),
{% endfor %}

medicare_claim_edit as (
  select
    distinct claim_edit_key
  from claim_edit_subscription
  where claim_edit_subscriber_code = 'MEDICARE'
),

final_claim_edit as (
  select
    {{ claim_edit_key }} as claim_edit_key,
    claim_edit.id as claim_edit_id,
    claim_edit.short_code as claim_edit_short_code,
    claim_edit.version as claim_edit_version,
    claim_edit.status as claim_edit_status,
    claim_edit.parent_criteria_code as claim_edit_parent_criteria_code,
    (
      regexp_replace(claim_edit.criteria_version_start, '\.[^.]*$', '') 
    ) as claim_edit_criteria_version_start,
    (
      regexp_replace(coalesce(claim_edit.criteria_version_end, 'Unspecified'), '\.[^.]*$', '') 
    ) as claim_edit_criteria_version_end,
    'Subscribable' as claim_edit_type,
    claim_edit.date_of_service_start as claim_edit_date_of_service_start_date,
    claim_edit.date_of_service_end as claim_edit_date_of_service_end_date,
    claim_edit.date_modified AS date_modified,
    coalesce(claim_edit.rationale, 'Unspecified') as claim_edit_rationale,
    claim_edit.disposition as claim_edit_disposition,
    coalesce(claim_edit.source_text, 'Unspecified') as claim_edit_source_text,
    coalesce(claim_edit.notes, 'Unspecified') as claim_edit_notes,
    claim_edit_remark.code as claim_edit_remark_code,
    coalesce(claim_edit_remark.description, 'Unspecified') as claim_edit_remark_description,
    claim_edit_remark.rank as claim_edit_remark_rank,
    claim_edit_strategy.code as claim_edit_strategy_code,
    claim_edit_strategy.level as claim_edit_strategy_level,
    claim_edit_strategy.rank as claim_edit_strategy_rank,
    coalesce(claim_edit_strategy.notes, 'Unspecified') as claim_edit_strategy_notes,
    -- Computed
    {% for edit_scope in edit_scopes %}
      {% set label = (edit_scope | replace("_", " ") | title) %}
      case
        when {{ edit_scope }}_claim_edit.claim_edit_key is not null
          then 'Is {{ label }} Edit'
        else 'Not {{ label }} Edit'
      end as is_{{ edit_scope }}_claim_edit,
    {% endfor %}
    -- NOTE( 2024-10-04 ): I don't know why, but having this logic in the same for loop as above causes a UNION error below. whatever...
    {% for edit_scope in edit_scopes %}
      case
        when {{ edit_scope }}_claim_edit.claim_edit_key is not null
          then TRUE
        else FALSE
      end as is_{{ edit_scope }},
    {% endfor %}
    row_number() over (
      order by
        claim_edit_strategy.level asc nulls last,
        claim_edit_remark.rank asc nulls last,
        claim_edit_strategy.rank asc nulls last
    ) as claim_edit_rank,
    case
      when
        disposition = 'AUTO_APPROVE_CLAIM'
        or disposition = 'AUTO_APPROVE_LINE'
        then 'approve'
      else 'deny'
    end as claim_edit_short_disposition,
    {% call(value) for_delimited(parsed_values, ',') %}
      coalesce(
        {{ safe_json_extract('claim_edit.strategy_values', [value.key]) }},
        'Not Applicable'
      ) as claim_edit_{{ value.label }}
    {% endcall %}
  from claim_edit
  inner join claim_edit_remark
    on claim_edit.remark_code = claim_edit_remark.code
  inner join claim_edit_strategy
    on claim_edit.strategy_code = claim_edit_strategy.code
  {% for edit_scope in edit_scopes %}
    left join {{ edit_scope }}_claim_edit
      on {{ claim_edit_key }} = {{ edit_scope }}_claim_edit.claim_edit_key
  {% endfor %}
),

-- Build static edits with version 0 (used by claim edit api) and version 1 (acts as default version)
static_claim_edit as (
  {% call(edit) for_delimited(static_claim_edits, 'union all') %}
    {% call(version) for_delimited(['0', '1'], 'union all') %}
      SELECT
        {{
          dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
            "'" ~ edit.id ~ "'",
            version,   
          ])
        }} as claim_edit_key,
        '{{ edit.id }}' as claim_edit_id,
        '{{ edit.id }}' as claim_edit_short_code,
        {{ version }} as claim_edit_version,
        'Published' as claim_edit_status,
        'Static' as claim_edit_type,
        'Unspecified' as claim_edit_parent_criteria_code,
        '1.0.0' as claim_edit_criteria_version_start,
        'Unspecified' as claim_edit_criteria_version_end,
        null::timestamp as claim_edit_date_of_service_start_date,
        null::timestamp as claim_edit_date_of_service_end_date,
        null::timestamp as date_modified,
        '{{ edit.rationale }}' as claim_edit_rationale,
        'NoEdit' as claim_edit_disposition,
        'Unspecified' as claim_edit_source_text,
        '{{ edit.notes }}' as claim_edit_notes,
        'CG00' as claim_edit_remark_code,
        'No action recommended' as claim_edit_remark_description,
        null::int as claim_edit_remark_rank,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_strategy_code,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_strategy_level,
        null::int as claim_edit_strategy_rank,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_strategy_notes,
        'Not Medical Policy Edit' as is_medical_policy_claim_edit,
        'Not Reimbursement Policy Edit' as is_reimbursement_policy_claim_edit,
        'Not Medicare Edit' as is_medicare_claim_edit,
        FALSE AS is_medicare,
        FALSE AS is_medical_policy,
        FALSE AS is_reimbursement_policy,
        null::int as claim_edit_rank,
        'NoEdit' as claim_edit_short_disposition,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_cpt_codes,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_and_cpt_codes,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_icd_codes,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_and_icd_codes,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_or_icd_codes,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_categories,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_lab_codes,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_gender,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_min_age,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_max_age,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_gender_min_age,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_gender_max_age,
        'Not Applicable' as claim_edit_place_of_service
    {% endcall %}
  {% endcall %}
),

default_claim_edit as (
  {% call(key) for_delimited(default_row_keys, 'union all') %}
    select {{ default_claim_edit_columns(key) }}
  {% endcall %}
),

final as (
  select * from final_claim_edit
  union all
  select * from static_claim_edit
  union all
  select * from default_claim_edit
)

select * from final

with 

criteria as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__policy_criteria"

    select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__policy_criteria_coverage_gtu"
),
criteria_coverage_gtu as (
    select
      criteria.id                       AS criteria_id,
      criteria.code                     AS criteria_code, 
      criteria.version                  AS criteria_version, 
      criteria.parent_policy_code       AS criteria_parent_policy_code,

model.concert.dim_category.compiled_code:
with

category as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__categories"
),

domain as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."dim_domain"
),

benchmarked_category_procedure as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."category_procedure__benchmarked"
),

category_benchmark as (
  select
    category_id,
    mode_procedure_signature,

    
      sum(lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate) as lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    
      sum(median_concert_fee_schedule_rate) as median_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    
    any_value(gtu_volume) as mode_procedure_signature_gtu_volume
  from benchmarked_category_procedure
  group by 1, 2
),

final_category as (
  select
    category.id as category_id,
    coalesce(category.name, 'Unspecified') as category_name,
    category.type as category_type,
    category.content_state as category_content_state,
    coalesce(category.indication, 'Unspecified') as category_indication,
    coalesce(category_benchmark.mode_procedure_signature, 'Unknown') as mode_procedure_signature,
    category_benchmark.mode_procedure_signature_gtu_volume,
    
      category_benchmark.lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    
      category_benchmark.median_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    
    coalesce(domain.domain_id, 'Unknown') as domain_id,
    coalesce(domain.domain_name, 'Unknown') as domain_name,
    coalesce(domain.domain_content_state, 'Unknown') as domain_content_state,
    coalesce(domain.area_id, 'Unknown') as area_id,
    coalesce(domain.area_name, 'Unknown') as area_name
  from category
  inner join domain
    on coalesce(category.domain_id, 'Unspecified') = domain.domain_id
  left join category_benchmark
    on category.id = category_benchmark.category_id
),

default_category as (
  
    select

The bridge table includes the policy code purely for query performance reasons. The `policy_code` cannot be used to join to a policy directly. For joining, the `policy_id` must be used.

health_plan_code.name: health_plan_code
health_plan_code.description: Unique code for the health plan

policy_code.name: policy_code
policy_code.description: Policy code associated with the policy (used for quicker lookups)

effective_start_date.name: effective_start_date
effective_start_date.description: Effective start date for the policy subscription

effective_end_date.name: effective_end_date
effective_end_date.description: Effective end date for the policy subscription

model.concert.bdg_health_plan_policy_sub.compiled_code:
with

subscription as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__payer_policy_subscriptions"
),

policy as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."dim_policy"
),

final as (
  select
    coalesce(subscription.payer_code, 'Unknown') AS health_plan_code,
    coalesce(subscription.url, 'Unknown')        AS url,
    coalesce(policy.policy_id, 'Unknown')        AS policy_id,
    coalesce(policy.policy_code, 'Unknown')      AS policy_code,
    policy.content_type                          AS content_type,
    subscription.effective_start                 AS effective_start_date,
    subscription.effective_end                   AS effective_end_date
  from subscription
  left join policy
    on coalesce(subscription.policy_id, 'Unspecified')
      = policy.policy_id
)

select * from final

model.concert.fct_claim_edit_api_summary.compiled_code:
with

summary as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_orders_db__claim_edit_api_summary_by_labs"
),

customer as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."dim_customer"
),

claim_edit_subscriber as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."dim_claim_edit_subscriber"
),

lab as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."dim_lab"
),

final as (
  select
    -- Dimensions
    coalesce(
      lab.lab_code,
      'Unknown'
    ) as lab_code,
    coalesce(
      summary.customer_code,
      'Unspecified'
    ) as customer_code,
    coalesce(
      claim_edit_subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
      summary.customer_code,
      'Unknown'
    ) as claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    coalesce(summary.payer_id, 'Unspecified') as payer_id,
    summary.requested_at as date_of_transaction,
    -- Facts
    summary.claims as claim_volume,
    summary.claims_edited as edited_claim_volume,
    summary.lines as line_volume,
    summary.lines_edited as edited_line_volume,
    summary.billed as billed_amount,
    summary.billed_edited as edited_billed_amount
  from summary
  left join customer
    on summary.customer_code = customer.customer_code
  left join claim_edit_subscriber
    on customer.customer_code = claim_edit_subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code
  left join lab
    on coalesce(summary.service_provider_lab_code, 'Unspecified') = lab.lab_code
)

select * from final

model.concert.dim_lab_synonym.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='all',
    sort=['synonym_type', 'lab_synonym'],
  )
}}

{% set default_row_keys = var('default_row_keys') %}

with

lab as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__labs') }}
),

lab_license as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__lab_licenses') }}
),

numbers as (
  {{ dbt_utils.generate_series(upper_bound=100) }}
),

unnested_lab_synonym as (
  select
    date_created as date_created,
    lab.code as lab_code,
    split_part(lab.aliases, '|', numbers.generated_number::INT) as lab_synonym
  from lab
  cross join numbers
  where split_part(lab.aliases, '|', numbers.generated_number::int) is not null
    and split_part(lab.aliases, '|', numbers.generated_number::int) != ''
),

final_lab_license as (
  select
    lab_code,
    number::varchar(1000) as lab_synonym,
    type as synonym_type,
    row_number() over (
      partition by lab_synonym
      order by date_created desc
    ) as row_num
  from lab_license
  where type in ('EIN', 'NPI')
),

final_lab_synonym as (
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym::varchar(1000) as lab_synonym,
    'NAME' as synonym_type
  from unnested_lab_synonym
),

default_lab_synonym as (
  {% call(key) for_delimited(default_row_keys, 'union all') %}
    select {{ default_lab_synonym_columns(key) }}
  {% endcall %}
),

final as (
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym,
    synonym_type
  from final_lab_license
  where row_num = 1
  union all
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym,
    synonym_type
  from final_lab_synonym
  union all
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym,
    synonym_type
  from default_lab_synonym
)

select * from final
model.concert.dim_lab_synonym.compiled_code:
with

lab as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__labs"
),

lab_license as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_concert_db__lab_licenses"
),

numbers as (
  

    

    with p as (
        select 0 as generated_number union all select 1
    ), unioned as (

    select

    
    p0.generated_number * power(2, 0)
     + 
    
    p1.generated_number * power(2, 1)
     + 
    
    p2.generated_number * power(2, 2)
     + 
    
    p3.generated_number * power(2, 3)
     + 
    
    p4.generated_number * power(2, 4)
     + 
    
    p5.generated_number * power(2, 5)
     + 
    
    p6.generated_number * power(2, 6)
    
    
    + 1
    as generated_number

    from

    
    p as p0
     cross join 
    
    p as p1
     cross join 
    
    p as p2
     cross join 
    
    p as p3
     cross join 
    
    p as p4
     cross join 
    
    p as p5
     cross join 
    
    p as p6
    
    

    )

    select *
    from unioned
    where generated_number <= 100
    order by generated_number


),

unnested_lab_synonym as (
  select
    date_created as date_created,
    lab.code as lab_code,
    split_part(lab.aliases, '|', numbers.generated_number::INT) as lab_synonym
  from lab
  cross join numbers
  where split_part(lab.aliases, '|', numbers.generated_number::int) is not null
    and split_part(lab.aliases, '|', numbers.generated_number::int) != ''
),

final_lab_license as (
  select
    lab_code,
    number::varchar(1000) as lab_synonym,
    type as synonym_type,
    row_number() over (
      partition by lab_synonym
      order by date_created desc
    ) as row_num
  from lab_license
  where type in ('EIN', 'NPI')
),

final_lab_synonym as (
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym::varchar(1000) as lab_synonym,
    'NAME' as synonym_type
  from unnested_lab_synonym
),

default_lab_synonym as (
  
    select 
  'Unknown' as lab_code,
  'Unknown' as lab_synonym,
  'Unknown' as synonym_type

  union all
    select 
  'Unspecified' as lab_code,
  'Unspecified' as lab_synonym,
  'Unspecified' as synonym_type

  union all
    select 
  'Not Applicable' as lab_code,
  'Not Applicable' as lab_synonym,
  'Not Applicable' as synonym_type

  
),

final as (
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym,
    synonym_type
  from final_lab_license
  where row_num = 1
  union all
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym,
    synonym_type
  from final_lab_synonym
  union all
  select
    lab_code,
    lab_synonym,
    synonym_type
  from default_lab_synonym
)

select * from final

model.concert.bdg_health_plan_policy_cri.name: bdg_health_plan_policy_criteria_claim_edit
model.concert.bdg_health_plan_policy_cri.compiled_code:
WITH 

main_relationships AS (
  SELECT
    A.health_plan_code AS health_plan_code,
    A.policy_id        AS policy_id,
    B.criteria_id      AS criteria_id,
    B.row_num          AS criteria_rank,
    C.claim_edit_key   AS claim_edit_key
  FROM "dw"."dw_common"."bdg_health_plan_policy_subscription" A
  INNER JOIN "dw"."dw_common"."bdg_policy_policy_criteria" B
    ON A.policy_id = B.policy_id
  INNER JOIN "dw"."dw_common"."bdg_claim_edit_criteria" C
    ON B.criteria_id = C.criteria_id
),

filler_relationships AS (
  
    select 
  'Unknown' AS health_plan_code,
  'Unknown' AS policy_id,
  'Unknown' AS criteria_id,
  1            AS criteria_rank,
  md5(cast(coalesce(cast('Unknown' as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(1 as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT))           AS claim_edit_key

  union all
    select 
  'Unspecified' AS health_plan_code,
  'Unspecified' AS policy_id,
  'Unspecified' AS criteria_id,
  1            AS criteria_rank,
  md5(cast(coalesce(cast('Unspecified' as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(1 as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT))           AS claim_edit_key

  union all
    select 
  'Not Applicable' AS health_plan_code,
  'Not Applicable' AS policy_id,
  'Not Applicable' AS criteria_id,
  1            AS criteria_rank,
  md5(cast(coalesce(cast('Not Applicable' as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(1 as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT))           AS claim_edit_key

  
),

final AS (
  SELECT * FROM main_relationships
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM filler_relationships
)

SELECT * FROM final

model.concert.dim_place_of_service.description: Dimensional table for place of service codes

place_of_service_code.name: place_of_service_code
place_of_service_code.description: Code between 1 and 99 that represents the place of service

model.concert.dim_place_of_service.compiled_code:
with

place_of_service as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_place_of_service_codes"
),

claim_edit_api_place_of_service as (
  select
    distinct place_of_service as place_of_service_code
  from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines"
  where nullif(place_of_service, '') is not null
),

post_pay_place_of_service as (
  select
      distinct cms_place_of_service_code as place_of_service_code
  from "dw"."dw_sources"."post_pay_payers_claims_lines"
  where cms_place_of_service_code is not null
),

every_place_of_service as (
  select place_of_service_code from place_of_service
  union all
  select place_of_service_code from claim_edit_api_place_of_service
  union all
  select place_of_service_code from post_pay_place_of_service
),

unique_place_of_service as (
  select distinct place_of_service_code from every_place_of_service
),

final_place_of_service as (
  select
    unique_place_of_service.place_of_service_code,
    coalesce(
      place_of_service.place_of_service_name,
      'Unknown'
    ) as place_of_service_name,
    coalesce(
      place_of_service.place_of_service_description,
      'Unknown'
    ) as place_of_service_description
  from unique_place_of_service
  left join place_of_service
    on unique_place_of_service.place_of_service_code
      = place_of_service.place_of_service_code
),

default_place_of_service as (
  
    select 
  'Unknown' as place_of_service_code,
  'Unknown' as place_of_service_name,
  'Unknown' as place_of_service_description

  union all
    select 
  'Unspecified' as place_of_service_code,
  'Unspecified' as place_of_service_name,
  'Unspecified' as place_of_service_description

  union all
    select 
  'Not Applicable' as place_of_service_code,
  'Not Applicable' as place_of_service_name,
  'Not Applicable' as place_of_service_description

   
),

base as (
  select * from final_place_of_service
  union all
  select * from default_place_of_service
),

final as (
  select
    *,
    row_number() over (
      partition by place_of_service_code
      order by place_of_service_name
    ) as row_num
  from base
)

select *
from final
where row_num = 1

model.concert.dim_gtu.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='all',
    sort=['status'],
  )
}}

{% set default_row_keys = var('default_row_keys') %}

with

gtu as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__gtus') }}
),

data_stable as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__gtus_data_stable') }}
),

cpt_overrides as ( 
  select * from {{ ref('stg_concert_db__gtus_cpt_overrides')}}
),

ranked_override as ( 
  select *, 
  row_number() over 
  (partition by gtu_id 
  order by effective_date desc)
  as row_num
  from cpt_overrides 
  where (effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE and expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE)
  or (effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE and expiration_date is null)
),

latest_override as ( 
  select * 
  from ranked_override
  where row_num = 1
),

ranked_gtu as (
  select

WITH

{% set TRAINING_SET_CLAIM_GROUP = ref('stg_concert_db__training_set_claim_groups') %}
{% set CATEGORY = ref('dim_category') %}
{% set AGE_GROUPS = [
  { "age_group": "<=14", "min": 0, "max": 10 },
  { "age_group": "15-49", "min": 15, "max": 45 },
  { "age_group": ">=50", "min": 50, "max": 90 },
] %}

-- Generate mapping between the age group identifiers and all of the age bands that apply to that group
age_group_to_age AS (
  {% call(age_group_config) for_delimited(AGE_GROUPS, 'UNION') %}
    {% call(age) for_delimited(range(age_group_config.min, age_group_config.max + 1, 5), 'UNION') %}
      SELECT
        '{{ age_group_config.age_group }}' as patient_age_group,
        {{ age }}::INT AS patient_age_band
    {% endcall %}
  {% endcall %}
),

base_group AS (
  SELECT
    -- Features
    claim_group.cpt_signature AS procedure_signature,
    claim_group.all_cpt AS expanded_procedure_signature,
    claim_group.all_icd AS diagnosis_signature,
    claim_group.member_age_band AS patient_age_group,
    claim_group.gender AS patient_gender,
    claim_group.service_provider_lab_code,
    -- TODO: Incorporate segmentation into Squid OR enhance the segment UDF to handle these groups
    'Genetic' AS segment_class,
    'Unknown' AS segment_name,
    0::INT AS segment_target_count,
    -- Labels
    category.category_id,
    category.category_name,
    category.domain_id,
    category.domain_name,
    category.area_id,
    category.area_name
  FROM {{ TRAINING_SET_CLAIM_GROUP }} claim_group
  INNER JOIN {{ CATEGORY }} category ON
    claim_group.predicted_category_id = category.category_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    base.procedure_signature,
    base.expanded_procedure_signature,
    base.diagnosis_signature,
    age_group.patient_age_band,
    base.patient_gender,
    base.service_provider_lab_code,
    base.segment_class,
    base.segment_name,
    base.segment_target_count,
    base.category_id,
    base.category_name,
    base.domain_id,
    base.domain_name,
    base.area_id,
    base.area_name,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY base.category_id
    )                                        AS category_volume,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY base.category_id
    )                                        AS category_row_number
  FROM base_group base
  LEFT JOIN age_group_to_age age_group ON
    base.patient_age_group = age_group.patient_age_group
)

SELECT * FROM final

model.concert.ext_dyn_claim_edit_test_li.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    sort=['claim_number'],
    dist='claim_number',
  )
}}

-- DEPENDENCIES
{% set EXT_CLAIM_LINE = ref('ext_claim_line') %}
{% set CATEGORY_MIN_CONFIDENCE = var('category_min_confidence') %}

-- QUERIES
{% set SEGMENT_CLASS = 'coalesce(next_segment_class, segment_class)' %} -- Prioritize next segment first
{% set SEGMENT_NAME = 'coalesce(next_segment_name, segment_name)' %}    -- ^ same logic
{% set TARGET_COUNT = 'coalesce(next_target_count, target_count)' %}    -- NOTE: Same logic as above, BUT it is not used for targeting right now

-- BEHAVIOR CONTROLS
{% set TARGET_NUM = 10 %}

with

-- PROCEDURE CODE TARGETING
--   calculates the row number for each procedure code that is used for whitelisting or segmentation
target_procedure_line as (
  select
    claim_number,
    line_number,
    cpt_code,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        cpt_code
      order by
        cpt_code,
        date_of_service desc
    ) as target_procedure_num
  from {{ EXT_CLAIM_LINE }}
  where
    procedure_for_api_whitelisting = true or
    procedure_for_api_segmentation = true
),

-- SEGMENTATION TARGETING
--   calculates the row number for each distinct segment combination. This also prioritizes the "next"
--   segment results during future model development
target_segment_line as (
  select
    claim_number,
    line_number,
    {{ SEGMENT_CLASS }} as segment_class,
    {{ SEGMENT_NAME }} as segment_name,
    {{ TARGET_COUNT }} as target_count,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        {{ SEGMENT_CLASS }},
        {{ SEGMENT_NAME }}
      order by
        {{ SEGMENT_CLASS }},
        {{ SEGMENT_NAME }},
        date_of_service desc
    ) as target_segment_num
  from {{ EXT_CLAIM_LINE }}
  where
    {{ SEGMENT_CLASS }} != 'Unknown'
),

-- CATEGORY TARGETING
--   calculates the row number for each distinct (non-punted) category
target_category_line as (
  select
    claim_number,
    line_number,
    category_id,
    category_confidence,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        category_id
      order by
        category_id,
        category_confidence,
        date_of_service desc
    ) as target_category_num
  from {{ EXT_CLAIM_LINE }}
  where
    category_id is not null and
    category_confidence >= {{ CATEGORY_MIN_CONFIDENCE }}
),

-- EDIT TARGETING
--   calculates the row number for each distinct combination of claim edit and edit trace.
--   The edit trace helps distinguish between the unique ways that the same edit was triggered
target_edit_line as (
  select
    claim_number,
    line_number,
    claim_edit_key,
    edit_trace_hash,
    row_number() over (
      partition by
        claim_edit_key,
        edit_trace_hash
      order by
        claim_edit_key,
        edit_trace_hash,
        date_of_service desc
    ) as target_edit_num
  from {{ EXT_CLAIM_LINE }}
  where
    claim_edit_key is not null
),

target_claim as (
  -- Procedure Code
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_procedure_line
    where target_procedure_num <= {{ TARGET_NUM }}
  )
  UNION
  -- Segment
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_segment_line
    where target_segment_num <= {{ TARGET_NUM }}
  )
  UNION
  -- Category
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_category_line
    where target_category_num <= {{ TARGET_NUM }}
  )
  UNION
  -- Edit
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_edit_line
    where target_edit_num <= {{ TARGET_NUM }}
  )
),

final as (
  select
    line.*
  from {{ EXT_CLAIM_LINE }} line
  inner join target_claim on
    line.claim_number = target_claim.claim_number
)

select * from final

      order by
        claim_edit_key,
        edit_trace_hash,
        date_of_service desc
    ) as target_edit_num
  from "dw"."dw_common"."ext_claim_line"
  where
    claim_edit_key is not null
),

target_claim as (
  -- Procedure Code
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_procedure_line
    where target_procedure_num <= 10
  )
  UNION
  -- Segment
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_segment_line
    where target_segment_num <= 10
  )
  UNION
  -- Category
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_category_line
    where target_category_num <= 10
  )
  UNION
  -- Edit
  (
    select
      distinct claim_number
    from target_edit_line
    where target_edit_num <= 10
  )
),

final as (
  select
    line.*
  from "dw"."dw_common"."ext_claim_line" line
  inner join target_claim on
    line.claim_number = target_claim.claim_number
)

{{

/************** MODEL DEPENDENCIES *********/
{% set CLAIM = ref('ext_int__claim_edit_api__claim') %}
{% set LINE = ref('fct_claim_edit_api_line') %}
{% set LINE_EDIT = ref('bdg_claim_edit_api_line_edit') %}

/*************** SCOPES ********************/
{% set PROVIDER_SCOPES = [
  {
    'ref': 'billing',
    'alias': 'billing',
  },
  {
    'ref': 'rendering',
    'alias': 'service',
  },
] %}

{% set NOT_APPLICABLE_HASH = local_md5('Not Applicable') %}

with

final as (
  select
    line.claim_number,
    claim.lines_on_claim,
    claim.date_of_service              as min_date_of_service,
    line.segment_class,
    line.segment_name,
    line.target_count,
    {% for scope in PROVIDER_SCOPES %}
      claim.{{ scope.ref }}_ein        as {{ scope.alias }}_ein,
      claim.{{ scope.ref }}_npi        as {{ scope.alias }}_npi,
      claim.{{ scope.ref }}_name       as {{ scope.alias }}_name,
      claim.{{ scope.ref }}_lab_code   as {{ scope.alias }}_lab_code,
    {% endfor %}
    line.line_of_business              as line_of_business,
    line.network_status                as network_status,
    line.cms_place_of_service_code     as place_of_service,
    line.member_sex                    as patient_gender,
    line.member_state_code             as patient_state,
    line.member_age_band               as patient_age,
    line.claim_line_number             as line_number,
    {{to_iso('line.date_of_service')}} as date_of_service,
    line.billed_amount                 as billed,
    line.allowed_amount                as allowed,
    line.claim_line_status             as status,
    line.procedure_code                as cpt_code,
    line.procedure_modifier_1          as cpt_modifier_1,
    null::varchar                      as cpt_modifier_2,
    null::varchar                      as cpt_modifier_3,
    null::varchar                      as cpt_modifier_4,
    line.service_units                 as service_units,
    {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
      line.diagnosis_code_{{ i }}      as icd_code_{{ i }},
    {% endfor %}
    line.category_id                   as category_id,
    line.pre_punt_prediction_probability as category_confidence,
    coalesce(
      line_edit.claim_edit_key,
      'Not Applicable'
    )                                  as claim_edit_key,
    coalesce(
      line_edit.edit_trace_hash,
      '{{ NOT_APPLICABLE_HASH }}'
    )                                  as edit_trace_hash,
    line.procedure_for_api_whitelisting,
    line.procedure_for_api_segmentation
  from {{ CLAIM }} claim
  inner join {{ LINE }} line
    on claim.claim_number = line.claim_number
  left join {{ LINE_EDIT }} line_edit on
    line.claim_number = line_edit.claim_number and
    line.claim_edit_api_line_key = line_edit.claim_edit_api_line_key and
    line_edit.edit_source = 'UDF_CONCERT' and
    line_edit.edit_rank = 1
)

select * from final

model.concert.procedure__benchmarked.description: Intermediate table to calculate the initial procedure benchmarks using claims data allowed amount percentiles, CMS fee schedule rates, and crosswalked code rates. This table implements the first 3 steps of the [Fee Schedule Methodology](https://github.com/concertgenetics/services-pm/wiki/Fee-Schedule--Methodology) and is used to generate category code benchmarks, and finally the official procedure benchmarks that complete the fee schedule methodology.

cms_fee_schedule_rate.name: cms_fee_schedule_rate
cms_fee_schedule_rate.description: The CMS fee schedule rate provided by the seed data

lower_quartile_allowed_amount.name: lower_quartile_allowed_amount
lower_quartile_allowed_amount.description: The lower quartile (25th percentile) allowed amount calculated from claims data (or overridden by the seed data)

lower_quartile_percent_difference.name: lower_quartile_percent_difference
lower_quartile_percent_difference.description: The percent difference between the lower quartile allowed amount and the CMS fee schedule

lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate.name: lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate
lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate.description: The lower quartile concert fee schedule rate derived from the cms fee schedule rate, lower quartile allowed amount, or crosswalked benchmark rate

lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_just.name: lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_justification
lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_just.description: A descriptive justification of the lower quartile concert fee schedule rate

median_allowed_amount.name: median_allowed_amount
median_allowed_amount.description: The median (50th percentile) allowed amount calculated from claims data (or overridden by the seed data)

median_percent_difference.name: median_percent_difference
median_percent_difference.description: The percent difference between the median allowed amount and the CMS fee schedule

median_concert_fee_schedule_rate.name: median_concert_fee_schedule_rate
median_concert_fee_schedule_rate.description: The median concert fee schedule rate derived from the cms fee schedule rate, median allowed amount, or crosswalked benchmark rate

median_concert_fee_schedule_justificatio.name: median_concert_fee_schedule_justification
median_concert_fee_schedule_justificatio.description: A descriptive justification of the median concert fee schedule rate

claim_volume.name: claim_volume
claim_volume.description: The number of claims that contribute to the percentile allowed amount calculations

model.concert.procedure__benchmarked.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    dist='all',
    sort=['procedure_code'],
  )
}}

{% set percentiles = var('benchmark_percentiles') %}
{% set claim_volume_threshold = var('benchmark_claim_volume_threshold') %}
{% set percent_difference_threshold = var('benchmark_percent_difference_threshold') %}

with

-- Percentile allowed amounts calculated from a years worth of claims data
calculated_procedure_percentile as (
  select * from {{ ref('procedure_percentile__calculated') }}
),

-- Crosswalk to comparable procedure(s)
unnested_procedure_crosswalk as (
  select * from {{ ref('procedure_crosswalk__unnested') }}
),

-- Explicitly overridden percentile allowed amounts provided by seed data
overridden_procedure_percentile as (
  select
    code as procedure_code,
    target_p25 as lower_quartile_allowed_amount,
    target_p50 as median_allowed_amount
  from {{ ref('stg_code_price_overrides') }}
),

-- CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) fee schedule rates
cms_fee_schedule as (
  select
    code as procedure_code,

    any_value(rate) as rate
  from {{ ref('stg_cms_fs') }}
  group by 1
),

-- Step 1: Gather and combine priliminary data and perform initial calculations

-- Step 1.1: Union the calculated and overridden procedure percentiles
procedure_percentile as (
  select
    -- Procedure code (whichever is available)
    coalesce(
      calculated_procedure_percentile.procedure_code,
      overridden_procedure_percentile.procedure_code
    ) as procedure_code,
    -- Percentile calculations (use override value first if available)
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      coalesce(
        overridden_procedure_percentile.{{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount,
        calculated_procedure_percentile.{{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount
      ) as {{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount,
      overridden_procedure_percentile.{{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount is not null as is_{{ percentile.alias }}_overridden,
    {% endfor %}
    -- Claim volume
    calculated_procedure_percentile.claim_volume
  from calculated_procedure_percentile
  full join overridden_procedure_percentile
    on calculated_procedure_percentile.procedure_code
      = overridden_procedure_percentile.procedure_code
),

-- Step 1.2: Union the procedure percentile and cms rates and calculate percentage differences
procedure_percentile_cms as (
  select
    -- Procedure code
    coalesce(
      procedure_percentile.procedure_code,
      cms_fee_schedule.procedure_code
    ) as procedure_code,
    -- CMS fee schedule rate
    case
      when cms_fee_schedule.rate > 0
        then cms_fee_schedule.rate
      else null
    end as cms_fee_schedule_rate,
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      {% set percentile_amount = 'procedure_percentile.' ~ percentile.alias ~ '_allowed_amount' %}
      -- Percentile allowed amount
      {{ percentile_amount }},
      -- Percent difference between percentile allowed amount and cms rate (= absolute_value(difference/average) * 100)
      case
        when {{ percentile_amount }} is not null
            and cms_fee_schedule.rate > 0
          then abs(
            ({{ percentile_amount }} - cms_fee_schedule.rate) /
            (({{ percentile_amount }} + cms_fee_schedule.rate) / 2 )
          ) * 100
        else null
      end as {{ percentile.alias }}_percent_difference,
      is_{{ percentile.alias }}_overridden,
    {% endfor %}
    procedure_percentile.claim_volume
  from procedure_percentile
  full join cms_fee_schedule
    on procedure_percentile.procedure_code
      = cms_fee_schedule.procedure_code
),

-- Step 2: Generate initial benchmark by deciding between percentile calculation
--         and cms fee schedule rate based on claim volume and percent difference
base_procedure_benchmark as (
  select
    -- Procedure Code
    procedure_code,
    -- CMS fee schedule rate
    cms_fee_schedule_rate,
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      -- Note: Reusable percentile conditions (needed for both the rate and the justification)
      {% set use_percentile_condition %}
        {{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount <= cms_fee_schedule_rate
        and {{ percentile.alias }}_percent_difference >= {{ percent_difference_threshold }}
        and claim_volume >= {{ claim_volume_threshold }}
      {% endset %}
      -- Percentile allowed amount
      {{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount,
      -- Percentile percentile difference
      {{ percentile.alias }}_percent_difference,
      -- Concert Fee Schedule rate calculated based on fee schedule methodology
      case
        when {{ use_percentile_condition }}
          then {{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount
        else cms_fee_schedule_rate
      end as {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
      -- Benchmark justification
      case
        when {{ use_percentile_condition }}
          then
            case
              when is_{{ percentile.alias }}_overridden = TRUE
                then 'Overridden concert claims {{ percentile.alias }}'
              else 'Concert claims {{ percentile.alias }}'
            end
        when cms_fee_schedule_rate is not null
          then 'CMS fee schedule'
        else 'Insufficient claims data'
      end as {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_justification,
    {% endfor %}
    claim_volume
  from procedure_percentile_cms
),

-- Step 3: Crosswalk procedures to comparable procedures

-- Step 3.1: Join unnested crosswalk codes to the base procedure benchmarks
unnested_crosswalk_benchmark as (
  select
    unnested_procedure_crosswalk.procedure_code,
    unnested_procedure_crosswalk.comparable_procedure_code,
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      base_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    {% endfor %}
    unnested_procedure_crosswalk.operator
  from unnested_procedure_crosswalk
  left join base_procedure_benchmark
    on unnested_procedure_crosswalk.comparable_procedure_code
      = base_procedure_benchmark.procedure_code
),

-- Step 3.2: Determine SUM operator crosswalk benchmarks
sum_crosswalk_benchmark as (
  select
    procedure_code,

    -- Summed benchmark rates
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      SUM({{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate) as {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    {% endfor %}
    -- Justification
    (
      'Comparable to the sum of code(s): ' ||
      LISTAGG(
        comparable_procedure_code,
        ', '
      )
    ) as benchmark_justification
  from unnested_crosswalk_benchmark
  where operator = 'SUM'
  group by 1
),

-- Step 3.3.1: Determine ANY operator first value benchmarks
any_first_value_crosswalk_benchmark as (
  select
    procedure_code,
    -- Get first not null benchmark value for each percentile
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      first_value(
        {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate ignore nulls
      ) over (
        partition by procedure_code
        order by comparable_procedure_code rows unbounded preceding
      ) as {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    {% endfor %}
    comparable_procedure_code
  from unnested_crosswalk_benchmark
  where operator = 'ANY'
),

-- Step 3.3.2: Determine distinct ANY operator benchmarks
any_crosswalk_benchmark as (
  select
    procedure_code,

    -- Get any value for each percentile (they will all be the same because of first_value operation)
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      ANY_VALUE({{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate) as {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
    {% endfor %}
    -- Aggregated comparable code(s)
    (
      'Comparable to any of code(s): ' ||
      LISTAGG(
        comparable_procedure_code,
        ', '
      )
    ) as benchmark_justification
  from any_first_value_crosswalk_benchmark
  group by 1
),

-- Step 3.4: Combine SUM and ANY crosswalked benchmarks
crosswalk_procedure_benchmark as (
  select * from sum_crosswalk_benchmark
  union all
  select * from any_crosswalk_benchmark
),

-- Step 4: Union the base benchmarks and crosswalk benchmarks and generate the final benchmark
final as (
  select
    -- Procedure code
    coalesce(
      base_procedure_benchmark.procedure_code,
      crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.procedure_code
    ) as procedure_code,
    base_procedure_benchmark.cms_fee_schedule_rate,
    {% for percentile in percentiles %}
      -- Percentile allowed amount
      base_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_allowed_amount,
      -- Percentile percent difference
      base_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_percent_difference,
      -- Percentile benchmark rate
      coalesce(
        base_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
        crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate
      ) as {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
      -- Percentile concert fee schedule justification
      case
        when base_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate is not null
          then base_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_justification
        when crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.{{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_rate is not null
          then crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.benchmark_justification
        else 'Insufficient claims data'
      end as {{ percentile.alias }}_concert_fee_schedule_justification,
    {% endfor %}
    -- Claim volume
    base_procedure_benchmark.claim_volume
  from base_procedure_benchmark
  full join crosswalk_procedure_benchmark
    on base_procedure_benchmark.procedure_code
      = crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.procedure_code
)

select * from final

        ', '
      )

crosswalk_procedure_benchmark as (

-- Step 4: Union the base benchmarks and crosswalk benchmarks and generate the final benchmark

      -- Percentile allowed amount

      -- Percentile percent difference
      base_procedure_benchmark.lower_quartile_percent_difference,

        base_procedure_benchmark.lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
        crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate
      ) as lower_quartile_concert_fee_schedule_rate,

      -- Percentile allowed amount
      base_procedure_benchmark.median_allowed_amount,
      -- Percentile percent difference
      base_procedure_benchmark.median_percent_difference,
      -- Percentile benchmark rate
      coalesce(
        base_procedure_benchmark.median_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
        crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.median_concert_fee_schedule_rate
      ) as median_concert_fee_schedule_rate,
      -- Percentile concert fee schedule justification

          then base_procedure_benchmark.median_concert_fee_schedule_justification
        when crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.median_concert_fee_schedule_rate is not null
          then crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.benchmark_justification
        else 'Insufficient claims data'

    -- Claim volume

  from base_procedure_benchmark

    on base_procedure_benchmark.procedure_code
      = crosswalk_procedure_benchmark.procedure_code
)

-- Model Dependencies
{% set FCT_CLAIM_EDIT_API_LINE = ref('base_claim_edit_api_line') %}
{% set DIM_PROCEDURE = ref('dim_procedure') %}

with

segment_code as (
  select
    segment_key,
    procedure_code,

    ANY_VALUE(claim_number) as claim_number,
    SUM(service_units) as service_units
  from {{ FCT_CLAIM_EDIT_API_LINE }}
  group by 1, 2
),

procedure_dim as (
  select
    procedure_code,
    clean_procedure_description
  from {{ DIM_PROCEDURE }}
),

segment_code_with_description as (
  select
    sc.segment_key,
    sc.procedure_code,
    sc.claim_number,
    sc.service_units,
    pd.clean_procedure_description
  from segment_code sc
  left join procedure_dim pd
    on sc.procedure_code = pd.procedure_code
),

final as (
  select
    segment_key,
    
    ANY_VALUE(claim_number) as claim_number,
    coalesce(
      LISTAGG(
        nullif(procedure_code, 'Unspecified')
          || 'x'
          || nullif(service_units, 0),
        ' '
      )
      within group (order by procedure_code),
      'Unspecified'
    ) as cpt_signature,
    coalesce(
      LISTAGG(
        procedure_code 
        || ': '
        || coalesce(clean_procedure_description, 'Unspecified'),
        ' | '
      ) within group (order by procedure_code),
      'Unspecified'
    ) as procedure_descriptions
  from segment_code_with_description
  group by 1
)
