model.concert.base_claim_edit_api_line.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='table',
    dist='claim_number',
    sort=['claim_number', 'claim_line_number'],
  )
}}

-- Model Dependencies
{% set STG_CLAIM_EDIT_API_LINE = ref('stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines') %}
{% set STG_CLAIM_EDIT_API_ERRORS = ref('stg_orders_db__claim_edit_api_errors') %}
{% set DIM_CLAIM_EDIT_SUBSCRIBER = ref('dim_claim_edit_subscriber') %}
{% set DIM_PLACE_OF_SERVICE = ref('dim_place_of_service') %}
{% set DIM_AGE_BAND = ref('dim_age_band') %}
{% set DIM_STATE = ref('dim_state') %}
{% set DIM_CATEGORY = ref('dim_category') %}
{% set DIM_LAB = ref('dim_lab') %}
{% set DIM_PROVIDER = ref('dim_provider') %}
{% set DIM_PROCEDURE = ref('dim_procedure') %}


with

unique_line as (
  select
    claim_number,
    claim_line_number,

    id                              AS concert_id,
    request_id                      AS request_id,
    payer_id                        AS payer_id,
    segment_id                      AS segment_id,
    segment_key                     AS segment_key,
    segment_name                    AS segment_name,
    segment_class                   AS segment_class,
    target_count                    AS target_count,
    requested_at                    AS requested_at,
    responded_at                    AS responded_at,
    date_of_service                 AS date_of_service,
    customer_code                   AS customer_code,
    customer_code                   AS claim_edit_subscriber_code, -- Right now it's the same AS customer code
    lob                             AS line_of_business,
    standard_line_of_business       AS standard_line_of_business,
    place_of_service                AS cms_place_of_service_code,
    category_id                     AS category_id,
    standard_place_of_service       AS standard_place_of_service,
    network_status                  AS network_status,
    icd_version                     AS icd_version,
    gender                          AS member_sex,
    member_age_band                 AS member_age_band,
    member_state_code               AS member_state_code,
    type_of_bill                    AS type_of_bill,
    admission_type                  AS admission_type,
    category_confidence             AS pre_punt_prediction_probability,
    category_id                     AS pre_punt_category_id,
    model_id                        AS claim_matching_model_id,
    {% for provider in ['billing', 'rendering'] %}
    {% set provider_alias = 'service' if provider == 'rendering' else provider %}
      {% for type in ['ein', 'npi', 'name'] %}
          {{ provider }}_{{ type }} AS {{ provider_alias }}_provider_{{ type }},
      {% endfor %}
    {% endfor %}
    revenue_code                    AS revenue_code,
    service_provider_lab_code       AS service_provider_lab_code,
    claim_line_status               AS claim_line_status,
    procedure_code                  AS procedure_code,
    procedure_modifier              AS procedure_modifier_1,
    procedure_modifier_2            AS procedure_modifier_2,
    procedure_modifier_3            AS procedure_modifier_3,
    procedure_modifier_4            AS procedure_modifier_4,
    {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
      icd_{{ i }}                   AS diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
    {% endfor %}
    has_auth_number                 AS has_auth_number,
    billed                          AS billed_amount,
    allowed                         AS allowed_amount,
    service_units                   AS service_units,
    {% for amount_type in ['billed'] %}
    -- Raw Amount per service unit
      CASE
        WHEN service_units > 0 THEN {{ amount_type }} / service_units
        ELSE null
      END AS {{ amount_type }}_amount_per_service_unit,
    {% endfor %}
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY claim_number, claim_line_number
    ) AS transaction_count
  from {{ STG_CLAIM_EDIT_API_LINE }}
),


concert_ids as (
  select
  claim_number,
  claim_line_number,
  request_id,
  JSON_PARSE('[' ||
  LISTAGG(DISTINCT '"' || concert_id || '"', ',')
    WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY concert_id) 
    || ']') AS concert_id_list
  from unique_line
  group by 1, 2, 3
),

revenue_line_counts AS (
        SELECT
          claim_number,
          request_id,
          coalesce(nullif(revenue_code, ''), 'Unspecified') as revenue_code,
          COUNT(*) as line_counts
        FROM unique_line
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
      ),

claim_revenue_signature AS (
        SELECT
          claim_number,
          request_id,
          LISTAGG(
            revenue_code
            || 'x'
            || line_counts,
            ' '
            ) WITHIN GROUP (
                ORDER BY revenue_code
                ) AS claim_revenue_code_signature
        FROM revenue_line_counts
        GROUP BY 1, 2
      ), 

latest_request as (
  select
    claim_number,
    request_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() over (
      partition by claim_number
      order by requested_at desc
    ) as row_num
  from unique_line
),

latest_only as (
  select
    claim_number,
    request_id
  from latest_request
  where row_num = 1
),

dedupe_errors as (
  select *
  from (
    select e.*,
    row_number() over (
      partition by e.customer_code, e.payer_id, e.requested_at
      order by e.requested_at desc
    ) as row_num
  from {{ STG_CLAIM_EDIT_API_ERRORS }} e
) deduped
where row_num = 1
),

initial_line as (
  select
    -- Primary Key
    {{
      dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
        'unique_line.claim_number',
        'unique_line.claim_line_number',
        'unique_line.request_id'
      ])
    }}                                                                    AS claim_edit_api_line_key,
    -- Degenerate Dimensions
    unique_line.concert_id                                                AS concert_id,
    unique_line.claim_number                                              AS claim_number,
    coalesce(unique_line.request_id, 'Unknown')                           AS request_id,
    coalesce(unique_line.payer_id, 'Unspecified')                         AS payer_id,
    unique_line.segment_key                                               AS segment_key,
    unique_line.claim_line_number                                         AS claim_line_number,
    -- Dimensions
    date_trunc('day', unique_line.requested_at)                           AS date_of_transaction_request,
    date_trunc('day', unique_line.responded_at)                           AS date_of_transaction_response,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'America/New_York', unique_line.requested_at) AS requested_at_et,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'America/New_York', unique_line.responded_at) AS responded_at_et,
    errors.error                                                          AS error,
    errors.status_code                                                    AS status_code,
    datediff(
      'milliseconds',
      unique_line.requested_at,
      unique_line.responded_at
    )                                                                     AS transaction_processing_time_in_ms,
    unique_line.date_of_service                                           AS date_of_service,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.customer_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS customer_code,
    coalesce(
      claim_edit_subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.line_of_business,
      'Unspecified'
    )                                                                     AS line_of_business,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.standard_line_of_business,
      'unknown'
    )                                                                     AS standard_line_of_business,
    coalesce(
      place_of_service.place_of_service_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS cms_place_of_service_code,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.standard_place_of_service,
      'unknown'
    )                                                                     AS standard_place_of_service,
    replace(
      coalesce(
        unique_line.network_status,
        'X'
      ),
      'U',
      'X'
    )                                                                     AS network_status,
    coalesce( unique_line.icd_version::INT, 10)                           AS icd_version,
    {{ standardize_patient_gender('member_sex') }}                        AS member_sex,
    coalesce(
      age_band.age_band,
      35
    )::INT                                                                AS member_age_band,
    coalesce(
      state.state_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS member_state_code,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.type_of_bill,
      'Unspecified'
    )                                                                     AS type_of_bill,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.admission_type,
      'Unspecified'
    )                                                                     AS admission_type,
    coalesce(
      category.category_id,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS pre_punt_category_id,
    {{ category_punting_logic(pre_punt_column_name='unique_line.pre_punt_category_id', prediction_probability_column_name='unique_line.pre_punt_prediction_probability') }},
    coalesce(
      unique_line.segment_id,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS segment_id,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.segment_name,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS segment_name,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.segment_class,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS segment_class,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.target_count::INT,
      0
    )                                                                     AS target_count,
    coalesce(unique_line.claim_matching_model_id, 'Unspecified')          AS claim_matching_model_id,
    case
      when latest.request_id is not null then 1
      else 0
    end                                                                   AS latest_claim_indicator,
    {% for provider in ['billing', 'service'] %}
      {% for type in ['ein', 'npi', 'name'] %}
        {{ provider }}_provider_{{ type }}                                AS {{ provider }}_provider_{{ type }},
      {% endfor %}
      {{dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
        provider ~ '_provider_ein',
        provider ~ '_provider_npi',
        provider ~ '_provider_name'
        ])}}                                                              AS {{ provider }}_provider_key,
    {% endfor %}

    coalesce(lab.lab_code, 'Unknown')                                     AS service_provider_lab_code,
    coalesce(unique_line.claim_line_status, 'Unknown')                    AS claim_line_status,
    coalesce(unique_line.revenue_code, 'Unspecified')                     AS revenue_code,
    coalesce(procedure.procedure_code, 'Unknown')                         AS procedure_code,
    coalesce(procedure.for_api_whitelisting, false)                       AS procedure_for_api_whitelisting,
    coalesce(procedure.for_api_segmentation, false)                       AS procedure_for_api_segmentation,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_1, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_1,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_2, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_2,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_3, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_3,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_4, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_4,
    {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_{{ i }}, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
    {% endfor %}
    -- To fix later on
    case
      when has_auth_number = true
        then 'Has Prior Auth'
      else 'Not Has Prior Auth'
    end                                                                   AS has_prior_authorization,
    -- Facts
    unique_line.billed_amount                                             AS billed_amount,
    unique_line.allowed_amount                                            AS allowed_amount,
    unique_line.service_units                                             AS service_units,
    unique_line.billed_amount_per_service_unit                            AS billed_amount_per_service_unit,
    unique_line.pre_punt_prediction_probability                           AS pre_punt_prediction_probability,
    unique_line.transaction_count                                         AS transaction_count,
    cid.concert_id_list                                                   AS concert_id_list,
    crs.claim_revenue_code_signature                                      AS claim_revenue_code_signature,
    GETDATE()                                                             AS record_last_updated_UTC,
    1::int                                                                AS volume
  from unique_line 
  left join claim_revenue_signature crs
    on unique_line.claim_number = crs.claim_number
    and unique_line.request_id = crs.request_id
  left join concert_ids cid
    on unique_line.claim_number = cid.claim_number
    and unique_line.claim_line_number = cid.claim_line_number
    and unique_line.request_id = cid.request_id
  left join latest_only latest
    on unique_line.claim_number = latest.claim_number
    and unique_line.request_id = latest.request_id
  left join {{ DIM_CLAIM_EDIT_SUBSCRIBER }} claim_edit_subscriber
    on coalesce(unique_line.claim_edit_subscriber_code, 'Unspecified')
      = claim_edit_subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code
  left join {{ DIM_PLACE_OF_SERVICE }} place_of_service
    on coalesce(unique_line.cms_place_of_service_code, 'Unspecified')
      = place_of_service.place_of_service_code
  left join {{ DIM_AGE_BAND }} age_band
    on unique_line.member_age_band = age_band.age_band
  left join {{ DIM_STATE }} state
    on coalesce(unique_line.member_state_code, 'Unspecified') = state.state_code
  left join {{ DIM_CATEGORY }} category
    on coalesce(unique_line.pre_punt_category_id, 'Unspecified') = category.category_id
  left join {{ DIM_LAB }} lab
    on coalesce(unique_line.service_provider_lab_code, 'Unspecified') = lab.lab_code
  left join {{ DIM_PROCEDURE }} procedure
    on coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_code, ''), 'Unspecified') = procedure.procedure_code
  left join dedupe_errors errors
    on unique_line.customer_code = errors.customer_code
    and unique_line.payer_id = errors.payer_id
    and unique_line.requested_at = errors.requested_at
),

final as (
  select
    initial_line.*,
    coalesce(billing_provider.lab_code, 'Unknown') as billing_provider_lab_code,
    coalesce(service_provider.lab_name, 'Unknown') as service_provider_lab_name
  from initial_line
  {% for provider in ['billing', 'service'] %}
    left join {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} as {{ provider }}_provider
    on initial_line.{{ provider }}_provider_key = {{ provider }}_provider.provider_key
  {% endfor %}
)

select * from final

    category_confidence             AS pre_punt_prediction_probability,
    category_id                     AS pre_punt_category_id,
    model_id                        AS claim_matching_model_id,
    
    
      
          billing_ein AS billing_provider_ein,
      
          billing_npi AS billing_provider_npi,
      
          billing_name AS billing_provider_name,
      
    
    
      
          rendering_ein AS service_provider_ein,
      
          rendering_npi AS service_provider_npi,
      
          rendering_name AS service_provider_name,
      
    
    revenue_code                    AS revenue_code,
    service_provider_lab_code       AS service_provider_lab_code,
    claim_line_status               AS claim_line_status,
    procedure_code                  AS procedure_code,
    procedure_modifier              AS procedure_modifier_1,
    procedure_modifier_2            AS procedure_modifier_2,
    procedure_modifier_3            AS procedure_modifier_3,
    procedure_modifier_4            AS procedure_modifier_4,
    
      icd_1                   AS diagnosis_code_1,
    
      icd_2                   AS diagnosis_code_2,
    
      icd_3                   AS diagnosis_code_3,
    
      icd_4                   AS diagnosis_code_4,
    
      icd_5                   AS diagnosis_code_5,
    
      icd_6                   AS diagnosis_code_6,
    
      icd_7                   AS diagnosis_code_7,
    
      icd_8                   AS diagnosis_code_8,
    
      icd_9                   AS diagnosis_code_9,
    
      icd_10                   AS diagnosis_code_10,
    
    has_auth_number                 AS has_auth_number,
    billed                          AS billed_amount,
    allowed                         AS allowed_amount,
    service_units                   AS service_units,
    
    -- Raw Amount per service unit
      CASE
        WHEN service_units > 0 THEN billed / service_units
        ELSE null
      END AS billed_amount_per_service_unit,
    
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY claim_number, claim_line_number
    ) AS transaction_count
  from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_spectrum__claim_audit_lines"
),


concert_ids as (
  select
  claim_number,
  claim_line_number,
  request_id,
  JSON_PARSE('[' ||
  LISTAGG(DISTINCT '"' || concert_id || '"', ',')
    WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY concert_id) 
    || ']') AS concert_id_list
  from unique_line
  group by 1, 2, 3
),

revenue_line_counts AS (
        SELECT
          claim_number,
          request_id,
          coalesce(nullif(revenue_code, ''), 'Unspecified') as revenue_code,
          COUNT(*) as line_counts
        FROM unique_line
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
      ),

claim_revenue_signature AS (
        SELECT
          claim_number,
          request_id,
          LISTAGG(
            revenue_code
            || 'x'
            || line_counts,
            ' '
            ) WITHIN GROUP (
                ORDER BY revenue_code
                ) AS claim_revenue_code_signature
        FROM revenue_line_counts
        GROUP BY 1, 2
      ), 

latest_request as (
  select
    claim_number,
    request_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() over (
      partition by claim_number
      order by requested_at desc
    ) as row_num
  from unique_line
),

latest_only as (
  select
    claim_number,
    request_id
  from latest_request
  where row_num = 1
),

dedupe_errors as (
  select *
  from (
    select e.*,
    row_number() over (
      partition by e.customer_code, e.payer_id, e.requested_at
      order by e.requested_at desc
    ) as row_num
  from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_orders_db__claim_edit_api_errors" e
) deduped
where row_num = 1
),

initial_line as (
  select
    -- Primary Key
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(unique_line.claim_number as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(unique_line.claim_line_number as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(unique_line.request_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT))                                                                    AS claim_edit_api_line_key,
    -- Degenerate Dimensions
    unique_line.concert_id                                                AS concert_id,
    unique_line.claim_number                                              AS claim_number,
    coalesce(unique_line.request_id, 'Unknown')                           AS request_id,
    coalesce(unique_line.payer_id, 'Unspecified')                         AS payer_id,
    unique_line.segment_key                                               AS segment_key,
    unique_line.claim_line_number                                         AS claim_line_number,
    -- Dimensions
    date_trunc('day', unique_line.requested_at)                           AS date_of_transaction_request,
    date_trunc('day', unique_line.responded_at)                           AS date_of_transaction_response,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'America/New_York', unique_line.requested_at) AS requested_at_et,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'America/New_York', unique_line.responded_at) AS responded_at_et,
    errors.error                                                          AS error,
    errors.status_code                                                    AS status_code,
    datediff(
      'milliseconds',
      unique_line.requested_at,
      unique_line.responded_at
    )                                                                     AS transaction_processing_time_in_ms,
    unique_line.date_of_service                                           AS date_of_service,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.customer_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS customer_code,
    coalesce(
      claim_edit_subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.line_of_business,
      'Unspecified'
    )                                                                     AS line_of_business,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.standard_line_of_business,
      'unknown'
    )                                                                     AS standard_line_of_business,
    coalesce(
      place_of_service.place_of_service_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS cms_place_of_service_code,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.standard_place_of_service,
      'unknown'
    )                                                                     AS standard_place_of_service,
    replace(
      coalesce(
        unique_line.network_status,
        'X'
      ),
      'U',
      'X'
    )                                                                     AS network_status,
    coalesce( unique_line.icd_version::INT, 10)                           AS icd_version,
    
    CASE
        WHEN member_sex = 'M' THEN 'Male'
        WHEN member_sex = 'F' THEN 'Female'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END 
                        AS member_sex,
    coalesce(
      age_band.age_band,
      35
    )::INT                                                                AS member_age_band,
    coalesce(
      state.state_code,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS member_state_code,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.type_of_bill,
      'Unspecified'
    )                                                                     AS type_of_bill,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.admission_type,
      'Unspecified'
    )                                                                     AS admission_type,
    coalesce(
      category.category_id,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS pre_punt_category_id,
    
  -- Vars
  
  

  -- Queries
  
   CASE
     WHEN 
    unique_line.pre_punt_prediction_probability < 0.7
   THEN '22834fa0-46f4-43fb-aa05-fd7ac8028e83'
     ELSE unique_line.pre_punt_category_id
   END                               AS category_id,
   
    unique_line.pre_punt_prediction_probability < 0.7
                     AS is_punted
,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.segment_id,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS segment_id,
    coalesce(

      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS segment_name,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.segment_class,
      'Unknown'
    )                                                                     AS segment_class,
    coalesce(
      unique_line.target_count::INT,
      0
    )                                                                     AS target_count,
    coalesce(unique_line.claim_matching_model_id, 'Unspecified')          AS claim_matching_model_id,

      when latest.request_id is not null then 1

    end                                                                   AS latest_claim_indicator,

        service_provider_ein                                AS service_provider_ein,
      
        service_provider_npi                                AS service_provider_npi,
      
        service_provider_name                                AS service_provider_name,
      
      md5(cast(coalesce(cast(service_provider_ein as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(service_provider_npi as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(service_provider_name as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT))                                                              AS service_provider_key,
    

    coalesce(lab.lab_code, 'Unknown')                                     AS service_provider_lab_code,
    coalesce(unique_line.claim_line_status, 'Unknown')                    AS claim_line_status,
    coalesce(unique_line.revenue_code, 'Unspecified')                     AS revenue_code,
    coalesce(procedure.procedure_code, 'Unknown')                         AS procedure_code,
    coalesce(procedure.for_api_whitelisting, false)                       AS procedure_for_api_whitelisting,
    coalesce(procedure.for_api_segmentation, false)                       AS procedure_for_api_segmentation,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_1, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_1,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_2, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_2,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_3, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_3,
    coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_modifier_4, ''), 'Unspecified') AS procedure_modifier_4,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_1, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_1,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_2, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_2,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_3, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_3,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_4, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_4,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_5, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_5,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_6, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_6,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_7, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_7,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_8, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_8,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_9, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_9,
    
      coalesce(
        nullif(
          replace(unique_line.diagnosis_code_10, '.', ''),
          ''
        ),
        'Unspecified'
      )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_10,
    
    -- To fix later on
    case
      when has_auth_number = true
        then 'Has Prior Auth'
      else 'Not Has Prior Auth'
    end                                                                   AS has_prior_authorization,
    -- Facts
    unique_line.billed_amount                                             AS billed_amount,
    unique_line.allowed_amount                                            AS allowed_amount,
    unique_line.service_units                                             AS service_units,
    unique_line.billed_amount_per_service_unit                            AS billed_amount_per_service_unit,
    unique_line.pre_punt_prediction_probability                           AS pre_punt_prediction_probability,
    unique_line.transaction_count                                         AS transaction_count,
    cid.concert_id_list                                                   AS concert_id_list,
    crs.claim_revenue_code_signature                                      AS claim_revenue_code_signature,
    GETDATE()                                                             AS record_last_updated_UTC,
    1::int                                                                AS volume
  from unique_line 
  left join claim_revenue_signature crs
    on unique_line.claim_number = crs.claim_number
    and unique_line.request_id = crs.request_id
  left join concert_ids cid
    on unique_line.claim_number = cid.claim_number
    and unique_line.claim_line_number = cid.claim_line_number
    and unique_line.request_id = cid.request_id
  left join latest_only latest
    on unique_line.claim_number = latest.claim_number
    and unique_line.request_id = latest.request_id
  left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_claim_edit_subscriber" claim_edit_subscriber
    on coalesce(unique_line.claim_edit_subscriber_code, 'Unspecified')
      = claim_edit_subscriber.claim_edit_subscriber_code
  left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_place_of_service" place_of_service
    on coalesce(unique_line.cms_place_of_service_code, 'Unspecified')
      = place_of_service.place_of_service_code
  left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_age_band" age_band
    on unique_line.member_age_band = age_band.age_band
  left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_state" state
    on coalesce(unique_line.member_state_code, 'Unspecified') = state.state_code
  left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_category" category
    on coalesce(unique_line.pre_punt_category_id, 'Unspecified') = category.category_id
  left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_lab" lab
    on coalesce(unique_line.service_provider_lab_code, 'Unspecified') = lab.lab_code
  left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_procedure" procedure
    on coalesce(nullif(unique_line.procedure_code, ''), 'Unspecified') = procedure.procedure_code
  left join dedupe_errors errors
    on unique_line.customer_code = errors.customer_code
    and unique_line.payer_id = errors.payer_id
    and unique_line.requested_at = errors.requested_at
),

final as (
  select
    initial_line.*,
    coalesce(billing_provider.lab_code, 'Unknown') as billing_provider_lab_code,
    coalesce(service_provider.lab_name, 'Unknown') as service_provider_lab_name
  from initial_line
  
    left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_provider" as billing_provider
    on initial_line.billing_provider_key = billing_provider.provider_key
  
    left join "dw"."dw_common"."dim_provider" as service_provider
    on initial_line.service_provider_key = service_provider.provider_key
  
)

  unnested.edit_rank,

model.concert.procedure_percentile__calc.description: Intermediate table to calculate the allowed amount (per service unit) percentiles for all distinct procedure codes in a subset of genepayer claims that serve as the benchmark basis. The claim volume (number of claims representing the procedure) is included as well.

procedure_code.name: procedure_code
procedure_code.description: The unique code for the benchmarked procedure

lower_quartile_allowed_amount.name: lower_quartile_allowed_amount
lower_quartile_allowed_amount.description: The lower quartile (25th percentile) of allowed amount per service units

median_allowed_amount.name: median_allowed_amount
median_allowed_amount.description: The median (50th percentile) of allowed amount per service units

claim_volume.name: claim_volume
claim_volume.description: The number of claims representing the percentile allowed amount calculation

model.concert.procedure_percentile__calc.compiled_code:
-- Just picking a random payer code string for now just so this compiles (doesn't need to work since we don't rely on this data anymore)





with

-- Gather all claim procedure code and allowed amount combinations
claim_procedure_allowed as (
  
    select
      claim_number,
      procedure_code,
      allowed_amount::float / service_units::int as allowed_amount
    FROM "dw"."dw_sources"."post_pay_payers_claims_lines"
    where date_of_service between '2021-04-01' and '2022-03-30'
      and payer_code = 'blahblahblah'
      and claim_line_status = 'Paid'
      and allowed_amount::float >= 1
      and service_units::int > 0
  
),

procedure_claim_volume as (
  select
    procedure_code,

    count(distinct claim_number) as claim_volume
  from claim_procedure_allowed
  group by 1
),

-- Calucate percentiles for each distinct procedure's allowed amounts
procedure_percentile_allowed as (
  select
    distinct procedure_code,

    
      percentile_cont(0.25)
        within group (
          order by allowed_amount
        )
        over (
          partition by procedure_code
        ) as lower_quartile_allowed_amount
    ,
      percentile_cont(0.5)
        within group (
          order by allowed_amount
        )
        over (
          partition by procedure_code
        ) as median_allowed_amount
    
  from claim_procedure_allowed
),

final as (
  select
    procedure_percentile_allowed.procedure_code,
    
      procedure_percentile_allowed.lower_quartile_allowed_amount,
    
      procedure_percentile_allowed.median_allowed_amount,
    
    procedure_claim_volume.claim_volume
  from procedure_percentile_allowed
  inner join procedure_claim_volume
    on procedure_percentile_allowed.procedure_code 
      = procedure_claim_volume.procedure_code
)

model.concert.procedure_crosswalk__unnes.compiled_code:
with

seed_code_crosswalk as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_staging"."stg_code_crosswalk"
),

numbers as (
  

    

    with p as (
        select 0 as generated_number union all select 1
    ), unioned as (

    select

    
    p0.generated_number * power(2, 0)
     + 
    
    p1.generated_number * power(2, 1)
     + 
    
    p2.generated_number * power(2, 2)
     + 
    
    p3.generated_number * power(2, 3)
    
    
    + 1
    as generated_number

    from

    
    p as p0
     cross join 
    
    p as p1
     cross join 
    
    p as p2
     cross join 
    
    p as p3
    
    

    )

    select *
    from unioned
    where generated_number <= 10
    order by generated_number


),

unnested as (
  select
    seed_code_crosswalk.code as procedure_code,
    case
      when comp_code like '%+%'
        then '+'
      else '|'
    end as operator,
    nullif(
      split_part(
        seed_code_crosswalk.comp_code,
        operator,
        numbers.generated_number::int
      ),
      ''
    ) as comparable_procedure_code
  from seed_code_crosswalk
  cross join numbers
  where seed_code_crosswalk.comp_code is not null
    and comparable_procedure_code is not null
),

final as (
  select
    procedure_code,
    case
      when operator = '+'
        then 'SUM'
      else 'ANY'
    end as operator,
    comparable_procedure_code
  from unnested
)

model.concert.claim_edit_api__line__top_.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        dist='claim_number',
        sort=['claim_number'],
    )
}}

-- Dependencies
{% set BASE_LINE = ref('base_claim_edit_api_line') %}
{% set BDG_LINE_EDIT = ref('bdg_claim_edit_api_line_edit') %}
{% set DIM_CLAIM_EDIT = ref('dim_claim_edit') %}
{% set DIM_CRITERIA = ref('dim_criteria') %}
{% set CLAIM_EDIT_CRITERIA = ref('bdg_claim_edit_criteria')%}
{% set POLICY_CRITERIA = ref('bdg_policy_policy_criteria')%}

-- Variables
{% set EDIT_SOURCES = var('ceapi_edit_sources') %}
{% set NA_KEY = generate_local_surrogate_key(['Not Applicable', '1']) %}
{% set EDIT_TRACE = "nvl(line_edit.edit_trace, 'Not Applicable')" %}

with

line as (
    select
        base_line.claim_number,
        base_line.claim_line_number,
        base_line.request_id,
        base_line.claim_edit_api_line_key,
        base_line.segment_key,
        base_line.concert_id,
        base_line.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
        base_line.payer_id,
        base_line.billed_amount
    from {{ BASE_LINE }} base_line
),

{% for edit_source in EDIT_SOURCES %}
    {% set prefix = edit_source.name %}
    {% set IS_DENIED = "claim_edit.claim_edit_short_disposition = 'deny'" %}
    top_ranked_{{ prefix }}_edit as (
        select
            line.claim_number,
            line.claim_line_number,
            line.request_id,
            nvl(line_edit.claim_edit_key, {{ NA_KEY }})                         as claim_edit_key,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_id, 'Unknown')                            as claim_edit_id,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_short_code, 'Unknown')                    as claim_edit_short_code,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_version, 1)                               as claim_edit_version,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_short_disposition, 'Unknown')             as claim_edit_disposition,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_rationale, 'Unknown')                     as claim_edit_rationale,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_remark_code, 'Unknown')                   as claim_edit_remark_code,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_remark_description, 'Unknown')            as claim_edit_remark_description,
            nvl(claim_edit.claim_edit_parent_criteria_code, 'Unknown')          as claim_edit_criteria_code,
            {{ EDIT_TRACE }}                                                    as edit_trace,
            md5({{ EDIT_TRACE }})                                               as edit_trace_hash,
            case
                when {{ IS_DENIED }} then 1
                else 0
            end                                                                 as denial_indicator,
            case
                when {{ IS_DENIED }} then line.billed_amount
                else 0
            end                                                                 as edited_billed_amount,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.policy_code, 'Unknown')         as policy_code,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.policy_version, 'Unknown')      as policy_version,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.policy_name, 'Unknown')         as policy_name,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.policy_id, 'Unknown')           as policy_id,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.policy_type, 'Unknown')         as policy_type,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.criteria_version, 'Unknown')    as criteria_version,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.criteria_name, 'Unknown')       as criteria_name,
            coalesce(policy_criteria_dimensions.criteria_id, 'Unknown')         as criteria_id
        from line
        left join {{ BDG_LINE_EDIT }} line_edit on
            line.claim_number = line_edit.claim_number and
            line.claim_line_number = line_edit.claim_line_number and
            line.request_id = line_edit.request_id and
            line_edit.edit_source = '{{ edit_source.source_id }}' and
            line_edit.edit_rank = 1
        left join {{ DIM_CLAIM_EDIT }} claim_edit on
            line_edit.claim_edit_key = claim_edit.claim_edit_key
        left join {{ CLAIM_EDIT_CRITERIA }} claim_edit_criteria on
            line_edit.claim_edit_key = claim_edit_criteria.claim_edit_key and 
            claim_edit_criteria.criteria_rank = 1
        left join {{ POLICY_CRITERIA }} policy_criteria on
            claim_edit_criteria.criteria_id = policy_criteria.criteria_id and 
            policy_criteria.row_num = 1
        left join {{ DIM_CRITERIA }} policy_criteria_dimensions on
            policy_criteria.criteria_id = policy_criteria_dimensions.criteria_id and
            policy_criteria.policy_id = policy_criteria_dimensions.policy_id
    ),

    deduped_{{ prefix }}_edit as (
        select * 
        from (
            select top_ranked.*,
                row_number() over (
                    partition by top_ranked.claim_number, top_ranked.claim_line_number, top_ranked.request_id
                    order by
                        top_ranked.claim_edit_version desc
                ) as rn
            from top_ranked_{{ prefix }}_edit top_ranked
        ) deduped
        where rn = 1
    ),
    
{% endfor %}

combined as (
    select
        line.claim_number,
        line.claim_line_number,
        line.request_id,
        line.claim_edit_api_line_key,
        line.segment_key,
        line.concert_id,
        line.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
        line.payer_id,
        line.billed_amount,
        {% call(edit_source) for_delimited(EDIT_SOURCES, ',') %}
            {% set alias = edit_source.name ~ '_edit' %}
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_key                           as {{ alias }}_key,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_id                            as {{ alias }}_id,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_short_code                    as {{ alias }}_short_code,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_version                       as {{ alias }}_version,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_disposition                   as {{ alias }}_disposition,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_rationale                     as {{ alias }}_rationale,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_remark_code                   as {{ alias }}_remark_code,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_remark_description            as {{ alias }}_remark_description,
            {{ alias }}.claim_edit_criteria_code                 as {{ alias }}_criteria_code,
            {{ alias }}.edit_trace_hash                          as {{ alias }}_trace_hash,
            {{ alias }}.denial_indicator                         as {{ alias }}_denial_indicator,
            {{ alias }}.edited_billed_amount                     as {{ alias }}_edited_billed_amount,
            {{ alias }}.policy_code                              as {{ alias }}_policy_code,
            {{ alias }}.policy_version                           as {{ alias }}_policy_version,
            {{ alias }}.policy_name                              as {{ alias }}_policy_name,
            {{ alias }}.policy_id                                as {{ alias }}_policy_id,
            {{ alias }}.policy_type                              as {{ alias }}_policy_type,
            {{ alias }}.criteria_version                         as {{ alias }}_criteria_version,
            {{ alias }}.criteria_name                            as {{ alias }}_criteria_name,
            {{ alias }}.criteria_id                              as {{ alias }}_criteria_id
        {% endcall %}
    from line
    {% for edit_source in EDIT_SOURCES %}
        {% set alias = edit_source.name ~ '_edit' %}
        LEFT JOIN deduped_{{ edit_source.name }}_edit {{ alias }} ON
            line.claim_number = {{ alias }}.claim_number AND
            line.claim_line_number = {{ alias }}.claim_line_number AND
            line.request_id = {{ alias }}.request_id
    {% endfor %}
),

final as (
    select
        *,
        concert_edit_key != concert_qa_edit_key                   as is_concert_edit_different,
        customer_edit_key != customer_qa_edit_key                 as is_customer_edit_different,
        case when (
            concert_edit_key !=
            concert_qa_edit_key
        )
            then (
                concert_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || concert_edit_version ||
                ' -> ' ||
                concert_qa_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || concert_qa_edit_version
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as concert_edit_change,
        case when (
            customer_edit_key !=
            customer_qa_edit_key
        )
            then (
                customer_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || customer_edit_version ||
                ' -> ' ||
                customer_qa_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || customer_qa_edit_version
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as customer_edit_change,
        concert_edit_disposition != concert_qa_edit_disposition   as is_concert_disposition_different,
        customer_edit_disposition != customer_qa_edit_disposition as is_customer_disposition_different,
        case when (
            concert_edit_disposition !=
            concert_qa_edit_disposition
        )
            then (
                concert_edit_disposition ||
                ' -> ' ||
                concert_qa_edit_disposition
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as concert_disposition_change,
        case when (
            customer_edit_disposition !=
            customer_qa_edit_disposition
        )
            then (
                customer_edit_disposition ||
                ' -> ' ||
                customer_qa_edit_disposition
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as customer_disposition_change
    from combined
)

select * from final

            customer_qa_edit.claim_edit_version                       as customer_qa_edit_version,
            customer_qa_edit.claim_edit_disposition                   as customer_qa_edit_disposition,
            customer_qa_edit.claim_edit_rationale                     as customer_qa_edit_rationale,
            customer_qa_edit.claim_edit_remark_code                   as customer_qa_edit_remark_code,
            customer_qa_edit.claim_edit_remark_description            as customer_qa_edit_remark_description,
            customer_qa_edit.claim_edit_criteria_code                 as customer_qa_edit_criteria_code,
            customer_qa_edit.edit_trace_hash                          as customer_qa_edit_trace_hash,
            customer_qa_edit.denial_indicator                         as customer_qa_edit_denial_indicator,
            customer_qa_edit.edited_billed_amount                     as customer_qa_edit_edited_billed_amount,
            customer_qa_edit.policy_code                              as customer_qa_edit_policy_code,
            customer_qa_edit.policy_version                           as customer_qa_edit_policy_version,
            customer_qa_edit.policy_name                              as customer_qa_edit_policy_name,
            customer_qa_edit.policy_id                                as customer_qa_edit_policy_id,
            customer_qa_edit.policy_type                              as customer_qa_edit_policy_type,
            customer_qa_edit.criteria_version                         as customer_qa_edit_criteria_version,
            customer_qa_edit.criteria_name                            as customer_qa_edit_criteria_name,
            customer_qa_edit.criteria_id                              as customer_qa_edit_criteria_id
        
    from line
    
        
        LEFT JOIN deduped_audit_edit audit_edit ON
            line.claim_number = audit_edit.claim_number AND
            line.claim_line_number = audit_edit.claim_line_number AND
            line.request_id = audit_edit.request_id
    
        
        LEFT JOIN deduped_concert_edit concert_edit ON
            line.claim_number = concert_edit.claim_number AND
            line.claim_line_number = concert_edit.claim_line_number AND
            line.request_id = concert_edit.request_id
    
        
        LEFT JOIN deduped_concert_qa_edit concert_qa_edit ON
            line.claim_number = concert_qa_edit.claim_number AND
            line.claim_line_number = concert_qa_edit.claim_line_number AND
            line.request_id = concert_qa_edit.request_id
    
        
        LEFT JOIN deduped_customer_edit customer_edit ON
            line.claim_number = customer_edit.claim_number AND
            line.claim_line_number = customer_edit.claim_line_number AND
            line.request_id = customer_edit.request_id
    
        
        LEFT JOIN deduped_customer_qa_edit customer_qa_edit ON
            line.claim_number = customer_qa_edit.claim_number AND
            line.claim_line_number = customer_qa_edit.claim_line_number AND
            line.request_id = customer_qa_edit.request_id
    
),

final as (
    select
        *,
        concert_edit_key != concert_qa_edit_key                   as is_concert_edit_different,
        customer_edit_key != customer_qa_edit_key                 as is_customer_edit_different,
        case when (
            concert_edit_key !=
            concert_qa_edit_key
        )
            then (
                concert_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || concert_edit_version ||
                ' -> ' ||
                concert_qa_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || concert_qa_edit_version
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as concert_edit_change,
        case when (
            customer_edit_key !=
            customer_qa_edit_key
        )
            then (
                customer_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || customer_edit_version ||
                ' -> ' ||
                customer_qa_edit_short_code ||
                'v' || customer_qa_edit_version
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as customer_edit_change,
        concert_edit_disposition != concert_qa_edit_disposition   as is_concert_disposition_different,
        customer_edit_disposition != customer_qa_edit_disposition as is_customer_disposition_different,
        case when (
            concert_edit_disposition !=
            concert_qa_edit_disposition
        )
            then (
                concert_edit_disposition ||
                ' -> ' ||
                concert_qa_edit_disposition
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as concert_disposition_change,
        case when (
            customer_edit_disposition !=
            customer_qa_edit_disposition
        )
            then (
                customer_edit_disposition ||
                ' -> ' ||
                customer_qa_edit_disposition
            )
            else 'No Change'
        end                                                       as customer_disposition_change
    from combined
)

with

claim_edit_api_line as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."base_claim_edit_api_line"
  where latest_claim_indicator = 1
),

claim_edit_api_claim as (
  select
    claim_number,

    ANY_VALUE(request_id)                             as request_id,
    ANY_VALUE(claim_edit_subscriber_code)             as claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    ANY_VALUE(payer_id)                               as payer_id,
    ANY_VALUE(line_of_business)                       as line_of_business,
    ANY_VALUE(network_status)                         as network_status,
    ANY_VALUE(member_sex)                             as member_sex,
    ANY_VALUE(billing_provider_key)                   as billing_provider_key,
    ANY_VALUE(service_provider_key)                   as service_provider_key
  from claim_edit_api_line
  group by 1
),

category as (
  select * from "dw"."dw_common"."dim_category"
),

provider AS (
  SELECT
    provider_key,
    provider_ein,
    provider_npi
  FROM "dw"."dw_common"."dim_provider"
),

-- Aggregate claim attributes
claim_agg as (
  select
    claim_number,
    
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    procedure_code,
    '|'
  )
                         AS all_procedure_code,
    
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when btrim(procedure_modifier_1) ~ '^[0-9A-Z]{2}$' then procedure_modifier_1 else null::varchar end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_procedure_modifier_1,
    
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when btrim(procedure_modifier_2) ~ '^[0-9A-Z]{2}$' then procedure_modifier_2 else null::varchar end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_procedure_modifier_2,
    
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when btrim(procedure_modifier_3) ~ '^[0-9A-Z]{2}$' then procedure_modifier_3 else null::varchar end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_procedure_modifier_3,
    
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when btrim(procedure_modifier_4) ~ '^[0-9A-Z]{2}$' then procedure_modifier_4 else null::varchar end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_procedure_modifier_4,
    
    
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_1 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_1 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_1
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_2 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_2 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_2
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_3 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_3 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_3
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_4 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_4 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_4
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_5 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_5 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_5
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_6 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_6 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_6
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_7 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_7 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_7
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_8 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_8 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_8
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_9 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_9 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_9
    ,
      
      
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    case when diagnosis_code_10 = 'Unspecified' then null::varchar else diagnosis_code_10 end,
    '|'
  )
                                                      AS all_icd_code_10
    
  from claim_edit_api_line
  group by 1
),

-- Aggregate lines to the segment level
segment as (
  select
    segment_key,

    ANY_VALUE(claim_number)                                   AS claim_number,
    ANY_VALUE(member_age_band)                                AS patient_age_band,
    ANY_VALUE(member_state_code)                              AS patient_state_code,
    ANY_VALUE(billing_provider_lab_code)                      AS billing_provider_lab_code,
    ANY_VALUE(service_provider_lab_code)                      AS service_provider_lab_code,
    ANY_VALUE(standard_place_of_service)                      AS standard_place_of_service,
    ANY_VALUE(category_id)                                    AS category_id,
    
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    coalesce(billed_amount, 0),
    '|'
  )
             AS all_billed_amount,
    
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    TO_CHAR(date_of_service, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    '|'
  )
 AS all_date_of_service,
    
  -- Pattern = "=|=|..."
  LISTAGG(
    claim_line_number || '=' ||
    service_units,
    '|'
  )
                          AS all_service_units
  from claim_edit_api_line
  group by 1
),

final as (
  select
    segment.claim_number                                      AS claim_number,
    claim.request_id                                          AS request_id,
    segment.segment_key                                       AS segment_key,

    claim.payer_id                                            AS payer_id,
    claim.claim_edit_subscriber_code                          AS claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    segment.patient_age_band                                  AS patient_age_band,
    case when segment.patient_state_code ~ '[A-Z]{2}'
      then segment.patient_state_code
      else 'XX'
    end                                                       AS patient_state_code,
    case claim.member_sex
      when 'Male' then 'M'
      when 'Female' then 'F'
      else 'U'
    end                                                       AS patient_gender,
    
      
        billing_provider.provider_ein    AS billing_provider_ein,
        billing_provider.provider_npi    AS billing_provider_npi,
    
      
        service_provider.provider_ein    AS rendering_provider_ein,
        service_provider.provider_npi    AS rendering_provider_npi,
    
    coalesce(
      segment.service_provider_lab_code,
      nullif(segment.billing_provider_lab_code, 'Unknown')
    )                                        AS service_provider_lab_code,
    segment.standard_place_of_service        AS standard_place_of_service,
    claim.line_of_business                   AS line_of_business,
    case when (
      claim.network_status = 'I' or
      claim.network_status = 'O'
    )
      then claim.network_status
      else 'U'
    end                                      AS network_status,
    category.category_id                     AS category_id,
    segment.all_billed_amount                AS all_billed_amount,
    segment.all_date_of_service              AS all_date_of_service,
    claim_agg.all_procedure_code             AS all_procedure_code,
    
      claim_agg.all_procedure_modifier_1 AS all_procedure_modifier_1,
    
      claim_agg.all_procedure_modifier_2 AS all_procedure_modifier_2,
    
      claim_agg.all_procedure_modifier_3 AS all_procedure_modifier_3,
    
      claim_agg.all_procedure_modifier_4 AS all_procedure_modifier_4,
    
    segment.all_service_units                AS all_service_units,
    
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_1         AS all_icd_code_1
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_2         AS all_icd_code_2
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_3         AS all_icd_code_3
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_4         AS all_icd_code_4
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_5         AS all_icd_code_5
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_6         AS all_icd_code_6
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_7         AS all_icd_code_7
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_8         AS all_icd_code_8
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_9         AS all_icd_code_9
    ,
      claim_agg.all_icd_code_10         AS all_icd_code_10
    
  from segment
  inner join category
    on segment.category_id = category.category_id
  inner join claim_edit_api_claim claim
    on segment.claim_number = claim.claim_number
  inner join claim_agg on
    segment.claim_number = claim_agg.claim_number
  
      inner join provider billing_provider
        on claim.billing_provider_key = billing_provider.provider_key
  
      inner join provider service_provider
        on claim.service_provider_key = service_provider.provider_key
  
)

select * from final

with

traces as (
  select * from {{ ref('stg_spectrum__claim_edit_api_traces') }}
),

api_request_spans as (
  select
    trace_id,
    trace_name,
    duration_ms,
    http_status_code,
    http_url,
    year,
    month,
    day
  from traces
  where trace_name in ('POST /claim', 'POST /claim/batch')
),

customer_spans as (
  select
    trace_id,
    customer_code,
    claim_edit_subscriber_code
  from traces
  where trace_name = 'get-customer'
    and customer_code is not null
),

audit_intercept_spans as (
  select
    trace_id,
    payer_ids
  from traces
  where trace_name = 'audit-intercept'
),

segmentation_spans as (
  select
    trace_id,
    claim_count
  from traces
  where trace_name = 'segmentation'
),

joined as (
  select
    api.trace_id,
    api.trace_name,
    api.duration_ms,
    api.http_status_code,
    api.http_url,
    api.year,
    api.month,
    api.day,
    cust.customer_code,
    cust.claim_edit_subscriber_code,
    audit.payer_ids,
    coalesce(seg.claim_count, 1) as claim_count,
    api.duration_ms / coalesce(nullif(seg.claim_count, 0), 1) as duration_per_claim_ms
  from api_request_spans api
  left join customer_spans cust
    on api.trace_id = cust.trace_id
  left join audit_intercept_spans audit
    on api.trace_id = audit.trace_id
  left join segmentation_spans seg
    on api.trace_id = seg.trace_id
)

select * from joined

with

expected_infectious_disease AS (
  select
    distinct code as procedure_code
  from {{ ref('dim_procedure_code_scopes') }}
  where is_infectious_disease = 'infectious_disease'
),

-- The actual indicated genetic procedures from the procedure dimension
actual_infectious_disease as (
  select
    procedure_code
  from {{ ref('dim_procedure') }}
  where is_infectious_disease = true
)

-- Only returns rows that fall outside the union of the actual and expected genetic procedures
select
  actual_infectious_disease.procedure_code as actual_procedure_code,
  expected_infectious_disease.procedure_code as expected_procedure_code
from actual_infectious_disease
full join expected_infectious_disease
  on actual_infectious_disease.procedure_code = expected_infectious_disease.procedure_code
where
