macro.concert.fct_post_pay_segment.name: fct_post_pay_segment
macro.concert.fct_post_pay_segment.macro_sql:
{% macro fct_post_pay_segment(payer_code) %}
    -- Vars
    {% set amount_types = var('amount_types') %}
    {% set provider_types = var('provider_types') %}

    -- Model Dependencies
    {% set FCT_POST_PAY_LINE = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_line') %}
    {% set POST_PAY_SEGMENT_DIAGNOSIS = source('dw_common', 'post_pay_diagnosis__segment__grouped') %}
    {% set POST_PAY_SEGMENT_STATUS = source('dw_common', 'post_pay_payment_status__segment__grouped') %}
    {% set POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__SEGMENT__GROUPED = source('post_pay_staging', 'latest_post_pay_procedure__segment__grouped') %}
    {% set DIM_AGE_BAND = ref('dim_age_band') %}
    {% set DIM_PROVIDER = ref('dim_provider') %}
    {% set destination_table = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_segment') %}

    {% set query %}
        DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}';

        INSERT INTO {{ destination_table }}
        ( {{ generate_column_list_insert(fct_post_pay_segment_columns) }} )
        WITH

        segment AS (
            select
                segment_key,

                count(distinct(segment_key))                    AS segments_on_claim,
                any_value(claim_number)                         AS claim_number,
                any_value(segment_id)                           AS segment_id,
                any_value(segment_class)                        AS segment_class,
                any_value(segment_name)                         AS segment_name,
                any_value(target_count)                         AS target_count,
                count(post_pay_line_key)                        AS lines_on_segment,
                any_value(payer_code)                           AS payer_code,
                min(date_of_service)                            AS date_of_service,
                min(claim_paid_date)                            AS min_claim_paid_date,
                max(claim_paid_date)                            AS max_claim_paid_date,
                min(claim_received_date)                        AS min_claim_received_date,
                max(claim_received_date)                        AS max_claim_received_date,
                max(month_of_service)                           AS max_month_of_service,
                max(claim_paid_month)                           AS max_claim_paid_month,
                max(claim_received_month)                       AS max_claim_received_month,
                any_value(member_id)                            AS member_id,
                any_value(member_state_code)                    AS member_state_code, 
                min(member_age)                                 AS member_age, 
                {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
                    any_value({{ provider_type }}_provider_key) AS {{ provider_type }}_provider_key,
                {% endfor %}
                any_value(service_provider_state)               AS service_provider_state,
                any_value(cms_place_of_service_code)            AS cms_place_of_service_code,
                any_value(standard_place_of_service)            AS standard_place_of_service,
                any_value(category_id)                          AS category_id,
                any_value(network_status)                       AS network_status,
                any_value(member_sex)                           AS member_sex, 
                bool_or(
                    case
                        when has_ordering_provider = 'Has Ordering Provider'
                        then true
                        else false
                    end
                )                                               AS has_ordering_provider,
                any_value(entity)                               AS entity,
                any_value(line_of_business)                     AS line_of_business,
                any_value(reporting_group)                      AS reporting_group,
                any_value(home_host)                            AS home_host,
                bool_or(
                    case
                        when has_prior_authorization = 'Has Prior Auth'
                        then true
                        else false
                    end
                )                                               AS has_prior_authorization,
                any_value(business_unit)                        AS business_unit,
                any_value(claims_system)                        AS claims_system,
                any_value(incident_of_care)                     AS incident_of_care,
                any_value(claim_form_type)                      AS claim_form_type,
                any_value(claim_matching_model_id)              AS claim_matching_model_id,
                any_value(pre_punt_prediction_probability)      AS pre_punt_prediction_probability,
                sum(service_units)                              AS service_units,
                {% for amount_type in amount_types %}
                    {% set label = 'paid' if amount_type == 'insurance_paid' else amount_type %}
                        SUM({{ amount_type }}_amount)           AS {{ amount_type }}_amount,
                        SUM(edited_{{ label }}_amount)          AS edited_{{ label }}_amount,
                {% endfor %}
                sum(deductible_amount)                          AS deductible_amount,
                sum(coinsurance_amount)                         AS coinsurance_amount,
                sum(cob_amount)                                 AS cob_amount,
                any_value(pre_punt_category_id)                 AS pre_punt_category_id,
                any_value(is_punted)                            AS is_punted,
                any_value(claim_revenue_code_signature)         AS claim_revenue_code_signature,
                min(type_of_bill)                               AS type_of_bill,
                min(admission_type)                             AS admission_type
            FROM {{ FCT_POST_PAY_LINE }}
            WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
            GROUP BY 1
        ),

        final as (
            select
                segment.payer_code,
                -- Primary Key
                segment.segment_key,
                segment.claim_number,
                -- Segment Dimensions (most of the time, a Segment Dimension is going to be the same as a Claim dimension)
                segment.segment_id,
                segment.segment_class,
                segment.segment_name,
                segment.target_count,
                segment.date_of_service,
                segment.min_claim_paid_date,
                segment.max_claim_paid_date,
                segment.min_claim_received_date,
                segment.max_claim_received_date,
                segment.max_month_of_service,
                segment.max_claim_paid_month,
                segment.max_claim_received_month,
                segment.member_id,
                segment.member_state_code,
                segment.member_age,
                {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
                    segment.{{ provider_type }}_provider_key,
                {% endfor %}
                segment.service_provider_state,
                segment.cms_place_of_service_code,
                segment.standard_place_of_service,
                segment.category_id,
                {{
                    create_claim_group_key(
                        cpt_signature='grouped_segment_procedure.procedure_signature',
                        icd_signature='grouped_segment_diagnosis.diagnosis_signature',
                        patient_gender='segment.member_sex',
                        patient_age_band_group='patient_age_band_group.age_band_group_code',
                        service_provider_lab_code='provider.lab_code'
                    )
                }} AS segment_group_id,
                -- Claim Profile Attributes
                segment.network_status,
                segment.member_sex,
                case
                    when segment.has_ordering_provider = true
                    then 'Has Ordering Provider'
                    else 'Not Has Ordering Provider'
                end as has_ordering_provider,
                segment.entity,
                segment.line_of_business,
                segment.reporting_group,
                segment.home_host,
                case
                    when segment.has_prior_authorization = true
                    then 'Has Prior Auth'
                    else 'Not Has Prior Auth'
                end as has_prior_authorization,
                segment.business_unit,
                segment.claims_system,
                segment.incident_of_care,
                segment.claim_form_type,
                segment.claim_matching_model_id,
                segment.claim_revenue_code_signature,
                segment.type_of_bill,
                segment.admission_type,
                grouped_segment_diagnosis.diagnosis_signature,
                grouped_segment_diagnosis.diagnosis_descriptions,
                grouped_segment_status.segment_status,
                grouped_segment_procedure.procedure_signature,
                grouped_segment_procedure.procedure_descriptions,
                -- Segment Facts
                segment.lines_on_segment,
                segment.pre_punt_prediction_probability,
                segment.service_units,
                grouped_segment_procedure.paid_service_units,
                {% for amount_type in amount_types %}
                    segment.{{ amount_type }}_amount,
                {% endfor %}
                segment.pre_punt_category_id,
                segment.is_punted,
                segment.segments_on_claim,
                segment.edited_allowed_amount,
                segment.edited_billed_amount,
                segment.edited_paid_amount,
                segment.deductible_amount,
                segment.coinsurance_amount,
                segment.cob_amount,
                GETDATE()                                       AS record_last_updated_UTC
            from segment 
            -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
            inner join {{ POST_PAY_SEGMENT_DIAGNOSIS }} grouped_segment_diagnosis on
                segment.claim_number = grouped_segment_diagnosis.claim_number and
                segment.segment_key = grouped_segment_diagnosis.segment_key
            -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
            inner join {{ POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__SEGMENT__GROUPED }} grouped_segment_procedure on
                segment.claim_number = grouped_segment_procedure.claim_number and
                segment.segment_key = grouped_segment_procedure.segment_key
            -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
            inner join {{ POST_PAY_SEGMENT_STATUS }} grouped_segment_status on
                segment.claim_number = grouped_segment_status.claim_number AND
                segment.segment_key = grouped_segment_status.segment_key
            inner join {{ DIM_AGE_BAND }} patient_age_band_group
                on segment.member_age = patient_age_band_group.age_band
            inner join {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} provider
                on segment.service_provider_key = provider.provider_key
        )

        SELECT {{ generate_column_list_select(fct_post_pay_segment_columns) }} from final
    {% endset %}

    {{ print("Updating " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data...") }}
    {% do run_query(query) %}
    {{ print("Updated " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data.") }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.concert.mart_post_pay_segment.name: mart_post_pay_segment
macro.concert.mart_post_pay_segment.macro_sql:
{% macro mart_post_pay_segment(payer_code) %}
    -- Vars
    {% set provider_types = var('provider_types') %}
    {% set amount_types = var('amount_types') %}
    -- Dependencies
    {% set FCT_POST_PAY_SEGMENT = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_segment') %}
    {% set DIM_PROVIDER = ref('dim_provider') %}
    {% set CATEGORY = ref('dim_category') %}
    {% set TARGET_PRICES = ref('stg_category_target_prices') %}
    {% set MAC = ref('stg_npi_mac') %}
    {% set DIM_SEGMENT = ref('dim_segment') %}
    {% set DIM_PLACE_OF_SERVICE = ref('dim_place_of_service') %}
    {% set POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__CLAIM__GROUPED = source('dw_common', 'post_pay_procedure__claim__grouped') %}

    {% set destination_table = source('dw_marts', 'mart_post_pay_segment') %}

    {% set query %}
        DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}';

        INSERT INTO {{ destination_table }}
        ( {{ generate_column_list_insert(mart_post_pay_segment_columns) }} )
        WITH 
        final AS (
            SELECT
                -- Payer Dimension
                segment.payer_code,
                -- Primary Key
                segment.segment_key,
                -- Degenerate Dimensions
                segment.claim_number,
                -- Segment Dimension
                dim_segment.segment_class,
                dim_segment.segment_name,
                dim_segment.segment_id,
                -- Segment Attributes
                segment.target_count,
                segment.date_of_service,
                segment.min_claim_received_date as min_claim_received_date,
                segment.max_claim_received_date as max_claim_received_date,
                segment.min_claim_paid_date as min_claim_paid_date,
                segment.max_claim_paid_date as max_claim_paid_date,
                segment.max_month_of_service,
                segment.max_claim_paid_month,
                segment.max_claim_received_month,
                segment.member_id,
                segment.member_state_code,
                segment.member_age,
                segment.member_sex,
                segment.service_provider_state,
                segment.cms_place_of_service_code,
                coalesce(place_of_service.place_of_service_description, 'Unknown') AS cms_place_of_service_description,
                segment.standard_place_of_service,
                segment.network_status,
                segment.has_prior_authorization,
                segment.entity,
                segment.reporting_group,
                segment.home_host,
                segment.line_of_business,
                segment.business_unit,
                segment.diagnosis_signature,
                segment.diagnosis_descriptions,
                segment.incident_of_care,
                segment.procedure_signature,
                mac.mac,
                segment.procedure_descriptions,
                segment.segment_status,
                segment.pre_punt_prediction_probability,
                segment.claim_form_type,
                segment.claim_matching_model_id,
                segment.claims_system,
                segment.claim_revenue_code_signature,
                segment.pre_punt_category_id,
                segment.type_of_bill,
                segment.admission_type,
                -- Provider Dimension
                {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.lab_code                     AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_lab_code,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.lab_name                     AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_lab_name,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_npi                 AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_npi,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_ein                 AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_ein,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_key                 AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_key,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_name                AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_name,
                {% endfor %}
                -- Category Dimension
                category.category_id,
                category.category_name,
                category.domain_name,
                category.area_name,
                -- Facts
                segment.paid_service_units,
                segment.lines_on_segment,
                segment.service_units,
                {% for amount_type in amount_types %}
                    {% set label = 'paid' if amount_type == 'insurance_paid' else amount_type %}
                        segment.{{ amount_type }}_amount,
                        segment.edited_{{ label }}_amount,
                {% endfor %}
                segment.deductible_amount,
                segment.coinsurance_amount,
                segment.cob_amount,
                segment.segments_on_claim,
                segment.is_punted,
                coalesce(grouped_claim_procedure.procedure_signature, 'Unknown')        AS claim_procedure_signature,
                coalesce(grouped_claim_procedure.procedure_descriptions, 'Unknown')     AS claim_procedure_descriptions,
                GETDATE()                                                               AS record_last_updated_UTC
            FROM {{ FCT_POST_PAY_SEGMENT }} segment 
                {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
                INNER JOIN {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} {{ provider_type }}_provider
                    ON segment.{{ provider_type }}_provider_key = {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_key
                {% endfor %}
            LEFT JOIN {{ DIM_PLACE_OF_SERVICE }} place_of_service
                ON segment.cms_place_of_service_code = place_of_service.place_of_service_code
            LEFT JOIN {{ POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__CLAIM__GROUPED }} grouped_claim_procedure
                ON segment.claim_number = grouped_claim_procedure.claim_number
                AND segment.payer_code = grouped_claim_procedure.payer_code
            LEFT JOIN {{ MAC }} mac
                ON mac.npi = service_provider.provider_npi
            INNER JOIN {{ CATEGORY }} category
                ON segment.category_id = category.category_id
            LEFT JOIN {{ TARGET_PRICES }} target_prices
                ON segment.category_id = target_prices.category_id
            LEFT JOIN {{ DIM_SEGMENT }} dim_segment
                ON segment.segment_id = dim_segment.segment_id
            WHERE segment.payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
        )
        SELECT {{ generate_column_list_select(mart_post_pay_segment_columns) }} FROM final
    {% endset %}

    {{ print("Updating " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data...") }}
    {% do run_query(query) %}
    {{ print("Updated " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data.") }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.concert.fct_post_pay_line.name: fct_post_pay_line
macro.concert.fct_post_pay_line.macro_sql:
{% macro fct_post_pay_line(payer_code) %}
  -- Model Dependencies
  {% set DIM_CRITERIA = ref('dim_criteria') %}
  {% set DIM_PROCEDURE = ref('dim_procedure') %}
  {% set DIM_PROVIDER = ref('dim_provider') %}
  {% set POST_PAY_DIAGNOSIS__CLAIM__GROUPED = source('post_pay_staging', 'post_pay_diagnosis__claim__grouped') %}
  {% set TOP_RANKED_LINE_EDIT = source('post_pay_staging', 'top_ranked_edit') %}
  {% set POST_SEGMENTATION_UNNESTING = source('post_pay_staging', 'post_segmentation_unnesting') %}
  {% set destination_table = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_line') %}

  -- Vars
  {% set MODEL_ID = env_var('CLAIM_MATCHING_MODEL_ID') %}
  {% set PROCEDURE_SCOPES = var('procedure_scopes') %}
  {% set AMOUNT_TYPES = var('amount_types') %}
  {% set PROVIDER_TYPES = var('provider_types') %}
  {% set procedure_code_logic = "COALESCE(line.procedure_code, 'Unspecified')"%}

  {% set query %}
      DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}
      WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}';

      INSERT INTO {{ destination_table }}
      ( {{ generate_column_list_insert(fct_post_pay_line_columns) }} )
      with

      prediction AS ( 
        {{ post_punt_category_classification(payer_code=payer_code) }}
      ),

      post_segmentation_unnesting AS (
        SELECT * 
        FROM {{ POST_SEGMENTATION_UNNESTING }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
      ),

      all_lines AS (
        SELECT * 
        FROM {{ source('post_pay_sources', 'post_pay_payers_claims_lines') }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'

      ),

      grouped_claim_diagnosis as (
        select claim_number, 
        diagnosis_signature
        from {{ POST_PAY_DIAGNOSIS__CLAIM__GROUPED }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
      ),

      revenue_line_counts AS (
        SELECT
          claim_number,
          coalesce(nullif(revenue_code, ''), 'Unspecified') as revenue_code,
          COUNT(*) as line_counts
        FROM all_lines
        GROUP BY 1, 2
      ),

      claim_revenue_signature AS (
        SELECT
          claim_number,
          LISTAGG(
            revenue_code
            || 'x'
            || line_counts,
            ' '
            ) WITHIN GROUP (
                ORDER BY revenue_code
                ) AS claim_revenue_code_signature
        FROM revenue_line_counts
        GROUP BY 1
      ), 

      final AS (
          SELECT
              -- Primary Key
              line.post_pay_line_key,
              -- Degenerate Dimensions
              line.claim_number,
              line.claim_line_number,
              segment.segment_key,
              -- Dimensions
              segment.segment_id,
              segment.segment_name,
              segment.segment_class,
              segment.target_count,
              segment.next_segment_name,
              segment.next_segment_class,
              segment.next_target_count,
              line.payer_code,
              line.date_of_service,
              line.claim_paid_date,
              line.claim_returned_date,
              line.claim_received_date,
              line.month_of_service                                                   AS month_of_service,
              line.claim_paid_month                                                   AS claim_paid_month,
              line.claim_received_month                                               AS claim_received_month,
              COALESCE(line.member_id, 'Unspecified')                                 AS member_id,
              COALESCE(line.member_state_code, 'Unspecified')                         AS member_state_code,
              COALESCE(line.member_age, 35)                                           AS member_age,
              {{ procedure_code_logic }}                                              AS procedure_code,
              COALESCE(procedure.for_api_whitelisting, false)                         AS procedure_for_api_whitelisting,
              COALESCE(procedure.for_api_segmentation, false)                         AS procedure_for_api_segmentation,
              {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
                  COALESCE(
                      line.diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
                      'Unspecified'
                  )                                                                   AS diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
              {% endfor %}
              {% for provider_type in PROVIDER_TYPES %}
                  {{ provider_type }}_provider_key,
              {% endfor %}
              COALESCE(line.service_provider_state, 'Unspecified')                    AS service_provider_state,
              COALESCE(line.cms_place_of_service_code, 'Unspecified')                 AS cms_place_of_service_code,
              COALESCE(segment.standard_place_of_service, 'Unknown')                  AS standard_place_of_service,
              COALESCE(prediction.pre_punt_category_id, 'Unknown')                    AS pre_punt_category_id,
              {{ category_punting_logic(pre_punt_column_name='prediction.pre_punt_category_id', prediction_probability_column_name='prediction.prediction_probability') }},
              COALESCE(provider.lab_code, 'Unknown')                                  AS service_provider_lab_code,
              COALESCE(provider.lab_name, 'Unknown')                                  AS service_provider_lab_name,
              -- Dimensionless Attributes
              COALESCE(line.network_status, 'Unknown')                                AS network_status,
              COALESCE(line.member_sex, 'Unknown')                                    AS member_sex,
              {% for num in range(1, 5) %}
                  COALESCE(
                      line.procedure_modifier_{{ num }},
                      'Unspecified'
                  )                                                                   AS procedure_modifier_{{ num }},
              {% endfor %}
              line.has_ordering_provider,
              COALESCE(line.claim_line_status, 'Unknown')                             AS claim_line_status,
              COALESCE(line.entity, 'Unspecified')                                    AS entity,
              COALESCE(line.line_of_business, 'Unspecified')                          AS line_of_business,
              COALESCE(line.reporting_group, 'Unspecified')                           AS reporting_group,
              COALESCE(line.home_host, 'Unspecified')                                 AS home_host,
              COALESCE(line.has_prior_authorization, 'Unspecified')                   AS has_prior_authorization,
              COALESCE(line.business_unit, 'Unspecified')                             AS business_unit,
              COALESCE(line.denial_reason, 'Unspecified')                             AS denial_reason,
              line.is_returned_to_client,
              COALESCE(line.return_notes, 'Unspecified')                              AS return_notes,
              COALESCE(line.claims_system, 'Unspecified')                             AS claims_system,
              COALESCE(line.incident_of_care, 'Unspecified')                          AS incident_of_care,
              -- Facts
              prediction.prediction_probability                                       AS pre_punt_prediction_probability,
              COALESCE(prediction.segment_matching_model_id, 'Unspecified')           AS claim_matching_model_id,
              line.service_units,
              {% for amount_type in ['billed', 'allowed'] %}
                  -- Raw Amount
                  line.{{ amount_type }}_amount,
                  -- Raw Amount per service unit
                  CASE
                      WHEN line.service_units > 0 THEN line.{{ amount_type }}_amount / line.service_units
                      ELSE null
                  END AS {{ amount_type }}_amount_per_service_unit,
              {% endfor %}
              line.insurance_paid_amount,
              COALESCE(line.deductible_amount, null)                                  AS deductible_amount,
              COALESCE(line.coinsurance_amount, null)                                 AS coinsurance_amount,
              COALESCE(line.cob_amount, null)                                         AS cob_amount,
              -- Top ranked edit info (unscoped)
              line_edit.claim_edit_key,
              line_edit.edit_trace_hash,
              line_edit.edited_allowed_amount,
              line_edit.edited_billed_amount,
              line_edit.edited_paid_amount,
              line_edit.customer_code,
              line_edit.policy_code,
              line_edit.policy_version,
              line_edit.policy_name,
              line_edit.criteria_code,
              line_edit.criteria_version,
              line_edit.criteria_name,
              coalesce(criteria.policy_id, 'Unknown')                                AS policy_id,
              coalesce(initcap(replace(criteria.content_type, '_', ' ')), 'Unknown') AS policy_type,
              coalesce(criteria.criteria_id, 'Unknown')                             AS criteria_id,
              GETDATE()                                                             AS record_last_updated_UTC,
              COALESCE(line.type_of_bill, 'Unspecified')                            AS type_of_bill,
              COALESCE(line.admission_type, 'Unspecified')                          AS admission_type,
              COALESCE(line.revenue_code, 'Unspecified')                            AS revenue_code,
              COALESCE(grouped_claim_diagnosis.diagnosis_signature, 'Unspecified')  AS diagnosis_signature,
              COALESCE(crs.claim_revenue_code_signature, 'Unspecified')             AS claim_revenue_code_signature,
              COALESCE(line.contracted_amount, null)                                AS contracted_amount,
              COALESCE(line.contracted_amount_estimated_indicator, null)            AS contracted_amount_estimated_indicator,
              COALESCE(line.concert_denial_indicator, null)                         AS concert_denial_indicator,
              COALESCE(line.concert_denial_claim_edit_short_code, 'Unspecified')    AS concert_denial_claim_edit_short_code,
              COALESCE(line.concert_denial_claim_edit_key, 'Unspecified')           AS concert_denial_claim_edit_key,
              COALESCE(line.concert_denial_claim_edit_remark_code, 'Unspecified')   AS concert_denial_claim_edit_remark_code,
              COALESCE(line.aux_str_1, 'Unspecified')                               AS aux_str_1,
              COALESCE(line.aux_str_2, 'Unspecified')                               AS aux_str_2,
              COALESCE(line.aux_str_3, 'Unspecified')                               AS aux_str_3,
              COALESCE(line.claim_form_type, 'Unspecified')                         AS claim_form_type,
              COALESCE(line.copay_amount, null)                                     AS copay_amount,
              COALESCE(line.administrative_duplicate_indicator, null)               AS administrative_duplicate_indicator,
              COALESCE(line.ioc_proc_sig_duplicate_indicator, null)                 AS ioc_proc_sig_duplicate_indicator
          FROM all_lines line
          LEFT JOIN claim_revenue_signature crs
              ON line.claim_number = crs.claim_number
          INNER JOIN {{ DIM_PROCEDURE }} procedure
              ON {{ procedure_code_logic }} = procedure.procedure_code
          LEFT JOIN {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} provider
              ON line.service_provider_key = provider.provider_key
          LEFT JOIN grouped_claim_diagnosis
              ON line.claim_number = grouped_claim_diagnosis.claim_number
          -- Edits
          INNER JOIN {{ TOP_RANKED_LINE_EDIT }} line_edit ON
              line.claim_number = line_edit.claim_number AND
              line.post_pay_line_key = line_edit.post_pay_line_key
          LEFT JOIN {{ DIM_CRITERIA }} criteria
               ON line_edit.policy_code = criteria.policy_code
               AND line_edit.policy_version = criteria.policy_version
               AND line_edit.criteria_code = criteria.criteria_code
               AND line_edit.criteria_version = criteria.criteria_version
          -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key as first condition
          INNER JOIN post_segmentation_unnesting segment ON
              line.claim_number = segment.claim_number AND
              line.post_pay_line_key = segment.post_pay_line_key 
          -- Matching prediction (claim_number is a dist key for optimized join)
          LEFT JOIN prediction prediction ON
              line.claim_number = prediction.claim_number AND
              segment.segment_key = prediction.segment_key AND
              prediction.segment_matching_model_id = '{{ MODEL_ID }}'
      )

      SELECT {{ generate_column_list_select(fct_post_pay_line_columns) }} FROM final
  {% endset %}

  {{ print("Updating " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data...") }}
  {% do run_query(query) %}
  {{ print("Updated " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data.") }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.concert.mart_post_pay_line.name: mart_post_pay_line
macro.concert.mart_post_pay_line.macro_sql:
{% macro mart_post_pay_line(payer_code) %}
  -- Model Dependencies
  {% set FCT_POST_PAY_LINE = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_line') %}
  {% set FCT_POST_PAY_SEGMENT = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_segment') %}
  {% set POST_PAY_DIAGNOSIS__CLAIM__GROUPED = source('post_pay_staging', 'post_pay_diagnosis__claim__grouped') %}
  {% set DIM_PROVIDER = ref('dim_provider') %}
  {% set DIM_PROCEDURE = ref('dim_procedure') %}
  {% set DIM_DIAGNOSIS = ref('dim_diagnosis') %}
  {% set DIM_CATEGORY = ref('dim_category') %}
  {% set DIM_CLAIM_EDIT = ref('dim_claim_edit') %}
  {% set DIM_PLACE_OF_SERVICE = ref('dim_place_of_service') %}
  {% set POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__CLAIM__GROUPED = source('dw_common', 'post_pay_procedure__claim__grouped') %}
  {% set destination_table = source('dw_marts', 'mart_post_pay_line') %}

  -- Vars
  {% set edit_scopes = var('edit_scopes') %}
  {% set amount_types = var('amount_types') %}
  {% set provider_types = var('provider_types') %}

  {% set query %}
      DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}
      WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}';

      INSERT INTO {{ destination_table }}
      ( {{ generate_column_list_insert(mart_post_pay_line_columns) }} )
      with

      line as (
        select * 
        from {{ FCT_POST_PAY_LINE }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
      ),

      grouped_claim_procedure as (
        select * 
        from {{ POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__CLAIM__GROUPED }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
      ),

      grouped_claim_diagnosis as (
        select * 
        from {{ POST_PAY_DIAGNOSIS__CLAIM__GROUPED }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
      ),

      final as (
        select
          -- Primary Key
          line.post_pay_line_key,
          -- Degenerate Dimensions
          line.claim_number,
          line.segment_key,
          line.claim_line_number,
          line.target_count,
          -- Payer Dimension
          line.payer_code,
          -- Line Attributes
          line.segment_id,
          line.segment_name,
          line.segment_class,
          line.date_of_service,
          line.claim_paid_date,
          line.claim_received_date,
          line.month_of_service,
          line.claim_paid_month,
          line.claim_received_month,
          line.line_of_business,
          line.reporting_group,
          line.member_id,
          line.member_state_code,
          line.member_age,
          line.member_sex,
          line.procedure_modifier_1,
          line.procedure_modifier_2,
          line.procedure_modifier_3,
          line.procedure_modifier_4,
          line.service_provider_state,
          line.home_host,
          line.entity,
          line.network_status,
          line.claims_system,
          line.claim_line_status,
          line.incident_of_care,
          line.has_prior_authorization,
          -- Provider Dimension
          {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
            coalesce({{ provider_type }}_provider.lab_code , 'Unknown')                    AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_lab_code,
            coalesce({{ provider_type }}_provider.lab_name , 'Unknown')                    AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_lab_name,
            coalesce({{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_npi , 'Unknown')                AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_npi,
            coalesce({{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_ein , 'Unknown')                AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_ein,
            coalesce({{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_name , 'Unknown')               AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_name,
          {% endfor %}
          line.billing_provider_key,
          line.service_provider_key,
          -- Procedure Dimension
          coalesce(procedure.procedure_code, 'Unknown') as procedure_code,
          coalesce(procedure.clean_procedure_description, 'Unknown') as procedure_description,
          -- Diagnosis Dimension
          {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
            coalesce(diagnosis_{{ i }}.diagnosis_code, 'Unknown') as diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
            coalesce(diagnosis_{{ i }}.diagnosis_description, 'Unknown') as diagnosis_description_{{ i }},
          {% endfor %}
          -- Place Of Service Dimension
          coalesce(place_of_service.place_of_service_description, 'Unknown') AS cms_place_of_service_description,
          line.cms_place_of_service_code                AS cms_place_of_service_code,
          line.standard_place_of_service                AS standard_place_of_service,
          -- Category Dimension
          coalesce(category.area_name, 'Unknown') as area_name,
          coalesce(category.domain_name, 'Unknown') as domain_name,
          coalesce(category.category_name, 'Unknown') as category_name,
          line.category_id,
          line.pre_punt_category_id,
          -- Service Units
          line.service_units,
          -- Raw Amounts
          line.billed_amount,
          line.billed_amount_per_service_unit,
          line.allowed_amount,
          line.insurance_paid_amount,
          line.allowed_amount_per_service_unit,
          line.business_unit,
          -- Edit dimensions and Facts 
          line.claim_edit_key,
          line.edited_allowed_amount,
          line.edited_billed_amount,
          line.edited_paid_amount,
          line.deductible_amount,
          line.coinsurance_amount,
          line.cob_amount,
          line.customer_code,
          line.policy_id,
          line.policy_code,
          line.policy_version,
          line.policy_name,
          line.policy_type,
          line.criteria_id,
          line.criteria_code,
          line.criteria_version,
          line.criteria_name,
          line.denial_reason,
          line.pre_punt_prediction_probability,
          line.claim_matching_model_id,
          coalesce(claim_edit.claim_edit_short_code, 'Unknown') AS claim_edit_short_code,
          coalesce(claim_edit.claim_edit_short_disposition, 'Unknown') AS claim_edit_short_disposition,
          CASE
            WHEN claim_edit.claim_edit_short_disposition = 'deny' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END AS claim_edit_indicator,
          coalesce(claim_edit.claim_edit_rationale, 'Unknown') AS claim_edit_rationale,
          coalesce(claim_edit.claim_edit_version, 1) AS claim_edit_version,
          coalesce(claim_edit.claim_edit_remark_code, 'Unknown') AS claim_edit_remark_code,
          coalesce(claim_edit.claim_edit_remark_description, 'Unknown') AS claim_edit_remark_description,
          -- Claim Grain attributes: This is obviously a "violation" of some
          -- Dimensional Modeling principals, but the purpose of any Paradigm is to help
          -- solve a problem, not get in the way of solving a problem. Adding this solves a problem for Analytics
          line.is_punted,
          coalesce(grouped_claim_procedure.procedure_signature, 'Unknown') AS claim_procedure_signature,
          coalesce(grouped_claim_procedure.procedure_descriptions, 'Unknown') AS claim_procedure_descriptions,
          coalesce(grouped_claim_diagnosis.diagnosis_signature, 'Unknown') AS diagnosis_signature,
          coalesce(grouped_claim_diagnosis.diagnosis_descriptions, 'Unknown') AS diagnosis_descriptions,
          coalesce(segment.procedure_descriptions, 'Unknown') AS segment_procedure_descriptions,
          coalesce(segment.procedure_signature, 'Unknown') AS segment_procedure_signature,
          GETDATE() AS record_last_updated_UTC,
          line.type_of_bill,
          line.admission_type,
          line.revenue_code,
          line.claim_revenue_code_signature,
          line.contracted_amount,
          line.contracted_amount_estimated_indicator,
          line.concert_denial_indicator,
          line.concert_denial_claim_edit_short_code,
          line.concert_denial_claim_edit_key,
          line.concert_denial_claim_edit_remark_code,
          line.aux_str_1,
          line.aux_str_2,
          line.aux_str_3,
          line.claim_form_type,
          line.copay_amount,
          line.administrative_duplicate_indicator,
          line.ioc_proc_sig_duplicate_indicator
        from line
        left join grouped_claim_procedure
          on line.claim_number = grouped_claim_procedure.claim_number
        left join grouped_claim_diagnosis
          on line.claim_number = grouped_claim_diagnosis.claim_number
        left join {{ FCT_POST_PAY_SEGMENT }} segment
          on line.claim_number = segment.claim_number
          and line.segment_key = segment.segment_key
        {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
          left join {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} {{ provider_type }}_provider
            on line.{{ provider_type }}_provider_key = {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_key
        {% endfor %}
        left join {{ DIM_PROCEDURE }} procedure
          on line.procedure_code = procedure.procedure_code
        {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
          left join {{ DIM_DIAGNOSIS }} diagnosis_{{ i }}
            on line.diagnosis_code_{{ i }} = diagnosis_{{ i }}.diagnosis_code    
        {% endfor %}
        left join {{ DIM_PLACE_OF_SERVICE }} place_of_service
          ON line.cms_place_of_service_code = place_of_service.place_of_service_code
        left join {{ DIM_CATEGORY }} category
          on line.category_id = category.category_id
        left join {{ DIM_CLAIM_EDIT }} claim_edit
          on line.claim_edit_key = claim_edit.claim_edit_key
      )

      select {{ generate_column_list_select(mart_post_pay_line_columns) }} from final
  {% endset %}

  {{ print("Updating " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data...") }}
  {% do run_query(query) %}
  {{ print("Updated " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data.") }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.concert.mart_post_pay_claim.name: mart_post_pay_claim
macro.concert.mart_post_pay_claim.macro_sql:
{% macro mart_post_pay_claim(payer_code) %}
    -- Vars

    -- Dependencies

        DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}

                claim.standard_place_of_service,
                claim.network_status,
                claim.has_prior_authorization,
                claim.entity,
                claim.reporting_group,
                claim.home_host,
                claim.line_of_business,
                claim.business_unit,
                claim.diagnosis_signature,
                claim.diagnosis_descriptions,
                claim.incident_of_care,
                claim.procedure_signature,
                mac.mac,
                claim.procedure_descriptions,
                claim.claim_status,
                claim.claims_system,
                claim.claim_form_type,
                claim.type_of_bill,
                claim.admission_type,
                -- Provider Dimension
                {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.lab_code                     AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_lab_code,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.lab_name                     AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_lab_name,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_npi                 AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_npi,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_ein                 AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_ein,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_name                AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_name,
                    {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_key                 AS  {{ provider_type }}_provider_key,
                {% endfor %}
                -- Facts
                claim.claim_revenue_code_signature,
                claim.paid_service_units,
                claim.segments_on_claim,
                claim.lines_on_claim,
                claim.service_units,
                claim.deductible_amount,
                claim.coinsurance_amount,

                        claim.{{ amount_type }}_amount,

            FROM {{ CLAIM }} claim
            LEFT JOIN {{ DIM_PLACE_OF_SERVICE }} place_of_service
                 ON claim.cms_place_of_service_code = place_of_service.place_of_service_code

                INNER JOIN {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} {{ provider_type }}_provider
                    ON claim.{{ provider_type }}_provider_key = {{ provider_type }}_provider.provider_key

            LEFT JOIN {{ MAC }} mac

        )
        SELECT {{ generate_column_list_select(mart_post_pay_claim_columns) }} FROM final

macro.concert.fct_post_pay_claim.name: fct_post_pay_claim
macro.concert.fct_post_pay_claim.macro_sql:
{% macro fct_post_pay_claim(payer_code) %}
    -- Vars
    {% set amount_types = var('amount_types') %}
    {% set provider_types = var('provider_types') %}

    -- Model Dependencies
    {% set POST_PAY_DIAGNOSIS__CLAIM__GROUPED = source('post_pay_staging', 'post_pay_diagnosis__claim__grouped') %}
    {% set POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__CLAIM__GROUPED = source('dw_common', 'post_pay_procedure__claim__grouped') %}
    {% set FCT_POST_PAY_SEGMENT = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_segment') %}
    {% set GROUPED_CLAIM_STATUS = source('dw_common', 'post_pay_payment_status__claim__grouped') %}
    {% set DIM_AGE_BAND = ref('dim_age_band') %}
    {% set DIM_PROVIDER = ref('dim_provider') %}
    {% set destination_table = source('dw_common', 'fct_post_pay_claim') %}

    {% set query %}
        DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}
        WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}';

        INSERT INTO {{ destination_table }}
        ( {{ generate_column_list_insert(fct_post_pay_claim_columns) }} )
        WITH

        claim AS (
            SELECT
                claim_number,

                COUNT(DISTINCT(segment_key))                  AS segments_on_claim,
                SUM(lines_on_segment)                         AS lines_on_claim,
                ANY_VALUE(payer_code)                         AS payer_code,
                ANY_VALUE(date_of_service)                    AS date_of_service,
                MIN(min_claim_paid_date)                      AS min_claim_paid_date,
                MAX(max_claim_paid_date)                      AS max_claim_paid_date,
                MIN(min_claim_received_date)                  AS min_claim_received_date,
                MAX(max_claim_received_date)                  AS max_claim_received_date, 
                ANY_VALUE(max_month_of_service)               AS max_month_of_service,
                ANY_VALUE(max_claim_paid_month)               AS max_claim_paid_month,
                ANY_VALUE(max_claim_received_month)           AS max_claim_received_month,
                ANY_VALUE(member_id)                          AS member_id,
                ANY_VALUE(member_state_code)                  AS member_state_code,
                ANY_VALUE(member_age)                         AS member_age,
                {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
                    ANY_VALUE({{ provider_type }}_provider_key)             AS {{ provider_type }}_provider_key,
                {% endfor %}
                ANY_VALUE(service_provider_state)                           AS service_provider_state,
                ANY_VALUE(cms_place_of_service_code)                        AS cms_place_of_service_code,
                ANY_VALUE(standard_place_of_service)                        AS standard_place_of_service,
                ANY_VALUE(network_status)                                   AS network_status,
                ANY_VALUE(member_sex)                                       AS member_sex,
                ANY_VALUE(has_ordering_provider)                            AS has_ordering_provider,
                ANY_VALUE(entity)                                           AS entity,
                ANY_VALUE(line_of_business)                                 AS line_of_business,
                ANY_VALUE(reporting_group)                                  AS reporting_group,
                ANY_VALUE(home_host)                                        AS home_host,
                ANY_VALUE(has_prior_authorization)                          AS has_prior_authorization,
                ANY_VALUE(business_unit)                                    AS business_unit,
                ANY_VALUE(claims_system)                                    AS claims_system,
                ANY_VALUE(incident_of_care)                                 AS incident_of_care,
                SUM(service_units)                                          AS service_units,
                ANY_VALUE(claim_revenue_code_signature)                     AS claim_revenue_code_signature,
                ANY_VALUE(claim_form_type)                                  AS claim_form_type,
                SUM(deductible_amount)                                      AS deductible_amount,
                SUM(coinsurance_amount)                                     AS coinsurance_amount,
                SUM(cob_amount)                                             AS cob_amount,
                MIN(type_of_bill)                                           AS type_of_bill,
                MIN(admission_type)                                         AS admission_type,
                {% for amount_type in amount_types %}
                    {% set label = 'paid' if amount_type == 'insurance_paid' else amount_type %}
                        SUM({{ amount_type }}_amount)                       AS {{ amount_type }}_amount,
                        SUM(edited_{{ label }}_amount)                      AS edited_{{ label }}_amount
                        {% if not loop.last%},{% endif %}
                {% endfor %}
            FROM {{ FCT_POST_PAY_SEGMENT }}
            WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
            GROUP BY 1
        ),

        final as (
            SELECT
                claim.payer_code,
                -- Primary Key
                claim.claim_number,
                -- Claim Dimensions
                claim.date_of_service,
                claim.min_claim_paid_date,
                claim.max_claim_paid_date,
                claim.min_claim_received_date,
                claim.max_claim_received_date,
                claim.max_month_of_service,
                claim.max_claim_paid_month,
                claim.max_claim_received_month,
                claim.member_id,
                claim.member_state_code,
                claim.member_age,
                {% for provider_type in provider_types %}
                    claim.{{ provider_type }}_provider_key,
                {% endfor %}
                claim.service_provider_state,
                claim.cms_place_of_service_code,
                claim.standard_place_of_service,
                -- # TODO( 2024-03-08 ): I'm not sure we will need this at the claim grain anymore - i think just the segment grain
                {{
                    create_claim_group_key(
                        cpt_signature='grouped_claim_procedure.procedure_signature',
                        icd_signature='grouped_claim_diagnosis.diagnosis_signature',
                        patient_gender='claim.member_sex',
                        patient_age_band_group='patient_age_band_group.age_band_group_code',
                        service_provider_lab_code='provider.lab_code'
                    )
                }} AS claim_group_id,
                -- Claim Profile Attributes
                claim.network_status,
                claim.member_sex,
                claim.has_ordering_provider,
                claim.entity,
                claim.line_of_business,
                claim.reporting_group,
                claim.home_host,
                claim.has_prior_authorization,
                claim.business_unit,
                claim.claims_system,
                claim.incident_of_care,
                claim.claim_form_type,
                claim.type_of_bill,
                claim.admission_type,
                grouped_claim_diagnosis.diagnosis_signature,
                grouped_claim_diagnosis.diagnosis_descriptions,
                grouped_claim_status.claim_status,
                grouped_claim_procedure.procedure_signature,
                grouped_claim_procedure.procedure_descriptions,
                -- Claim Facts
                claim.claim_revenue_code_signature,
                claim.segments_on_claim,
                claim.lines_on_claim,
                claim.service_units,
                grouped_claim_procedure.paid_service_units,
                claim.deductible_amount,
                claim.coinsurance_amount,
                claim.cob_amount,
                {% for amount_type in amount_types %}
                    {% set label = 'paid' if amount_type == 'insurance_paid' else amount_type %}
                        {{ amount_type }}_amount,
                        edited_{{ label }}_amount,
                {% endfor %}
                GETDATE()                                                   AS record_last_updated_UTC
            FROM claim
            INNER JOIN {{ POST_PAY_DIAGNOSIS__CLAIM__GROUPED }} grouped_claim_diagnosis
                ON claim.claim_number = grouped_claim_diagnosis.claim_number
            INNER JOIN {{ POST_PAY_PROCEDURE__CLAIM__GROUPED }} grouped_claim_procedure
                ON claim.claim_number = grouped_claim_procedure.claim_number
            INNER JOIN {{ GROUPED_CLAIM_STATUS }} grouped_claim_status
                ON claim.claim_number = grouped_claim_status.claim_number
            INNER JOIN {{ DIM_AGE_BAND }} patient_age_band_group
                ON claim.member_age = patient_age_band_group.age_band
            INNER JOIN {{ DIM_PROVIDER }} provider
                ON claim.service_provider_key = provider.provider_key
        )

        select {{ generate_column_list_select(fct_post_pay_claim_columns) }} from final
    {% endset %}

    {{ print("Updating " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data...") }}
    {% do run_query(query) %}
    {{ print("Updated " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data.") }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.concert.post_segmentation_unnestin.name: post_segmentation_unnesting
macro.concert.post_segmentation_unnestin.macro_sql:
{% macro post_segmentation_unnesting(payer_code) %}
  -- Models
  {% set destination_table = source('post_pay_staging', 'post_segmentation_unnesting') %}
  {% set MODELS = [
    { 'name': 'latest', 'ref': source('post_pay_staging', 'latest_segmentation_results') },
    { 'name': 'next', 'ref': source('post_pay_staging', 'next_segmentation_results') },
  ] %}

  -- Queries
  {% set LINE_KEYS = 'segment[0]::varchar' %}
  {% set SEGMENT_CLASS = 'segment[1]::varchar' %}
  {% set SEGMENT_NAME = 'segment[2]::varchar' %}
  {% set TARGET_COUNT = 'segment[3]::int' %}

  {% set query %}
      DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}
      WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}';

      INSERT INTO {{ destination_table }}
      ( {{ generate_column_list_insert(post_segmentation_unnesting_columns) }} )
      with

      {% for model in MODELS %}

        {{ model.name }}_segment as (
          select
            {{
              dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
                'claim.claim_number',
                SEGMENT_NAME,
                SEGMENT_CLASS,
              ])
            }}                                    as segment_key,
            {{
              dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
                SEGMENT_NAME,
                SEGMENT_CLASS,
              ])
            }}                                    as segment_id,
            claim.payer_code                      as payer_code,
            claim.claim_number                    as claim_number,
            claim.segment_data[0]::varchar        as segment_version,
            claim.segment_data[1]::varchar        as lab_code,
            claim.segment_data[2]::varchar        as standard_place_of_service,
            {{ SEGMENT_CLASS }}                   as segment_class,
            {{ SEGMENT_NAME }}                    as segment_name,
            NVL({{ TARGET_COUNT }}, 0)::int       as target_count,
            split_to_array(
              {{ LINE_KEYS}},
              ','
            )                                     as line_keys
          from
            {{ model.ref }} as claim,
            claim.segment_data[3] as segment
          where
            claim.payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
        ),

        {{ model.name }}_line as (
          select
            segment_key,
            segment_id,
            payer_code,
            claim_number,
            post_pay_line_key::varchar,
            segment_version,
            lab_code,
            standard_place_of_service,
            segment_class,
            segment_name,
            target_count
          from
            {{ model.name }}_segment as segment,
            segment.line_keys as post_pay_line_key
        ),
        
      {% endfor %}

      final as (
        select
          latest_line.payer_code,
          latest_line.segment_key,
          latest_line.segment_id,
          latest_line.claim_number,
          latest_line.post_pay_line_key,
          latest_line.segment_version,
          latest_line.lab_code,
          latest_line.standard_place_of_service,
          latest_line.segment_class,
          latest_line.segment_name,
          latest_line.target_count,
          next_line.segment_key          as next_segment_key,
          next_line.segment_id           as next_segment_id,
          next_line.segment_version      as next_segment_version,
          next_line.segment_class        as next_segment_class,
          next_line.segment_name         as next_segment_name,
          next_line.target_count         as next_target_count
        from latest_line
        left join next_line on
          latest_line.post_pay_line_key = next_line.post_pay_line_key
      )

      SELECT {{ generate_column_list_select(post_segmentation_unnesting_columns) }} from final
  {% endset %}

  {{ print("Updating " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data...") }}
  {% do run_query(query) %}
  {{ print("Updated " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data.") }}

{% endmacro %}

macro.concert.pre_editing_formatting.name: pre_editing_formatting
macro.concert.pre_editing_formatting.macro_sql:
{% macro pre_editing_formatting(payer_code) %}
  {% set provider_types = var('provider_types') %}

  {% set POST_SEGMENTATION_UNNESTING = source('post_pay_staging', 'post_segmentation_unnesting') %}
  {% set POST_PAY_LINE = source('post_pay_sources', 'post_pay_payers_claims_lines') %}
  {% set FCT_MATCHES = source('post_pay_staging', 'fct_matches') %}
  {% set destination_table = source('post_pay_staging', 'pre_editing_formatting') %}

  {% set query %}
      DELETE FROM {{ destination_table }}
      WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}';

      INSERT INTO {{ destination_table }}
      ( {{ generate_column_list_insert(pre_editing_formatting_columns) }} )
      WITH

      segments AS (
          SELECT * 
          FROM {{ POST_SEGMENTATION_UNNESTING }}
          WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
      ),

      line AS (
          SELECT
              claim_number,
              post_pay_line_key,
              member_sex,
              line_of_business,
              network_status,
              payer_code,
              member_age,
              member_state_code,
              billed_amount,
              allowed_amount,
              date_of_service,
              procedure_code,
              {% for i in range(1, 11) %}
                  diagnosis_code_{{ i }},
              {% endfor %}
              {% for i in range(1, 5) %}
                  procedure_modifier_{{ i }},
              {% endfor %}
              service_units,
              {% call(provider_type) for_delimited(provider_types, ',') %}
                {% set label = 'rendering' if provider_type == 'service' else provider_type %}
                  {{ provider_type }}_provider_ein AS {{ label }}_provider_ein,
                  {{ provider_type }}_provider_npi AS {{ label }}_provider_npi
              {% endcall %}
          FROM {{ POST_PAY_LINE }}
          WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
      ),

      -- These fields are "required" by the UDF, however we don't currently collect
      -- them from post pay claims data sets, so they must be "manufactured" here.
      -- Keep in mind, I'm using the word "required" to mean that the function
      -- signature "requires" them; there is logic within the UDF to handle the data
      -- being an emtpy string
      dummy_vars AS (
          SELECT
              CAST( '' AS TEXT ) AS procedure_code_2,
              CAST( '' AS TEXT ) AS procedure_code_3
      ),

      -- Get Claim Grain attributes to be applied to segments later
      claim_grain_attributes AS (
          SELECT 
              segments.claim_number,
              ANY_VALUE(segments.segment_key)                               AS segment_key,
              {{ post_pay_line_attr_concat("line.procedure_code") }}        AS all_procedure_code,
              {% for i in range(1, 5) %}
                  {{ post_pay_line_attr_concat("line.procedure_modifier_" ~ i ~ "") }} AS all_procedure_modifier_{{ i }},
              {% endfor %}
              {% call(i) for_delimited(range(1, 11), ',') %}
                {{ post_pay_line_attr_concat("line.diagnosis_code_" ~ i) }} AS all_icd_code_{{ i }}
              {% endcall %},
              {% call(provider_type) for_delimited(provider_types, ',') %}
                {% set label = 'rendering' if provider_type == 'service' else provider_type %}
                  ANY_VALUE(line.{{ label }}_provider_ein) AS {{ label }}_provider_ein,
                  ANY_VALUE(line.{{ label }}_provider_npi) AS {{ label }}_provider_npi
              {% endcall %}
          FROM segments
          -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
          INNER JOIN line ON
              segments.claim_number = line.claim_number AND
              segments.post_pay_line_key = line.post_pay_line_key
          GROUP BY 1
      ),

      -- Aggregate lines to the Segment Grain 
      segment AS (
          SELECT
              -- Optimize group by operation with claim_number dist key
              segments.claim_number                                                          AS claim_number,
              segments.segment_key                                                           AS segment_key,

              ANY_VALUE(line.member_sex)                                                     AS patient_gender,
              ANY_VALUE(line.line_of_business)                                               AS line_of_business,
              ANY_VALUE(line.network_status)                                                 AS network_status,
              ANY_VALUE(line.payer_code)                                                     AS payer_code,
              ANY_VALUE(line.member_age)                                                     AS patient_age_band,
              ANY_VALUE(line.member_state_code)                                              AS patient_state_code,
              ANY_VALUE(segments.standard_place_of_service)                                  AS standard_place_of_service,
              ANY_VALUE(match.category_id)                                                   AS category_id,
              {{ post_pay_line_attr_concat("COALESCE( line.billed_amount, 0 )") }}           AS all_billed_amount,
              {{ post_pay_line_attr_concat("COALESCE( line.allowed_amount, 0 )") }}          AS all_allowed_amount,
              {{ post_pay_line_attr_concat("TO_CHAR(line.date_of_service, 'YYYY-MM-DD')") }} AS all_date_of_service,
              {{ post_pay_line_attr_concat("line.service_units") }}                          AS all_service_units
          FROM segments
          -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
          INNER JOIN line ON
              segments.claim_number = line.claim_number AND
              segments.post_pay_line_key = line.post_pay_line_key
          -- Optimized join using claim_number dist key
          -- Adding a "WHERE payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'" isn't necessary since claim_number is unique across all payers
          LEFT JOIN {{ FCT_MATCHES }} match ON
              segments.claim_number = match.claim_number AND
              segments.segment_key = match.segment_key
          GROUP BY 1, 2
      ),

      final as (
          select
              segment.payer_code            AS payer_code,
              segment.claim_number          AS claim_number,
              segment.segment_key           AS segment_key,
              segment.patient_age_band      AS patient_age_band,
              segment.patient_state_code    AS patient_state_code,
              -- NOTE( 2025-02-19 ): This is done in this model (as opposed to further upstream) because this is the direct input into the editing process, and "M"/"F" are the expected values. In most other places in the DW, the goal is human-readability, not claim-edit-api compatibility.
              CASE
                WHEN segment.patient_gender = 'Male' THEN 'M'
                WHEN segment.patient_gender = 'Female' THEN 'F'
                ELSE 'U'
              END AS patient_gender,
              {% call(provider_type) for_delimited(provider_types, ',') %}
                {% set label = 'rendering' if provider_type == 'service' else provider_type %}
                  claim_grain_attributes.{{ label }}_provider_ein AS {{ label }}_provider_ein,
                  claim_grain_attributes.{{ label }}_provider_npi AS {{ label }}_provider_npi
              {% endcall %},
              -- NOTE( 2024-09-11 ): This is done in this model (as opposed to further upstream) because this is the direct input into the editing process, and "Comm", "Mcaid" and "Mcare" are the expected values. In most other places in the DW, the goal is human-readability, not claim-edit-api compatibility.
              CASE
                  WHEN segment.line_of_business IN ('Commercial', 'Comm') THEN 'Comm'
                  WHEN segment.line_of_business IN ('Medicaid') THEN 'Mcaid'
                  WHEN segment.line_of_business IN ('Medicare') THEN 'Mcare'
                  ELSE 'Unknown'
              END                           AS line_of_business,
              segment.network_status        AS network_status,
              segment.standard_place_of_service AS standard_place_of_service,
              segment.category_id           AS category_id,
              segment.all_billed_amount     AS all_billed_amount,
              segment.all_allowed_amount    AS all_allowed_amount,
              segment.all_date_of_service   AS all_date_of_service,
              claim_grain_attributes.all_procedure_code AS all_procedure_code,
              {% for i in range(1, 5) %}
                CASE
                    -- replaces the output of post_pay_line_attr_concat if that output isn't carrying any information
                    WHEN claim_grain_attributes.all_procedure_modifier_{{ i }} ~ '[a-z0-9]{32}=[0-9A-Z]{2}' THEN claim_grain_attributes.all_procedure_modifier_{{ i }}
                    ELSE ''
                END                         AS all_procedure_modifier_{{ i }},
              {% endfor %}
              segment.all_service_units     AS all_service_units,
              {% call(i) for_delimited(range(1,11), ',') %}
                  CASE
                      -- replaces the output of post_pay_line_attr_concat if that output isn't carrying any information
                      WHEN claim_grain_attributes.all_icd_code_{{ i }} ~ '^[a-z0-9]{32}=[A-Z0-9]{1,}' THEN claim_grain_attributes.all_icd_code_{{ i }}
                      ELSE ''
                  END                       AS all_icd_code_{{ i }}
              {% endcall %}
          from segment
          inner join claim_grain_attributes
              on segment.claim_number = claim_grain_attributes.claim_number
          inner join dummy_vars
              on 1 = 1
      )

      SELECT {{ generate_column_list_select(pre_editing_formatting_columns) }} FROM final
  {% endset %}

  {{ print("Updating " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data...") }}
  {% do run_query(query) %}
  {{ print("Updated " ~ destination_table ~ " with " ~ payer_code ~ "'s data.") }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.concert.standardize_line_of_busine.macro_sql:
{% macro standardize_line_of_business(column) %}
    CASE 
        -- # NOTE( 2022-10-11 ): regex
        WHEN TRIM({{ column }}) SIMILAR TO '%(MEDICARE|Medicare|medicare)%'THEN 'Medicare'
        WHEN TRIM({{ column }}) SIMILAR TO '%(MEDICAID|Medicaid|medicaid)%'THEN 'Medicaid'
        WHEN TRIM({{ column }}) SIMILAR TO '%(COMMERCIAL|Commercial|commercial|COM)%'THEN 'Commercial'

        -- # NOTE( 2022-10-11 ): global acronyms 
        WHEN TRIM({{ column }}) IN (
            'ME',
            'MC',
            'MEDSUPP',
            'MED ADV',
            'BLUE SHIELD PROMISE-MED ADV'
        ) THEN 'Medicare'
        WHEN TRIM({{ column }}) IN (
            'MD',
            'BLUE SHIELD PROMISE-MEDI-CAL'
        ) THEN 'Medicaid'
        WHEN TRIM({{ column }}) IN (
            'CO',
            'CP',
            'EX'
        ) THEN 'Commercial'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END
{% endmacro %}
macro.concert.standardize_line_of_busine.description: Standardizes a line of business column to be one of 'Medicare', 'Medicaid', 'Commercial' or 'Unknown'

{% macro compare_semver(va, vb) %}

macro.concert.to_json_string.name: to_json_string
macro.concert.to_json_string.description: Utility macro for assembling a JSON string from literal or sql values

arguments.name: definition_dict
arguments.description:
A dictionary of key value pairs where the key represents the key used in the final JSON output string, and the value is a configuration object.

_**Value Definition**_
- `literal`: Indicates that a literal value should inserted (pass `none` to ignore)
- `sql`: Will treat the string as SQL and wrap it in a coalesce to null statement (pass `none` to ignore)
- `quoted`: Will wrap the final JSON value in quotes to be treated as a string (defaults to true). For example a boolean or numeric JSON value should not be wrapped in quotes

_**Example**_
```jinja
-- The following call:
\{\{ to_json_string({
  "key1": { "literal": "105", "quoted": "false" }, -- Numeric literal value
  "key2": { "sql": "my_column" }, -- SQL Column (quoted by default)
}) \}\}

-- Will produce the following SQL output
(
  '{' ||
  '"key1":' || '105' ||
  ',"key2":' || coalesce(
    ('"' || my_column::varchar || '"'),
    'null'
  ) ||
  '}'
)
```

macro.concert.update_matching_cache.name: update_matching_cache
macro.concert.update_matching_cache.macro_sql:
{% macro update_matching_cache(payer_code, next = FALSE) %}

    {% set next_prefix = '' if not next else 'next_' %}
    {% set table_prefix = 'latest_' if not next else 'next_' %}

    {% set prod_model_id = 'CLAIM_MATCHING_MODEL_ID' %}
    {# If the next model id is not set, it will default to the production model id #}
    {% set model_id = env_var((next_prefix | upper) ~ prod_model_id, env_var(prod_model_id)) %}

    {% set PRE_INFERENCE_FORMATTING = source('post_pay_staging', table_prefix ~ 'pre_inference_formatting') %}
    {% set destination_table = source('matching_cache', 'matching_cache') %}
    {% set tmp_table = payer_code ~ '_tmp_matching_cache' %}

    {% set query %}
        CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE {{ tmp_table }} AS
        WITH 

        -- Grain: Segment (Only match for known segments)
        segments AS (
            SELECT * 
            FROM {{ PRE_INFERENCE_FORMATTING }}
            WHERE 
                payer_code = '{{ payer_code }}'
                AND segment_class != 'Unknown'
        ),

        -- Grain: Segment Group
        distinct_segment_groups AS (
            SELECT
                DISTINCT
                all_cpt,
                all_icd,
                gender,
                member_age_band,
                service_provider_lab_code,
                segment_name,
                segment_class,
                target_count
            FROM segments
        ),

        -- Grain: Segment Group
        -- Segment Groups without predictions *from this model*
        groups_wo_predictions AS (
            SELECT
                -- model inputs
                distinct_segment_groups.all_cpt,
                distinct_segment_groups.all_icd,
                distinct_segment_groups.gender,
                distinct_segment_groups.member_age_band,
                distinct_segment_groups.service_provider_lab_code,
                distinct_segment_groups.segment_name,
                distinct_segment_groups.segment_class,
                distinct_segment_groups.target_count,
                -- predictions
                JSON_PARSE(predict_category(
                    '{{ model_id }}',
                    CAST( distinct_segment_groups.all_cpt                    AS  TEXT),
                    CAST( distinct_segment_groups.all_icd                    AS  TEXT),
                    CAST( distinct_segment_groups.gender                     AS  TEXT),
                    CAST( distinct_segment_groups.member_age_band            AS   INT),
                    CAST( distinct_segment_groups.service_provider_lab_code  AS  TEXT),
                    CAST( distinct_segment_groups.segment_name               AS  TEXT),
                    CAST( distinct_segment_groups.segment_class              AS  TEXT),
                    CAST( COALESCE(distinct_segment_groups.target_count, 0)  AS   INT)
                )) AS prediction,
                -- prediction metadata
                '{{ model_id }}' AS model_id
            FROM distinct_segment_groups
            LEFT JOIN {{ destination_table }} matching_cache
                ON distinct_segment_groups.all_cpt                = matching_cache.all_cpt                   AND
                distinct_segment_groups.all_icd                   = matching_cache.all_icd                   AND
                distinct_segment_groups.gender                    = matching_cache.gender                    AND
                distinct_segment_groups.member_age_band           = matching_cache.member_age_band           AND

            WHERE
                matching_cache.all_cpt                   IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.all_icd                   IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.gender                    IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.member_age_band           IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.service_provider_lab_code IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.segment_name              IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.segment_class             IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.target_count              IS NULL AND
                matching_cache.model_id                  IS NULL

            SELECT
                all_cpt,
                all_icd,
                gender,
                member_age_band,
                service_provider_lab_code,
                segment_name,
                segment_class,
                target_count,
                prediction.category_id::VARCHAR AS predicted_label,
                prediction.probability::REAL AS probability,
                model_id
            FROM groups_wo_predictions
        )

            all_cpt,
            all_icd,
            gender,
            member_age_band,
            service_provider_lab_code,
            segment_name,
            segment_class,
            target_count,
            predicted_label,
            probability,
            model_id
        FROM final;

macro.dbt_redshift.redshift__get_columns.name: redshift__get_columns_in_relation
macro.dbt_redshift.redshift__get_columns.macro_sql:
{% macro redshift__get_columns_in_relation(relation) -%}
  {% call statement('get_columns_in_relation', fetch_result=True) %}
      with bound_views as (
        select
          ordinal_position,
          table_schema,
          column_name,
          data_type,
          character_maximum_length,
          numeric_precision,
          numeric_scale

        from information_schema."columns"
        where table_name = '{{ relation.identifier }}'
    ),

    unbound_views as (
      select
        ordinal_position,
        view_schema,
        col_name,
        case
          when col_type ilike 'character varying%' then
            'character varying'
          when col_type ilike 'numeric%' then 'numeric'
          else col_type
        end as col_type,
        case
          when col_type like 'character%'
          then nullif(REGEXP_SUBSTR(col_type, '[0-9]+'), '')::int
          else null
        end as character_maximum_length,
        case
          when col_type like 'numeric%'
          then nullif(
            SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_SUBSTR(col_type, '[0-9,]+'), ',', 1),
            '')::int
          else null
        end as numeric_precision,
        case
          when col_type like 'numeric%'
          then nullif(
            SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_SUBSTR(col_type, '[0-9,]+'), ',', 2),
            '')::int
          else null
        end as numeric_scale

      from pg_get_late_binding_view_cols()
      cols(view_schema name, view_name name, col_name name,
           col_type varchar, ordinal_position int)
      where view_name = '{{ relation.identifier }}'
    ),

    external_views as (
      select
        columnnum,
        schemaname,
        columnname,
        case
          when external_type ilike 'character varying%' or external_type ilike 'varchar%'
          then 'character varying'
          when external_type ilike 'numeric%' then 'numeric'
          else external_type
        end as external_type,
        case
          when external_type like 'character%' or external_type like 'varchar%'
          then nullif(
            REGEXP_SUBSTR(external_type, '[0-9]+'),
            '')::int
          else null
        end as character_maximum_length,
        case
          when external_type like 'numeric%'
          then nullif(
            SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_SUBSTR(external_type, '[0-9,]+'), ',', 1),
            '')::int
          else null
        end as numeric_precision,
        case
          when external_type like 'numeric%'
          then nullif(
            SPLIT_PART(REGEXP_SUBSTR(external_type, '[0-9,]+'), ',', 2),
            '')::int
          else null
        end as numeric_scale
      from
        pg_catalog.svv_external_columns
      where
        schemaname = '{{ relation.schema }}'
        and tablename = '{{ relation.identifier }}'

    ),

    unioned as (
      select * from bound_views
      union all
      select * from unbound_views
      union all
      select * from external_views
    )

    select
      column_name,
      data_type,
      character_maximum_length,
      numeric_precision,
      numeric_scale

    from unioned
    {% if relation.schema %}
    where table_schema = '{{ relation.schema }}'
    {% endif %}
    order by ordinal_position
  {% endcall %}
  {% set table = load_result('get_columns_in_relation').table %}
  {{ return(sql_convert_columns_in_relation(table)) }}
{% endmacro %}
